id: Taring dari beast yang ganas dan pemakan daging, yang ada di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha. Kekuatan rahang binatang ini sering membuat taringnya sendiri cuil atau rusak selagi dia menguyah buruannya. Karena ini, gigi yang rusak dari binatang ini sering ditemukan, dan sering dipakai untuk membuat senjata. Tapi, banyak yang berusaha menyerang daerah beast ini tanpa persiapan dan akhirnya mati. Karena itu, harus berhati-hati dalam mencari bahan yang satu ini.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10512_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The fang of a ferocious and carnivorous beast that inhabits the Principality of Vriksha. This animal's jaw strength is such that it often chips off, or breaks its own fangs as it masticates its prey. For this reason it is quite common to run into this creature's broken teeth, and are thus often used as materials to create weapons. However, there are many who invade this beast's territory unprepared and end up losing their lives in the process. Therefore, great caution is needed when searching for this particular material.

raw.en: The fang of a ferocious and carnivorous beast that inhabits the Principality of Vriksha. This animal's jaw strength is such that it often chips off, or breaks its own fangs as it masticates its prey. raw.es: Colmillo de una bestia salvaje y carnívora que vive en el principado de Vriksha. Este animal tiene tanta fuerza en la mandíbula que a menudo se parte los propios colmillos cuando mastica a su presa. Por esta razón, es bastante común encontrar los dientes partidos de esta criatura. A menudo se los usa como material para crear armas. No obstante, hay muchos que invaden el territorio de la bestia sin haberse preparado y terminan perdiendo la vida en la aventura. Por ello es necesario tener mucho cuidado al buscar este material.

Karena ini, gigi yang rusak dari binatang ini sering ditemukan, dan sering dipakai untuk membuat senjata. Tapi, banyak yang berusaha menyerang daerah beast ini tanpa persiapan dan akhirnya mati. raw.pt: A presa de uma besta feroz e carnívora que vive no Principado de Vriksha. A força da mandíbula deste animal é tanta que ele constantemente racha ou quebra os próprios dentes enquanto mastiga suas vítimas. Por esse motivo é bastante comum encontrar dentes quebrados desta criatura e eles são normalmente usados como material para criar armas. No entanto, há muitos que invadem o território deste monstro despreparados e acabam perdendo a vida no caminho. Portanto, é preciso ter muito cuidado ao procurar esse material em particular.
raw.th: เขี้ยวของสัตว์ที่ดุร้ายและกินเนื้ออาศัยอยู่ในเขตแดนของพฤกษา ความแข็งแรงขากรรไกรของสัตว์นี้มักจะทำให้เขี้ยวของมันหลุดหรือหักออกมา ขณะที่มันเคี้ยวเหยื่อของมัน ด้วยเหตุนี้มันจึงเป็นเรื่องธรรมดาที่จะพบเขี้ยวที่หักของสัตว์ตัวนี้ และจึงมักจะถูกใช้เป็นวัตถุดิบในการสร้างอาวุธ แต่มีหลายคนที่บุกรุกเข้าไปยังดินแดนของสัตว์ร้ายโดยไม่เตรียมตัว และก็ต้องขบลงด้วยการสูญเสียชีวิตไป ดังนั้นจึงต้องมีความระมัดระวังอย่างมาก เมื่อออกค้นหาวัตถุดิบดังกล่าว
raw.vi: Răng nanh của một con thú hung dữ và ăn thịt sống ở Công quốc Vriksha. Sức mạnh đôi hàm của con vật này cực khủng khiếp làm các răng nanh của nó thường bị sứt mẻ, hoặc nứt vỡ khi nhai nuốt con mồi của nó. Vì lý do đó mọi người thường hay bắt gặp răng vỡ của sinh vật này, và do đó thường được sử dụng làm nguyên liệu chế tạo vũ khí. Tuy nhiên, vẫn có rất nhiều người xâm chiếm lãnh thổ của con quái vật này mà không chuẩn bị sẵn và đã mất mạng trong quá trình đó. Vì vậy, cần phải hết sức thận trọng khi tìm kiếm nguyên liệu đặc biệt này.

id: Taring yang terus dibungkus oleh aliran listrik. Taring yang dipercaya dimiliki oleh makhluk yang menyerupai jerapah ketika dewasa, tapi karena beast ini punya kepandaian yang lebih rendah dari jerapah dan tubuhnya lebih kecil, klaim ini diragukan oleh para sarjana. Taring beast ini punya kemampuan untuk menyerap listrik, jadi sering dipakai sebagai bahan untuk membuat senjata. Tapi, karena juga punya kekuatan untuk memanggil guntur, sifat sihirnya digunakan untuk berbagai ritual, dan untuk membuat jebakan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10513_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A fang continuously surrounded by a bit of electricity. The fang was believed to belong to a creature that resembles a giraffe in its mature state, but since the beast has lower intelligence than a giraffe and its stature is also smaller, this claim is disputed by many scholars. This beast's fang has the ability to absorb electricity, so it is often used as a material to create weapons. However, since it also has the power to call lightning, its magical properties are used for various rituals, and to set up traps as well.

raw.en: A fang continuously surrounded by a bit of electricity. The fang was believed to belong to a creature that resembles a giraffe in its mature state, but since the beast has lower intelligence than a giraffe and its stature is also smaller, this claim is disputed by many scholars. This beast's fang has the ability to absorb electricity, so it is often used as a material to create weapons. However, since it also has the power to call lightning, its magical properties are used for various rituals, and to set up traps as well.
raw.es: Un colmillo rodeado constantemente por la electricidad. Se cree que este colmillo perteneció a una criatura similar a una jirafa madura. Sin embargo, debido a que la bestia es menos inteligente y más pequeña que una jirafa, muchos eruditos desconfían de este dato. El colmillo de la bestia tiene la habilidad de absorber la electricidad, así que a menudo se lo usa como material para crear armas. Sin embargo, dado que también tiene el poder de llamar a las tormentas, sus propiedades mágicas se usan para muchos rituales, además de para preparar trampas.

raw.pt: Uma presa constantemente cercada por eletricidade. Acreditam que a presa pertencia a uma criatura que lembra uma girafa quando adulta mas, já que a fera tem inteligência inferior a de uma girafa e sua estatura também é menor, essa possibilidade é refutada por muitos especialistas. A presa desta fera tem a habilidade de absorver eletricidade, então ela é muito usada como material na criação de armas. No entanto, já que ela também tem o poder de atrair raios, suas propriedades mágicas são usadas para vários rituais e em armadilhas também.
raw.th: เขี้ยวที่มีประกายไฟเล็กๆ สถิตย์อยู่โดยรอบ เชื่อกันว่าเขี้ยวนี้เป็นของสิ่งมีชีวิตรูปร่างคล้ายยีราฟที่โตเต็มวัย แต่เมื่อมันเริ่มฉลาดน้อยกว่ายีราฟ และขนาดร่างกายก็เล็กกว่า จึงคาดว่าเป็นฝีมือของเหล่านักปราชญ์ที่ทำให้เกิดเรื่องวุ่นวายเช่นนี้ เขี้ยวของมันดูดซับกระแสไฟฟ้าได้ จึงถูกนำมาเป็นวัตถุดิบในการสร้างอาวุธ อย่างไรก็ตาม ตั้งแต่มันมีพลังในการเรียกสายฟ้า พลังเวทย์ของมันก็ถูกนำไปใช้กับพิธีกรรมทั้งหลาย และยังใช้สร้างกับดักได้ด้วย
raw.vi: Một chiếc nanh luôn được bao bọc bởi một chút lôi điện. Chiếc nanh được cho là của một loài giống hươu cao cổ khi đã trưởng thành, bởi con thú này có trí thông minh thấp hơn so với hươu cao cổ và tầm vóc cũng nhỏ hơn, nhiều học giả vẫn còn tranh cãi tuyên bố này. Nanh của quái thú này có khả năng hấp thụ lôi điện, vì vậy nó thường được dùng làm nguyên liệu chế tạo vũ khí. Tuy nhiên, vì nó cũng có quyền năng kêu gọi sấm sét, các đặc tính phép thuật của nó được dùng cho nhiều nghi lễ cũng như để tạo bẫy rập.

id: Di Bariura, ada legenda kuno tentang monster yang tak kasatmata. Tadinya dikira makhluk mitos, tapi taringnya tidak ditemukan di area selain tempat penemuan, banyak orang mulai percaya bahwa taring tersebut berasal dari beast tak kasatmata. Taring ini punya banyak manfaat. Pencarian makhluk tak kasatmata mulai intensif, meski belum ditemulan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10514_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In Bariura there is an ancient legend that tells of an invisible monster. It was thought to be a mythical creature at first, but after the fangs of a creature not found anywhere in the area were discovered, many began to believe that the fangs belonged to the rumored invisible beast. Once it was discovered that these fangs had great beneficial properties, the search for the invisible creature heightened, though such creature has yet to be found.

raw.en: In Bariura there is an ancient legend that tells of an invisible monster. It was thought to be a mythical creature at first, but after the fangs of a creature not found anywhere in the area were discovered, many began to believe that the fangs belonged to the rumored invisible beast. Once it was discovered that these fangs had great beneficial properties, the search for the invisible creature heightened, though such creature has yet to be found.
raw.es: En Bariura existe una antigua leyenda que habla de un monstruo invisible. Al principio se creía que era una criatura mítica, pero luego de que se descubrieron los colmillos de una criatura nunca vista en el área, muchos comenzaron a creer que los colmillos pertenecían a una bestia invisible. Cuando se descubrió que estos colmillos tenían propiedades benéficas, se intensificó la búsqueda de la criatura invisible, aunque todavía no ha sido encontrada.

raw.pt: Há uma antiga lenda em Bariura que fala de um monstro invisível. Acreditavam que era uma criatura mística no início mas, depois da descoberta de presas de uma criatura jamais vista na região, muitos passaram a acreditar que as presas pertenciam a essa fera invisível. Quando descobriram que essas presas tinham ótimas propriedades positivas, a procura pela criatura invisível aumentou, mas ela ainda não foi vista.
raw.th: ในบาริอุระมีตำนานเล่าขานถึงสัตว์ประหลาดที่มองไม่เห็น ทีแรกนั้นคาดว่าเป็นสัตว์ประหลาดในตำนาน แต่เมื่อไม่พบเขี้ยวของมันในบริเวณใกล้ๆ สถานที่ค้นพบ หลายคนจึงเชื่อว่าอาจเป็นเขี้ยวของสัตว์ประหลาดที่มองไม่เห็นตามข่าวลือ ทำให้เขี้ยวนี้กลายเป็นของมีค่าขึ้นมา เริ่มมีการออกตามหาสิ่งมีชีวิตนี้มากขึ้น แต่ก็ยังไม่มีใครพบเจอ
raw.vi: Ở Bariura có một truyền thuyết cổ xưa về một con quái vật vô hình. Lúc đầu nó được cho là một sinh vật thần thoại, nhưng sau khi phát hiện răng nanh của một sinh vật không tìm thấy ở trong vùng, nhiều người bắt đầu tin rằng chúng thuộc về quái thú vô hình được đồn đại đó. Sau khi phát hiện những chiếc răng nanh này mang nhiều đặc tính ích lợi, việc tìm kiếm sinh vật vô hình đó đã gia tăng, dù vẫn chưa tìm ra sinh vật nào như vậy.

id: Taring yang dipakai Granomos untuk menavigasi bawah tanah, mengubah permukaan karang solid menjadi pasir. Pertama dipelajari oleh Pembunuh Setan saat mereka membawanya dari survei tanah, tapi barang ini dianggap dirancang untuk menggali oleh para ahli. Dalam riset terbaru, taring ini dipakai sebagai model alat menggali, meski perlu banyak agar studi terus berlangsung.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10515_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A fang that Granomos uses as it navigates underground to turn rock solid surfaces into tiny grains of sand. First studied by the Demon Slayers when they brought it back from a land survey, this Item was deemed to be designed for digging by their experts. In current research these fangs are used as a model to create new digging equipment, though many more of them will probably be needed in order to keep the studies going.

raw.en: A fang that Granomos uses as it navigates underground to turn rock solid surfaces into tiny grains of sand. First studied by the Demon Slayers when they brought it back from a land survey, this Item was deemed to be designed for digging by their experts. In current research these fangs are used as a model to create new digging equipment, though many more of them will probably be needed in order to keep the studies going.
raw.es: Un colmillo que usa Granomos para moverse bajo tierra y convertir superficies de roca sólida en pequeños granos de arena. Los expertos de los Exterminadores de demonios estudiaron este objeto cuando lo trajeron de un viaje de investigación y llegaron a la conclusión de que está diseñado para excavar. En las investigaciones actuales, estos colmillos se usan como modelo para la creación de equipo de excavación, si bien es claro que se necesitarán muchos más para continuar con los estudios.
