raw.pt: Uma presa utilizada por Granomos em escavações para transformar rochas em pequenas migalhas. Estudada primeiramente pelos Caçadores de Demônios quando trouxeram uma peça de um mapeamento, classificando o item como ferramenta de escavação. Em uma pesquisa recente, esta presa é usada como modelo para criar novos equipamentos de escavação, porém muito ainda serão necessários para que os estudos continuem.
raw.th: เขี้ยวที่กรานอมอสใช้ในการเดินทางใต้ดินเพื่อเปลี่ยนหินแข็งเป็นทรายเม็ดเล็กๆ การศึกษาครั้งแรกของนักปราบปีศาจในตอนที่พวกเขานำเขี้ยวกลับมา เขี้ยวนี้สามารถใช้ได้โดยผู้เชี่ยวชาญเท่านั้น ในตอนนี้เขี้ยวพวกนี้ได้ใช้เป็นตัวอย่างในการคิดค้นเครื่องมือขุดเจาะ แต่อาจจะต้องการเขี้ยวจำนวนมากในการศึกษาต่อไป
raw.vi: Một chiếc năng được Granomos sử dụng để đi dưới lòng đất biến bề mặt đá rắn thành những hạt cát nhỏ. Đầu tiên được nghiên cứu bởi các Sát thủ diệt ma khi họ mang nó về từ cuộc khảo sát một vùng đất, Vật phẩm này được cho là được thiết kế cho đào bởi các chuyên gia sử dụng chúng. Trong nghiên cứu gần đây, những chiếc nanh này được sử dụng làm mẫu để tạo ra thiết bị đào mới, mặc dù có thể sẽ cần nhiều mẫu hơn nữa để nghiên cứu được tiếp tục.

id: Balmedia adalah makhluk yang baru-baru ini ditemukan. Banyak referensi dibaca untuk menentukan apakah ini jenis beast baru atau mungkin setan tak dikenal. Tidak ada mitos yang menyebutkan makhluk ini meski jilid tertentu menyebutkan serigala putih dari dunia lain muncul untuk menghakimi. Ada banyak orang yang mengklaim makhluk dalam jilid adalah Balmedia.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10516_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Balmedia is a creature that was discovered only recently. An excessive amount of literature had to be consulted in order to determine whether it was an entirely new type of beast, or perhaps and unknown demon. No myths have been currently found to mention the creature, though a supposed forged tome mentions a white wolf from another world which appears to pass judgment. There are many people who claim that the creature mentioned in the tome could be none other than Balmedia.

raw.en: Balmedia is a creature that was discovered only recently. An excessive amount of literature had to be consulted in order to determine whether it was an entirely new type of beast, or perhaps and unknown demon. No myths have been currently found to mention the creature, though a supposed forged tome mentions a white wolf from another world which appears to pass judgment. There are many people who claim that the creature mentioned in the tome could be none other than Balmedia.
raw.es: Balmedia es una criatura que se descubrió hace relativamente poco tiempo. Hubo que consultar muchísimos escritos para determinar si era un tipo de bestia completamente nuevo, o quizá un demonio desconocido. Todavía no se han encontrado mitos donde se mencione a esta criatura, si bien en un tomo supuestamente falso se menciona un lobo blanco de otro mundo cuya misión es dictar sentencias. Mucha gente asegura que la criatura mencionada en el tomo no es otra que Balmedia.
raw.id: Balmedia adalah makhluk yang baru-baru ini ditemukan. Banyak referensi dibaca untuk menentukan apakah ini jenis beast baru atau mungkin setan tak dikenal. Tidak ada mitos yang menyebutkan makhluk ini meski jilid tertentu menyebutkan serigala putih dari dunia lain muncul untuk menghakimi. Ada banyak orang yang mengklaim makhluk dalam jilid adalah Balmedia.
raw.pt: Balmedia é uma criatura recém descoberta. Muitas referências foram consultadas para determinar se era um novo tipo de fera ou algum demônio desconhecido. Nenhum mito foi encontrado que mencione a criatura, apesar de um certo volume comentar algo sobre um lobo de outro mundo que parece passar no julgamento. Muitas pessoas afirmam que a criatura mencionada no volume não pode ser qualquer outra além de Balmedia.
raw.th: บาลเมเดียเป็นสิ่งมีชีวิตที่เพิ่งถูกค้นพบได้ไม่นาน ต้องการศึกษาจำนวนมากเพื่อตัดสินใจว่า เจ้าสิ่งนี้เป็นสัตว์สายพันธุ๋ใหม่ที่เพิ่งถูกค้นพบหรือเป็นปีศาจที่ไม่มีข้อมูล ไม่มีตำนานไหนได้กล่าวถึงสิ่งมีชีวิตตัวนี้ แต่มีสมุดบันทึกเล่มหนึ่งที่ได้กล่าวถึงหมาป่าขาวจากโลกอื่นที่จะนำโทษทัณฑ์มาให้ มีคนหลายคนคิดว่าสิ่งมีชีวิตในสมุดบันทึกนี้คือบาลเมเดีย
raw.vi: Balmedia là một sinh vật chỉ mới được phát hiện gần đây. Người ta phải tham khảo rất nhiều tài liệu để xác định xem nó hoàn toàn là một loài quái vật mới hay có thể là một loài quỷ chưa biết. Không có truyền thuyết nào gần đây được tìm thấy nhắc đến sinh vật này, mặc dù một bộ sách được cho là giả nhắc đến một con sói trắng đến từ thế giới khác xuất hiện để phán quyết. Có nhiều người cho rằng được nhắc đến trong bộ sách này không phải sinh vật nào khách chính là Balmedia.

id: Kristal dengan kekuatan api. Sangat intens, percik merahnya sangat disukai oleh wanita yang berapi-api. Terbentuk di daerah di mana kekuatan Roh Api tinggi, seperti Gua Api di Mistral, atau Gunung Berapi dari St. Lamia. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan api.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal with the power of fire. Its intense, red sparkle is loved by fiery women. It forms in areas where the Fire Spirit's power is high, such as the Cave of Flames in Mistral, or the Volcanoes of St. Lamia. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates fire-enhancing tools.

raw.en: A crystal with the power of fire. Its intense, red sparkle is loved by fiery women. It forms in areas where the Fire Spirit's power is high, such as the Cave of Flames in Mistral, or the Volcanoes of St. Lamia. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates fire-enhancing tools.
raw.es: Un cristal con el poder del fuego cuya intensa luz atrae a las mujeres más fogosas. Se encuentra en zonas donde el poder del espíritu ígneo es elevado, como la cueva de magma o los volcanes de Santa Lamia. Puede sintetizarse con una roca azarosa o noble para crear potenciadores de fuego.
raw.id: Kristal dengan kekuatan api. Sangat intens, percik merahnya sangat disukai oleh wanita yang berapi-api. Terbentuk di daerah di mana kekuatan Roh Api tinggi, seperti Gua Api di Mistral, atau Gunung Berapi dari St. Lamia. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan api.
raw.pt: Um cristal com o poder do fogo. Seu brilho vermelho e intenso é amado por mulheres vivazes. Ele se forma em áreas onde o poder de Espíritos de Fogo é grande, tais como a Caverna das Chamas em Mistral, ou os Vulcões de St. Lamia. Sintetizá-los com uma Pedra do destino ou uma Pedra do paladino cria ferramentas de aprimoramento do fogo.
raw.th: คริสตัลที่มีอำนาจของ ไฟ รุนแรง ประกายไฟสีแดงเป็นที่รักของผู้หญิงร้อนแรง มันเกิดขึ้นในพื้นที่ที่มีพลังไฟวิญญาณสูง เช่นถ้ำเปลวไฟในมิสทราล หรือภูเขาไฟแห่งเซนต์ลาเมีย สังเคราะห์มันด้วยหินแห่งโชคชะตา หรือหินพาราดิน เพื่อเสริมพลังให้กับอุปกรณ์ธาตุไฟ
raw.vi: Một tinh thể với sức mạnh của lửa. Khả năng tóe lửa màu đỏ và với cường độ lớn thường được những người phụ nữ hăng hái, nồng nhiệt ưa chuộng. Nó được tạo thành ở những khu vực nơi mà sức mạnh của Tinh thần của lửa lên cao, ví dụ như Động Lửa ở Mistral, hoặc Khu vực núi lửa ở St. Lamia. Tổng hợp tinh thể này với Đá hủy diệt (Fate stone) hoặc đá Paladin sẽ tạo ra các công cụ làm tăng sức mạnh của lửa

id: Kristal dengan kekuatan air. Bersinar seperti kolam dan juga favorit dari wanita kelas atas. Terbentuk di daerah di mana kekuatan Roh Air tinggi, seperti Padang Salju Egor di Mistral, atau di gunung St. Lamia. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan air.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10601_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal with the power of water. It shines like a pond and is a favorite of high-class women. It forms where the Water Spirit's power is high, such as the Egor Snowfield in Mistral, or the St. Lamia mountains. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates water-enhancing tools.

raw.en: A crystal with the power of water. It shines like a pond and is a favorite of high-class women. It forms where the Water Spirit's power is high, such as the Egor Snowfield in Mistral, or the St. Lamia mountains. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates water-enhancing tools.
raw.es: Un cristal con el poder del agua, muchas mujeres de clase alta lo desean. Se encuentra en zonas donde el poder del espíritu acuático es elevado, como la meseta helada de Egor en Mistral o las montañas de Santa Lamia. Puede sintetizarse con una roca azarosa o noble para crear potenciadores de agua.
raw.id: Kristal dengan kekuatan air. Bersinar seperti kolam dan juga favorit dari wanita kelas atas. Terbentuk di daerah di mana kekuatan Roh Air tinggi, seperti Padang Salju Egor di Mistral, atau di gunung St. Lamia. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan air.
raw.pt: Um cristal com o poder da água. Ele brilha como um lago e é um favorito de mulheres da classe alta. Ele se forma em áreas onde o poder de Espíritos da Água é grande, tais como o Campo Negado de Egor em Mistral, ou nas montanhas de St. Lamia. Sintetizá-los com uma Pedra do destino ou uma Pedra do paladino cria ferramentas de aprimoramento de água.
raw.th: คริสตัลที่มีอำนาจของ น้ำ มันส่องประกายเหมือนสระน้ำ และเป็นที่ชื่นชอบของสตรีชั้นสูง เป็นรูปแบบที่ใช้พลังงานระดับสูงของวิญญาณน้ำ เช่นทุ่งหิมะอีกอร์ ในมิสทราล หรือภูเขาที่เซนต์ลาเมีย สังเคราะห์มันด้วยหินแห่งโชคชะตา หรือหินพาราดิน เพื่อเสริมพลังให้กับอุปกรณ์ธาตุน้ำ
raw.vi: Một tinh thể với sức mạnh của nước. Nó tỏa ra ánh sáng giống như một cái ao và đây là thứ yêu thích của một người phụ nữ thuộc tầng lớp cao trong xã hội. Nó được tạo thành ở những nơi mà sức mạnh của Tinh thần của nước được nêu cao, ví dụ như cánh đồng tuyết Egor ở Mistral, hoặc khu vực vùng núi St. Lamia. Tổng hợp tinh thể này với đá hủy diệt (Fate stone) và đá Paladin sẽ tạo ra các công cụ làm tăng sức mạnh của nước

id: Kristal dengan kekuatan bumi. Berwarna hijau zamrud dan menambah kebersihan pemakainya. Sering ditemukan dalam Hutan Monster di daerah Mistral, di mana kekuatan Roh Pohon tinggi. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan bumi.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10602_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal with the power of earth. It has a rich emerald color and enhances the cleanliness of its carrier. It's often found in the Forest of Beasts in the Mistral region, where the Tree Spirit's power is high. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates earth-enhancing tools.

raw.en: A crystal with the power of earth. It has a rich emerald color and enhances the cleanliness of its carrier. It's often found in the Forest of Beasts in the Mistral region, where the Tree Spirit's power is high. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates earth-enhancing tools.
raw.es: Cuenta con el poder de la tierra, tiene un vivo color esmeralda y mejora la pureza de su portador. Suele encontrarse en el bosque de las bestias en Mistral, donde el poder del espíritu arbóreo es elevado. Puede sintetizarse con una roca azarosa o noble para crear potenciadores de tierra.
raw.id: Kristal dengan kekuatan bumi. Berwarna hijau zamrud dan menambah kebersihan pemakainya. Sering ditemukan dalam Hutan Monster di daerah Mistral, di mana kekuatan Roh Pohon tinggi. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan bumi.
raw.pt: Um cristal com o poder da terra. Possui uma intensa cor esmeralda e dá uma aparência mais limpa a seu portador. Ele é geralmente encontrado na Floresta das Bestas na região de Mistral, onde o poder do Espírito da Terra é grande. Sintetizá-los com uma Pedra do destino ou uma Pedra do paladino cria ferramentas de aprimoramento da terra.
raw.th: คริสตัลที่มีอำนาจของ ดิน มีสีเขียวมรกตที่สามารถรักษาปัดเป่าให้กับผู้ที่ถือมันมักจะพบในป่าของสัตว์ร้าย ในเขตแดนมิสทราล ที่ซึ่งมีพลังของต้นไม้วิญญาณสูง สังเคราะห์มันด้วยหินแห่งโชคชะตา หรือหินพาราดิน เพื่อเสริมพลังให้กับอุปกรณ์ธาตุดิน
raw.vi: Một tinh thể với sức mạnh của đất. Đây là tinh thể có màu ngọc lục bảo đậm và làm tăng độ thuần khiết của những thứ nó mang theo. Loại tinh thể này thường được tìm thấy trong các khu rừng Beasts ở vùng Mistral, đây là nơi mà sức mạnh của Tinh thần của cây được nêu cao. Tổng hợp tinh thể này với đá hủy diệt (Fate stone) và đá Paladin sẽ tạo ra các công cụ làm tăng sức mạnh của đất

id: Kristal dengan kekuatan guntur. Kilauan emasnya membuat siapa pun yang melihatnya terkesima. Sering ditemukan di daerah yang sering dihantam petir di mana kekuatan Roh Guntur tinggi, seperti Rawa Magutagal. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan guntur.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10603_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal with the power of thunder. Its golden glow fascinates anyone who sees it. It's found in areas with frequent lightning strikes where the Thunder Spirit's power is high, such as the Magutagal Wetlands. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates thunder-enhancing tools.

raw.en: A crystal with the power of thunder. Its golden glow fascinates anyone who sees it. It's found in areas with frequent lightning strikes where the Thunder Spirit's power is high, such as the Magutagal Wetlands. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates thunder-enhancing tools.
raw.es: Este cristal con el poder del trueno tiene un brillo dorado fascinante. Se halla en zonas donde caen tormentas eléctricas en las que el poder del espíritu eléctrico es elevado, como el pantano de Magutagal. Puede sintetizarse con una roca azarosa o noble para crear pócimas de trueno.
raw.id: Kristal dengan kekuatan guntur. Kilauan emasnya membuat siapa pun yang melihatnya terkesima. Sering ditemukan di daerah yang sering dihantam petir di mana kekuatan Roh Guntur tinggi, seperti Rawa Magutagal. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan guntur.
raw.pt: Um cristal com o poder do trovão. Seu brilho dourado fascina qualquer um que o vê. Ele é encontrado em áreas com relâmpagos frequentes onde o poder do Espírito do Trovão é grande, como o Pântano Magutagal. Sintetizá-los com uma Pedra do destino ou uma Pedra do paladino cria ferramentas de aprimoramento do trovão.
raw.th: คริสตัลที่มีอำนาจของ สายฟ้าแสงสีทองของมันทำให้ทุกคนที่เห็นเกิดความลุ่มหลง มันถูกพบในพื้นที่ที่มีฟ้าผ่าบ่อย ที่ซึ่งมีพลังของสายฟ้าวิญญาณสูง เช่น พื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำ มากูทากัล สังเคราะห์มันด้วยหินแห่งโชคชะตา หรือหินพาราดิน เพื่อเสริมพลังให้กับอุปกรณ์ธาตุสายฟ้า
raw.vi: Một tinh thể với sức mạnh của sấm sét. Với ánh sáng rực rỡ màu vàng chói lọi, tinh thể này thu hút bất kỳ ai nhìn thấy nó. Nó được tìm thấy tại những khu vực thường xuyên bị sét đánh hay nói cách khác chính là nơi mà sức mạnh của Tinh thần của sấm sét được tích tụ nhiều, ví dụ như ở vùng Magutagal Wetlands. Tổng hợp tinh thể này với đá hủy diệt (Fate stone) và đá Paladin sẽ tạo ra các công cụ làm tăng sức mạnh của sấm sét

id: Kristal dengan kekuatan terang. Biasanya jernih, sinar matahari membuatnya berkilau. Sangat langka, dan hanya dihasilkan di daerah suci St. Lamia di mana kekuatan Roh Terang tinggi. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan terang.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10604_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal with the power of light. Normally clear, the sun's light makes it sparkle. It's extremely rare, and is only produced in the sacred regions of St. Lamia where the Light Spirit's power is strong. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates light-enhancing tools.

raw.en: A crystal with the power of light. Normally clear, the sun's light makes it sparkle. It's extremely rare, and is only produced in the sacred regions of St. Lamia where the Light Spirit's power is strong. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates light-enhancing tools.
raw.es: Esta roca con el poder de la luz suele ser clara y brilla con el sol. Es muy poco habitual y solo se forma en las regiones sagradas de Santa Lamia donde el poder del espíritu de la luz es elevado. Puede sintetizarse con una roca azarosa o noble para crear potenciadores de luz.
raw.id: Kristal dengan kekuatan terang. Biasanya jernih, sinar matahari membuatnya berkilau. Sangat langka, dan hanya dihasilkan di daerah suci St. Lamia di mana kekuatan Roh Terang tinggi. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan terang.
raw.pt: Um cristal com o poder da luz. Geralmente transparente, a luz do sol faz com que ele brilhe. É extremamente raro, e só é produzido nas regiões sagradas de St. Lamia onde o poder do Espírito da Luz é forte. Sintetizá-los com uma Pedra do destino ou uma Pedra do paladino cria ferramentas de aprimoramento da luz.
raw.th: คริสตัลที่มีอำนาจของ แสง โดยปกติแล้วแสงของดวงอาทิตย์จะทำให้เกิดประกายไฟ มันหายากมากและมีการผลิตเฉพาะในเขตแดนศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของนักบวชของเซนต์ลาเมีย ที่มีพลังงานแสงวิญญาณแข็งแกร่ง สังเคราะห์มันด้วยหินแห่งโชคชะตา หรือหินพาราดิน เพื่อเสริมพลังให้กับอุปกรณ์ธาตุแสง
raw.vi: Một tinh thể với sức mạnh của ánh sáng. Thông thường ánh nắng mặt trời sẽ làm chúng lóe sáng. Loại tinh thể này vô cùng hiếm, và chỉ có tại những vùng đất thánh ở St. Lamia nơi được coi là Tinh thần của ánh sáng hội tụ nhiều nhất. Tổng hợp tinh thể này với đá hủy diệt (Fate stone) và đá Paladin sẽ tạo ra các công cụ làm tăng sức mạnh của ánh sáng

id: Kristal dengan kekuatan gelap, satu dari enam elemen yang membentuk dunia. Sinar redupnya hanya pernah disaksikan di gua-gua di daerah St. Lamia dari Gaia Besar. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan gelap.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10605_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal with the power of dark, one of the six elements that composes the world. Its dim glow has only been witnessed in the caves in the St. Lamia region of Grand Gaia. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates dark-enhancing tools.

raw.en: A crystal with the power of dark, one of the six elements that composes the world. Its dim glow has only been witnessed in the caves in the St. Lamia region of Grand Gaia. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates dark-enhancing tools.
raw.es: Este cristal con el poder de la oscuridad es uno de los seis elementos que componen el mundo. Su tenue brillo solo se ha visto en las cuevas de Santa Lamia, en Gran Gaia. Puede sintetizarse con una roca azarosa o noble para crear potenciadores de oscuridad.
raw.id: Kristal dengan kekuatan gelap, satu dari enam elemen yang membentuk dunia. Sinar redupnya hanya pernah disaksikan di gua-gua di daerah St. Lamia dari Gaia Besar. Menyintesis dengan Batu Takdir atau Batu Paladin membuat alat yang memberi kekuatan gelap.
raw.pt: Um cristal com o poder da sombra, um dos seis elementos que compõem o mundo. Seu brilho sombrio só foi avistado nas cavernas da região de St. Lamia em Grand Gaia. Sintetizá-los com uma Pedra do destino ou uma Pedra do paladino cria ferramentas de aprimoramento da sombra.
raw.th: คริสตัลที่มีอำนาจของ ความืด ซึ่งเป็นหนึ่งในหกองค์ประกอบที่ประกอบของโลก มันเรืองแสงสลัวและมีผู้พบเห็นในถ้ำที่เขตแดนเซนต์ลาเมีย ของแกรนด์ไกอาเท่านั้นสังเคราะห์มันด้วยหินแห่งโชคชะตา หรือหินพาราดิน เพื่อเสริมพลังให้กับอุปกรณ์ธาตุมืด
raw.vi: Một tinh thể với sức mạnh của bóng đêm, một trong só sáu nhân tố cấu thành nên thế giới. Với ánh sáng mờ mịt không nhìn rõ chúng chỉ được phát hiện tại các hang động ở vùng St. Lamia của Grand Gaia. Tổng hợp tinh thể này với đá hủy diệt (Fate stone) và đá Paladin sẽ tạo ra các công cụ làm tăng sức mạnh của bóng đêm

id: Kristal aneh yang berkilau berdasarkan energi spiritual pemegangnya. Dinamakan dari dewa perang yang terkenal akurat dalam mengantisipasi kemampuan lawannya. Langka di Elgaia dan Gaia Besar, tapi ada gosip bahwa para pendeta yang bersembunyi di tanah suci St. Lamia mungkin mempunyainya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10606_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This strange crystal sparkles based on the spiritual energy of its holder. It was named a war god famous for accurately anticipating his opponent's abilities. It's rare in both Elgaia and Grand Gaia, but there are rumors that the priest hiding in St. Lamia's sacred grounds may be hiding some.

raw.en: This strange crystal sparkles based on the spiritual energy of its holder. It was named a war god famous for accurately anticipating his opponent's abilities. It's rare in both Elgaia and Grand Gaia, but there are rumors that the priest hiding in St. Lamia's sacred grounds may be hiding some.
raw.es: Este cristal tan raro brilla en función de la energía espiritual de su portador. Lleva el nombre de un dios de la guerra conocido por anticipar las habilidades de sus adversarios. Es muy escaso en Elgaia y Gran Gaia, pero dicen que un sacerdote oculto en las tierras de Santa Lamia puede guardar alguno.
raw.id: Kristal aneh yang berkilau berdasarkan energi spiritual pemegangnya. Dinamakan dari dewa perang yang terkenal akurat dalam mengantisipasi kemampuan lawannya. Langka di Elgaia dan Gaia Besar, tapi ada gosip bahwa para pendeta yang bersembunyi di tanah suci St. Lamia mungkin mempunyainya.
raw.pt: Esse cristal estranho brilha conforme a energia espiritual do portador. Ele recebeu seu nome de um deus da guerra famoso por antecipar com precisão as habilidades de seus inimigos. É raro tanto em Elgaia quanto Grand Gaia, mas boatos dizem que o sacerdote que se esconde em St. Lamia pode estar escondendo alguns.
raw.th: คริสตัลแปลกอันนี้ เปล่งประกายแสงจากพลังวิญญาณของผู้ที่ถือมันอยู่ มันถูกตั้งชื่อของเทพเจ้าสงครามที่มีชื่อเสียงจากประเมินความสามารถของศัตรูได้อย่างแม่นยำ  มันหายากทั้งในเอลไกอา และแกรนด์ไกอา แต่มีข่าวลือว่านักบวชซ่อนบางส่วนเอาไว้อยู่ในบริเวณพื้นที่ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของเซนต์ลาเมีย
raw.vi: Tinh thể kỳ lạ này phát sáng dựa vào năng lượng tinh thần của người sở hữu chúng. Nó được đặt theo tên của một vị thần chiến tranh nổi tiếng, người đã dự đoán vô cùng chính xác năng lực của đối phương. Rất khó có thể tìm thấy loại tinh thể này ở cả Elgaia và Grand Gaia, nhưng lại có nhiều tin đồn cho rằng các thầy tu đang cất giấu một số ít những tinh thể này ở vùng đất thánh tại St. Lamia

id: Kristal misterius yang sangat langka di Gaia Besar. Bersinar dengan warna keemasan. Keberadaannya dituliskan di buku-buku kuno, tapi efek dan kegunaannya adalah sebuah misteri. Orang yang beruntung menemukannya tidak tahu apa kegunaannya, meskipun jelas mempunyai kekuatan magis. Kristal ini masih merupakan subyek riset.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10607_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This mysterious crystal is extremely rare in Grand Gaia. It radiates a golden light. Its existence is recorded in ancient books, but its effects and uses are a mystery. Those lucky enough to find one have no idea what to do with it, despite it clearly holding magical power. These crystals are the subject of continuous research.

raw.en: This mysterious crystal is extremely rare in Grand Gaia. It radiates a golden light. Its existence is recorded in ancient books, but its effects and uses are a mystery. Those lucky enough to find one have no idea what to do with it, despite it clearly holding magical power. These crystals are the subject of continuous research.
raw.es: Este cristal, escaso en Gran Gaia, irradia una luz dorada. Se habla de él en libros muy antiguos, pero sus usos y efectos son un misterio. Quienes tienen la suerte de encontrar uno, no saben qué hacer con él pese a sus evidentes cualidades mágicas. Por ello, están sometidos a constante investigación.
raw.id: Kristal misterius yang sangat langka di Gaia Besar. Bersinar dengan warna keemasan. Keberadaannya dituliskan di buku-buku kuno, tapi efek dan kegunaannya adalah sebuah misteri. Orang yang beruntung menemukannya tidak tahu apa kegunaannya, meskipun jelas mempunyai kekuatan magis. Kristal ini masih merupakan subyek riset.
raw.pt: Esse cristal misterioso é extremamente raro em Grand Gaia. Ele irradia uma luz dourada. Sua existência foi registrada em livros antigos, mas seus efeitos e usos são um mistério. Aqueles que têm sorte o suficiente de encontrá-lo não sabem o que fazer com ele, apesar de seu óbvio potencial mágico. Esses cristais são alvo de pesquisas contínuas.
raw.th: คริสตัลลึกลับชิ้นนี้ เป็นของหายากมากในแกรนด์ไกอา มันส่องประกายแสงสีทองอล่าม มันถูกบันทึกไว้ในหนังสือโบราณถึงการมีอยู่ แต่ผลและการใช้งานยังเป็นเรื่องลึกลับ ผู้ที่โชคดีที่ได้พบก็ยังไม่รู้ว่าจะทำเช่นไรกับมัน แน่นอนว่ามันมีพลังเวทมนตร์  ซึ่งคริสตัลเหล่านี้ทำให้มีการวิจัยค้นคว้าอย่างต่อเนื่อง
raw.vi: Tinh thể kỳ bí này thực sự vô cùng hiếm ở Grand Gaia. Nó có khả năng phát xạ ra ra một thứ ánh sáng màu vàng. Sự tồn tại của loại tinh thể này đã được ghi chép lại trong các cuốn sách cổ, nhưng ảnh hưởng và cách sử dụng nó vẫn còn là một bí ẩn. Có thể may mắn tìm được một tinh thể này nhưng điều đó không đồng nghĩa với việc bạn có thể làm gì với nó mặc dù bạn biết rõ ràng rằng nó chứa đựng một sức mạnh thần bí. Những tinh thể này vẫn đang tiếp tục được nghiên cứu

id: Kristal berkilau emas yang misterius sangat jarang ditemukan di Gaia Besar. Meskipun disebutkan di catatan kuno, kegunaannya tetap misterius, dan siapapun yang pernah menemukannya tidak tahu cara pemakaiannya. Tapi, tetap saja sangat dicari, dan banyak sarjana yang meriset bagaimana cara memakainya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10608_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A mysterious, gold-glowing crystal found only rarely in Grand Gaia. Though mentioned in ancient records, their purpose remains shrouded in mystery, and anyone lucky enough to discover one is said to have been stumped as to what to do with it. Nevertheless, they remain highly-sought after, and many scholars continue to research ways to use them.

raw.en: A mysterious, gold-glowing crystal found only rarely in Grand Gaia. Though mentioned in ancient records, their purpose remains shrouded in mystery, and anyone lucky enough to discover one is said to have been stumped as to what to do with it. Nevertheless, they remain highly-sought after, and many scholars continue to research ways to use them.
raw.es: Misterioso cristal dorado que escasea en Gran Gaia. Aunque se menciona en escritos antiguos, su propósito se desconoce y todo aquel que ha tenido la suerte de encontrar uno no ha sabido que uso darle. Aun así, siguen siendo muy buscados y muchos estudiosos siguen investigando sus posibles usos.
raw.id: Kristal berkilau emas yang misterius sangat jarang ditemukan di Gaia Besar. Meskipun disebutkan di catatan kuno, kegunaannya tetap misterius, dan siapapun yang pernah menemukannya tidak tahu cara pemakaiannya. Tapi, tetap saja sangat dicari, dan banyak sarjana yang meriset bagaimana cara memakainya.
raw.pt: Um cristal misterioso com brilho dourado raramente encontrado em Grand Gaia. Embora tenha sido mencionado em registros antigos, o propósito dele ainda é um mistério e dizem que, quem tiver sorte para encontrar um, vai ficar confuso com o que fazer com ele. Mesmo assim, ele continua com alta demanda e muitos estudiosos continuam pesquisando formas de usá-lo.
raw.th: คริสตัลส่องประกายแสงสีทองลึกลับ มันหาได้ยากและพบเฉพาะในแกรนด์ไกอาเท่านั้น แต่ที่กล่าวถึงในบันทึกโบราณ การใช้ของมันก็ยังเต็มไปด้วยความลึกลับ และใครก็ตามที่โชคดีได้พบมัน ต่างมึนงงเพราะไม่รู้จะทำเช่นไรกับมัน อย่างไรก็ตาม พวกมันก็ยังคงถูกตามหาอยู่ และพวกนักปราชญ์ก็ยังพยายามค้นคว้าหาวิธีใช้มันต่อไป
raw.vi: Những tinh thể thần bí có khả năng phát ra ánh sáng vàng chỉ được tìm thấy tại một số ít nơi thuộc Grand Gaia. Mặc dù đã được ghi chép lại trong các cuốn sách cổ, nhưng mục đích sử dụng những tinh thể này như thế nào thì vẫn còn là một bí mật, và bất kỳ ai may mắn phát hiện được một tinh thể này thì cũng không đồng nghĩa với việc họ biết sẽ phải làm gì với nó. Tuy nhiên, sau đó việc tìm kiếm các tinh thể này vẫn tiếp tục được tiến hành với tần xuất lớn, và nhiều nhà nghiên cứu vẫn tiếp tục nghiên cứu cách thức để sử dụng các tinh thể này

id: Dari jauh nampaknya perak, jika didekati bisa dilihat cahaya menari dalam kristal bening ini. Katanya sihir di dalamnya berubah menjadi butiran yang memantul bersuara seperti pasir saat dikocok. Riset untuk penggunaan sihirnya sedang dilakukan, tapi susah dipakai dan hanya sedikit yang sukses.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10609_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: From far away it appears silver, but upon closer look one can see a ray of light dancing inside this translucent crystal. It's said that the magic it holds turns into tiny reflective grains that make a sandy sound when shaken. Research on ways to use its magic is ongoing, but it is difficult to use and there are few successful attempts.

raw.en: From far away it appears silver, but upon closer look one can see a ray of light dancing inside this translucent crystal. It's said that the magic it holds turns into tiny reflective grains that make a sandy sound when shaken. Research on ways to use its magic is ongoing, but it is difficult to use and there are few successful attempts.
raw.es: Desde la lejanía parece plata, pero al observarlo de cerca puede verse un rayo de luz ondeando dentro del cristal translúcido. Dicen que la magia que contiene se convierte en pequeños gránulos que producen un sonido arenoso al agitarlos. Siguen las investigaciones sobre las formas de usar su magia, pero es difícil usarla y son pocos los intentos exitosos.
raw.id: Dari jauh nampaknya perak, jika didekati bisa dilihat cahaya menari dalam kristal bening ini. Katanya sihir di dalamnya berubah menjadi butiran yang memantul bersuara seperti pasir saat dikocok. Riset untuk penggunaan sihirnya sedang dilakukan, tapi susah dipakai dan hanya sedikit yang sukses.
raw.pt: De longe parece prateado, mas olhando de perto é possível ver um raio de luz dançando dentro deste cristal translúcido. Dizem que a magia que ele possui se transforma em partículas refletivas que fazem um som de areia quando chacoalhadas. Pesquisas sobre formas de usar a magia dele continuam sendo realizadas, mas continua sendo difícil de usar e são poucas as tentativas que funcionam.
raw.th: มันดูเป็นสีเงินเมื่อมองจากที่ไกลๆ แต่เมื่อลองเข้าไปมองใกล้ๆ จะสามารถมองเห็นลำแสงเต้นรำภายในคริสตัลโปร่งแสงนี้ ว่ากันว่าเพราะเวทมนตร์ที่มันมีอยู่เปลี่ยนเป็นเมล็ดเล็ก ๆ ที่สะท้อนแสงที่ทำให้เสียงเหมือนทรายเมื่อเขย่า การค้นคว้าการนำพลังเวทย์ของมันมาใช้ยังดำเนินต่อไป แต่มันใช้งานได้ยากและน้อยคนนักที่จะพยายามจนประสบความสำเร็จ
raw.vi: Nhìn từ xa nó có ánh bạc, như khi lại gần có thể thấy một tia sáng nhảy múa bên trong tinh thể trong suốt này. Người ta nói rằng phép thuật của nó biến thành những hạt nhỏ phản chiếu tạo nên âm thanh lạo xạo khi bị lung lay. Nghiên cứu về cách sử dụng phép thuật của nó vẫn đang tiến hành, nhưng rất khó sử dụng và cũng rất ít nỗ lực thành công.

id: Kristal berkilau ditemukan sporadik di Gaia Besar. Sinar samarnya tidak cukup kuat untuk menerangi kegelapan, tapi mengeluarkan sihir bergelombang unik bersama sinarnya. Namanya diperoleh karena Pemanggil dapat mendeteksi kekuatannya dari jauh. Bagi orang biasa, adalah batu yang cantik, bagi Pembunuh Setan, ini adalah bahan berharga.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10610_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A glowing crystal found sporadically across Grand Gaia. Its faint glow isn't strong enough to light up the darkness, but it does emit magic of a unique wavelength together with the light it does produce. It got its name from the fact that Summoners could detect its power from quite a distance. To common people it is but a beautiful stone, but to the Demon Slayers it is a valued material.

raw.en: A glowing crystal found sporadically across Grand Gaia. Its faint glow isn't strong enough to light up the darkness, but it does emit magic of a unique wavelength together with the light it does produce. It got its name from the fact that Summoners could detect its power from quite a distance. To common people it is but a beautiful stone, but to the Demon Slayers it is a valued material.
raw.es: Un cristal brillante hallado esporádicamente en Gran Gaia. Su leve resplandor no es lo suficientemente fuerte para iluminar la oscuridad, pero sí emite magia de una longitud de onda única junto con la luz que produce. Su nombre se debe a que los invocadores pueden detectar su poder desde muy lejos. Puede que para la gente común sea una piedra preciosa, pero para los Exterminadores de demonios es un valioso material.
raw.id: Kristal berkilau ditemukan sporadik di Gaia Besar. Sinar samarnya tidak cukup kuat untuk menerangi kegelapan, tapi mengeluarkan sihir bergelombang unik bersama sinarnya. Namanya diperoleh karena Pemanggil dapat mendeteksi kekuatannya dari jauh. Bagi orang biasa, adalah batu yang cantik, bagi Pembunuh Setan, ini adalah bahan berharga.
raw.pt: Um cristal brilhante encontrado por todo lado em Grand Gaia. Seu brilho tênue não é o suficiente para iluminar a escuridão, mas emite magia de uma frequência única junto da luz que produz. Recebeu o nome do fato de que os Invocadores podem detectar seu poder à distância. Para pessoas comuns não é nada além de uma pedra bonita.
raw.th: คริสตัลเรื่องแสงที่พบปะปรายในแกรนด์ไกอา แสงจางๆ ของมันสว่างมากพอที่จะส่องในความมืด แต่มันก็ปล่อยพลังเวทย์ซึ่งมีความยาวคลื่นที่ไม่ซ้ำกันพร้อมกับแสงที่มันผลิต มันได้ชื่อของมันจากข้อเท็จจริงที่ว่าซัมมอนเนอร์สามารถตรวจจับพลังของมันได้จากระยะไกล สำหรับคนทั่วไปมันเป็นแค่หินที่สวยงาม แต่สำหรับนักล่าปีศาจมันเป็นวัตถุดิบที่มีคุณค่ามาก
raw.vi: Một viên pha lê phát sáng được tìm thấy rải rác trên khắp Grand Gaia. Ánh sáng yếu ớt của nó không đủ mạnh để thắp sáng bóng đêm, nhưng nó phát ra phép thuật có bước sóng vô song cùng với ánh sáng nó tạo ra. Nó có tên như vậy từ thực tế là Người triệu hồi có thể phát hiện sức mạnh của nó từ một khoảng cách khá xa. Đối với người bình thường nó chỉ là một hòn đá đẹp, nhưng với Sát thủ diệt ma, nó là vật liệu có giá trị.

id: Zaman dahulu, perang berskala besar terjadi di Agni. Kristal ini bisa ditemukan di puing medan perang kuno. Ada yang percaya itu hanya bijih, tapi para sarjana membantahnya dengan mengklaim itu tidak terjadi secara normal di alam. Legenda berkata, tentara Agni pemnerani yang jatuh ke tanah meninggalkan rasa haus darahnya, gerutu mereka mengkristal menjadi zat hitam.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10611_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Long ago, wars of a large scale took place in the region of Agni, where the ancient Agni Empire once stood. This crystal can be found in the ruins of those ancient battlegrounds. There are those who simply believe it to be an ore, but scholars refute this by claiming that it does not normally occur in nature. According to legend, the fearless Agni soldiers that fell on those grounds left their taste for blood behind, which then caused their grudge to crystalize into a black substance.

raw.en: Long ago, wars of a large scale took place in the region of Agni, where the ancient Agni Empire once stood. This crystal can be found in the ruins of those ancient battlegrounds. There are those who simply believe it to be an ore, but scholars refute this by claiming that it does not normally occur in nature. According to legend, the fearless Agni soldiers that fell on those grounds left their taste for blood behind, which then caused their grudge to crystalize into a black substance.
raw.es: Hace mucho tiempo, guerras de gran escala se libraban en la región de Agní, donde alguna vez se erigió el antiguo imperio que lleva el mismo nombre. Este cristal puede hallarse en las ruinas de esos antiguos campos de batalla. Hay quien simplemente piensa que se tratan de una mena, pero los eruditos refutan esta teoría asegurando que estos cristales no son obra de la naturaleza. De acuerdo a las leyendas, los temerarios soldados de Agní que cayeron en esos campos de batalla dejaron su sed de sangre consigo, y su rencor se cristalizó en esta sustancia negra.
raw.id: Zaman dahulu, perang berskala besar terjadi di Agni. Kristal ini bisa ditemukan di puing medan perang kuno. Ada yang percaya itu hanya bijih, tapi para sarjana membantahnya dengan mengklaim itu tidak terjadi secara normal di alam. Legenda berkata, tentara Agni pemnerani yang jatuh ke tanah meninggalkan rasa haus darahnya, gerutu mereka mengkristal menjadi zat hitam.
raw.pt: Há muito tempo, guerras de grande escala aconteceram na região de Agni, onde ficava o antigo Império de Agni. Esse cristal pode ser encontrado nas ruínas desses campos de batalha. Há quem acredite que seja somente uma pedra, mas estudiosos refutam essa ideia dizendo que ele não aparece naturalmente. De acordo com a lenda, os destemidos soldados de Agni que caíram nesses campos deixaram o gosto por sangue para trás, o que fez com que o rancor se cristalizasse e virasse uma substância enegrecida.
raw.th: นานมาแล้ว สงครามขนาดใหญ่ได้เกิดขึ้นในแคว้นแอ็กนี่ ที่ซึ่งครั้งหนึ่งจักรวรรดิแอ็กนี่เคยยืนหยัดอยู่ คริสตัลนี้สามารถพบเจอได้ในซากโบราณที่เป็นสนาบรบเก่าๆ นั้น มีพวกคนที่เชื่อว่ามันเป็นแร่ธาตุ แต่นักวิชาการปฏิเสธโดยอ้างว่ามันไม่เกิดขึ้นในธรรมชาติตามปกติ  ตามที่ตำนานกล่าวไว้ว่า ทหารแอ็กนี่ซึ่งปราศจากความกลัวที่ตายในสนามรบเหล่านั้นจะทิ้งความกระหายเลือดไว้เบื้องหลัง ซึ่งจะเปลี่ยนความแค้นให้ตกผลึกจนกลายเป็นวัตถุสีดำ
raw.vi: Nhiều năm về trước, các cuộc chiến diễn ra trên phạm vi rộng thuộc xứ Agni, tại đó Đế chế Agni vẫn còn đứng vững. Viên pha lê có thể được tìm thấy trong các đống đổ nát trên những chiến trường cổ đại này. Có người tin rằng đó đơn giản là một loại quặng nhưng các học giả đã bác bỏ bằng việc tuyên bố rằng thứ này không thường xuất hiện trong tự nhiên.  Theo truyền thuyết, những người lính Agni can đảm đã ngã xuống trên chiến trường, để lại máu của mình phía sau, từ đó đã khiến mối căm thù của họ kết tụ tinh thần lại thành một loại chất màu đen.

id: Beberapa laporan berkata Marian adalah istri dewa berpangkat tinggi yang simpati dengan manusia sampai akhir. Ia tidak sampai melawan penghancuran, namun ia mengagumi keahlian tempurnya, ketahanannya, berusaha setiap ada kesempatan untuk menyerang balik. Marah pada sikap santai suaminya, ia mengubah tubuh indahnya untuk menghidupkan kemarahan di dalamnya, berharap bisa bertempur.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10612_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Some reports state the Marian was the wife of a high ranking god that was sympathetic towards humans until the very end. He didn't go as far as to oppose their destruction, but he admired their combat skills, especially their perseverance, taking every opportunity available to strike back. Furious at her husband's easygoing demeanor, she transformed her beautiful body in order to revive the rage within, hoping for a fight.

raw.en: Some reports state the Marian was the wife of a high ranking god that was sympathetic towards humans until the very end. He didn't go as far as to oppose their destruction, but he admired their combat skills, especially their perseverance, taking every opportunity available to strike back. Furious at her husband's easygoing demeanor, she transformed her beautiful body in order to revive the rage within, hoping for a fight.
raw.es: Algunos informes manifiestan que Marian era la esposa de un dios de alto rango que sintió empatía con los humanos hasta su muerte. No llegó a oponerse a su destrucción, pero admiraba sus habilidades de combate, especialmente su perseverancia y esa manía de aprovechar cualquier oportunidad para contraatacar. Marian, en busca de una pelea y furiosa por el comportamiento de su esposo, transformó todo su cuerpo para poder revivir la furia que llevaba dentro.
raw.id: Beberapa laporan berkata Marian adalah istri dewa berpangkat tinggi yang simpati dengan manusia sampai akhir. Ia tidak sampai melawan penghancuran, namun ia mengagumi keahlian tempurnya, ketahanannya, berusaha setiap ada kesempatan untuk menyerang balik. Marah pada sikap santai suaminya, ia mengubah tubuh indahnya untuk menghidupkan kemarahan di dalamnya, berharap bisa bertempur.
raw.pt: Alguns relatos dizem que Marian foi a esposa de um deus de alto escalão, que foi simpática aos humanos até o último momento. Ele não acabaria indo tão longe a ponto de sugerir a sua destruição, mas ele admirava suas habilidades em combate, especialmente , tomando cada oportunidade disponível para contra-atacar. Furiosa com seu marido calmo, ela transformou seu belo corpo para reviver a ira neste, esperando por uma luta.
raw.th: บางรายงานเขียนไว้ว่า มาเรี่ยน เป็นภรรยาของเทพเจ้าระดับสูงที่มีความเห็นอกเห็นใจมนุษย์จวบจนวาระสุดท้าย เขาไม่ได้สู้จนถึงขั้นต่อต้านการทำลายล้างของพวกนั้น แต่เขาก็ยังชื่นชมทักษะการต่อสู้ของพวกนั้น โดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งความขยันหมั่นเพียรของพวกมนุษย์ ที่จะใช้ทุกโอกาสที่มีเพื่อจู่โจมกลับ ด้วยความโกรธต่อท่าทางสบายๆ ของสามีของเธอ เธอเปลี่ยนร่างที่สวยงามของเธอเพื่อที่จะชุบชีวิตความโกรธภายใน โดยหวังให้มีการต่อสู้
raw.vi: Một số báo cáo nêu rõ Marian là vợ của một vị thần có thứ hạng cao đã đứng về phía con người cho đến tận cùng. Anh đã không đi xa đến mức chống lại sự hủy diệt của họ, trái lại anh ngưỡng mộ kỹ năng chiến đấu của họ, đặc biệt là sự kiên trì của họ, tận dụng mọi cơ hội có được để phản công. Tức giận trước thái độ dễ dãi của chồng, cô đã biến đổi cơ thể xinh đẹp của mình để khơi dậy cơn giận dữ trong đó, hy vọng có được khả năng chiến đấu.

id: Setan Marian biasanya bertindak sendirian. Aslinya, ia tidak bergaul dengan siapa pun kecuali suaminya, namun ia tidak menunjukkan kepribadian ini saat bertarung dengan manusia. Ia tidak peduli bertarung dengan Dewa Sesat lain dan menghabiskan waktunya membuka gerbang belakang untuk memburu manusia. Jika setan Marian kembali cantik seperti dulu, akankah ia berkunjung?
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10613_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The demon Marian usually acts alone. Originally, she didn't mingle with anyone besides her husband, but she showed no hints of her reclusive personality when fighting humans. She doesn't care for fighting other Fallen Gods, and spends her days opening the back gates in order to hunt humans. Will he come visit when the demon Marian returns to her beautiful, old self...?

raw.en: The demon Marian usually acts alone. Originally, she didn't mingle with anyone besides her husband, but she showed no hints of her reclusive personality when fighting humans. She doesn't care for fighting other Fallen Gods, and spends her days opening the back gates in order to hunt humans. Will he come visit when the demon Marian returns to her beautiful, old self...?
raw.es: La demonio Marian generalmente actúa sola. Originalmente no se relacionaba con nadie más que no fuera su marido, si bien no daba señales de su personalidad solitaria cuando peleaba contra los humanos. No le interesa pelear contra otros Dioses caídos, y pasa sus días abriendo las puertas traseras para poder cazar humanos. ¿Vendrá de visita cuando la demonio Marian regrese a su antigua y bella forma...?
raw.id: Setan Marian biasanya bertindak sendirian. Aslinya, ia tidak bergaul dengan siapa pun kecuali suaminya, namun ia tidak menunjukkan kepribadian ini saat bertarung dengan manusia. Ia tidak peduli bertarung dengan Dewa Sesat lain dan menghabiskan waktunya membuka gerbang belakang untuk memburu manusia. Jika setan Marian kembali cantik seperti dulu, akankah ia berkunjung?
raw.pt: Aquela demônio Marian geralmente age sozinha. Originalmente, ela não se misturava com ninguém além do marido, mas não mostrou traços de uma personalidade reclusa quando lutando contra humanos. Ela não dá a mínima para lutar contra outros Deuses Caídos, e passa seus dias abrindo os portões do fundo para caçar humanos. Será que ele vem visitar quando a demônio Marian retornar à sua bela forma anterior...?
raw.th: ปีศาจมาเรี่ยนปรกติจะทำการเพียงลำพัง เดิมที่เธอจะไม่ยุ่งกับใครนอกจากสามีของเธอ แต่เธอไม่เคยแสดงให้เห็นนิสัยสันโดษของตนเมื่อต่อสู้กับมนุษย์ เธอไม่สนใจที่จะสู้กับเทพมารอื่นๆ และใช้เวลาของเธอด้วยการเปิดประตูหลังเพื่อไล่ล่ามนุษย์ เขาจะกลับมาเยี่ยมไหมเมื่อปีศาจมาเรี่ยนกลับไปสู่ตัวตนเมที่สวยงามของเธอ...?
raw.vi: Con quỷ Marian luôn hành động một mình. Ban đầu, cô không hòa nhập với bất cứ ai ngoài chồng cô, nhưng cô không cho thấy chút tính cách ẩn dật nào khi chiến đấu với con người. Cô không quan tâm đến việc chiến đấu với các Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần khác và dành thời gian để mở những cánh cổng sau nhằm săn đuổi con người. Liệu anh có đến thăm khi con quỷ Marian trở lại là chính cô xinh đẹp, trước đây không...?

id: Setan Reduhark memanen jiwa semua manusia yang mengunjungi Gaia Besar. Berdasarkan pengamatan, sejak Empat Dewa Sesat tidak membentuk grup, ia bertindak sesukanya. Ia tidak membenci manusia seperti dewa lain. Meski ia kuat, ia memperlakukan manusia seperti membunuh lalat yang mengganggu.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10614_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The demon Reduhark reaps the souls of all humans that visit Grand Gaia. Based on current observations, since the Four Fallen Gods have not formed a group of any kind, it would seem that he is acting on his own judgment. However, he doesn't share the same hatred towards humans that other gods do. Though he is indeed strong, he treats humans the same way one would exterminate an annoying fly.

raw.en: The demon Reduhark reaps the souls of all humans that visit Grand Gaia. Based on current observations, since the Four Fallen Gods have not formed a group of any kind, it would seem that he is acting on his own judgment. However, he doesn't share the same hatred towards humans that other gods do. Though he is indeed strong, he treats humans the same way one would exterminate an annoying fly.
raw.es: El demonio Reduhark cosecha las almas de todos los humanos que visitan Gran Gaia. Según las observaciones actuales, dado que los cuatro Dioses caídos no han formado un grupo de ningún tipo, parece ser que Reduhark está actuando por motu proprio. Sin embargo, él no odia a los humanos de la misma manera que los demás dioses. Si bien es muy poderoso, se deshace de los humanos de la misma forma en que alguien podría matar a una mosca molesta.
raw.id: Setan Reduhark memanen jiwa semua manusia yang mengunjungi Gaia Besar. Berdasarkan pengamatan, sejak Empat Dewa Sesat tidak membentuk grup, ia bertindak sesukanya. Ia tidak membenci manusia seperti dewa lain. Meski ia kuat, ia memperlakukan manusia seperti membunuh lalat yang mengganggu.
raw.pt: O demônio Reduhark colhe a alma dos humanos que visitam Grand Gaia. Com base nas observações atuais, como os Quatro Deuses Caídos não formaram nenhum tipo de grupo, parece que ele está agindo por conta própria. Porém, ele não compartilha o mesmo ódio dos humanos com outros deuses. Apesar de ser mesmo forte, ele trata humanos da mesma forma que se extermina uma mosca irritante.
raw.th: ปีศาจเรดูฮาร์คเด็ดวิญญาณของมนุษย์ทุกคนที่มาเยือนแกรนด์ไกอา ตามข้อสังเกตในปัจจุบัน ตั้งแต่จตุรเทพมารไม่ได้จัดตั้งกลุ่มใดๆ ขึ้นมา มันจึงดูเหมือนว่าเขาทำสิ่งต่างๆ ตามที่ตนเองตัดสินใจ อย่างไรก็ตาม เขาก็ไม่ได้มีความเกลียดชังในตัวมนุษย์เช่นเดียวกับเทพเจ้าอื่นๆ แม้ว่าเขาจะแข็งแกร่ง เขาก็ปฏิบัติกับมนุษย์ไม่ต่างจากการทำลายแมลงน่ารำคาญ
raw.vi: Con quỷ Reduhark thu linh hồn của tất cả con người đến Grand Gaia. Dựa trên những quan sát gần đây, kể từ khi Bốn Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần không tạo thành bất cứ nhóm nào, thì dường như anh đang hành động theo sự phán đoán của chính mình. Tuy nhiên, anh không có chung sự thù hận đối với con người như các vị thần khác. Mặc dù anh quả thực có sức mạnh, nhưng anh đối xử với con người giống như cách người ta sẽ tiêu diệt một con ruồi gây phiền nhiễu.

id: Sumber suhu tinggi yang tidak biasa dari naga berbaju api adalah jantungnya yang memompa darah dengan suhu setinggi lava. Anehnya, saat jantung ini diekspos ke udara, akan mengeras seperti kristal dan berhenti bergerak. Meski berhenti berdetak, panas misteriusnya masih tak terpecahkan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10615_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The source to the fire clad dragon's unusually high temperature is said to be its heart. The heart pumps blood at an extremely high temperature, which then travels all around the body with a temperature as high as lava. Strangely, when this heart is exposed to air, it hardens into something resembling a crystal, and stops moving. Though the heart may stop beating, the mysterious heat that emanates from it is still unfathomable.

raw.en: The source to the fire clad dragon's unusually high temperature is said to be its heart. The heart pumps blood at an extremely high temperature, which then travels all around the body with a temperature as high as lava. Strangely, when this heart is exposed to air, it hardens into something resembling a crystal, and stops moving. Though the heart may stop beating, the mysterious heat that emanates from it is still unfathomable.
raw.es: Se dice que la fuente de la alta e inusual temperatura del dragón cubierto de llamas es su corazón. Este órgano bombea sangre a una temperatura extremadamente alta que luego viaja por todo el cuerpo con una temperatura tan alta como la lava. Lo extraño es que cuando este corazón queda expuesto al aire, se endurece, se convierte en una especie de cristal y deja de moverse. A pesar de que el corazón deja de latir, el calor misterioso que emana de su interior sigue siendo inconmensurable.
raw.id: Sumber suhu tinggi yang tidak biasa dari naga berbaju api adalah jantungnya yang memompa darah dengan suhu setinggi lava. Anehnya, saat jantung ini diekspos ke udara, akan mengeras seperti kristal dan berhenti bergerak. Meski berhenti berdetak, panas misteriusnya masih tak terpecahkan.
raw.pt: A fonte da temperatura alta do dragão de fogo é supostamente seu coração. O coração bombeia o sangue extremamente rápido, e então ele atravessa o corpo com uma temperatura tão quente quanto lava. Estranhamente, quando seu coração é exposto ao ar, ele vira algo parecido com um cristal e para de se mover. Apesar do coração parar de bater, o calor misterioso ainda é incompreensível.
raw.th: แหล่งความร้อนสูงที่ผิดปกติของเกราะไฟมังกรว่ากันว่าอยู่ที่หัวใจของมัน หัวใจสูบฉีดเลือดที่มีความร้อนสูงมาก ซึ่งเดินทางไปรอบร่างกายด้วยความร้อนที่สูงเหมือนลาวา น่าแปลก เมื่อหัวนี้สัมผัสกับอากาศมันจะแข็งขึ้นจนคล้ายกับคริสตัลและหยุดเคลื่อนไหว แม้ว่าหัวใจจะหยุดเต้นไปแล้ว ความร้อนลึกลับที่เล็ดลอดออกมาจากมันก็ยังคงไม่สามารถหยังถึง
raw.vi: Nguồn tạo ra nhiệt độ cao bất thường của con rồng phủ lửa được cho là trái tim của nó. Trái tim bơm máu có nhiệt độ cực kỳ cao, sau đó máu đi khắp cơ thể với nhiệt độ cao như dung nham. Điều lạ là khi trái tim này tiếp xúc với không khí, nó cứng lại thành một thứ giống như pha lê va ngừng đập. Mặc dù trái tim có thể ngừng đập, nhưng sức nóng huyền bí tỏa ra từ nó vẫn không thể đo được.

id: Asal nama naga bersinar ini dari tanduk tunggal di keningnya yang bersinar, dandari kekejaman kelas satunya. Banyak sarjana berdebat mengapa tanduknya bersinar, namun setelah salah satu naga ini dilenyapkan, lengkungan bersinar di dalam tengkorak naga memecahkan misteri ini. Alasan mengapa perhiasan mirip mutiara ini bersinar masih belum diketahui, dan sebagai material bernilai tinggi, ini menyulitkan riset.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10616_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The origin of the shining dragon's name comes from the extent that the single horn on its forehead glows, and from its first-class rate ferocity. Many scholars debated the reason as to why its horn glows, but after one of these dragons was vanquished, a shining orb was found inside the dragon's skull that solved the mystery. However, the reason why this pearl-like jewel glows itself is still unknown, and its high value as a material makes research difficult.

raw.en: The origin of the shining dragon's name comes from the extent that the single horn on its forehead glows, and from its first-class rate ferocity. Many scholars debated the reason as to why its horn glows, but after one of these dragons was vanquished, a shining orb was found inside the dragon's skull that solved the mystery. However, the reason why this pearl-like jewel glows itself is still unknown, and its high value as a material makes research difficult.
raw.es: El origen del nombre del dragón brillante viene dado por la forma en la que brilla el único cuerno que tiene en su cabeza y por su increíble ferocidad. Muchos eruditos debatían sobre la razón de este brillo, pero después de que uno de estos dragones fue derrotado, se encontró dentro del cráneo de la bestia una orbe resplandeciente que resolvió el misterio. Sin embargo, todavía se desconoce la razón de por qué esta joya perlada brilla por cuenta propia, y su alto valor como material hace que sea difícil llevar a cabo investigaciones.
raw.id: Asal nama naga bersinar ini dari tanduk tunggal di keningnya yang bersinar, dandari kekejaman kelas satunya. Banyak sarjana berdebat mengapa tanduknya bersinar, namun setelah salah satu naga ini dilenyapkan, lengkungan bersinar di dalam tengkorak naga memecahkan misteri ini. Alasan mengapa perhiasan mirip mutiara ini bersinar masih belum diketahui, dan sebagai material bernilai tinggi, ini menyulitkan riset.
raw.pt: A origem do nome do dragão brilhante vem do chifre único e brilhante na sua testa, além de sua violência ímpar. Muitos estudiosos debateram o porquê do chifre brilhar, mas depois de um destes dragões ter sido eliminado, uma orbe brilhante foi encontrada no crânio e respondeu ao mistério. Porém, a razão desta joia semelhante a uma pérola brilhar ainda é desconhecida, e seu alto valor enquanto material torna mais difícil a pesquisa.
raw.th: ต้นกำเนิดของชื่อมังกรแสงมาจากขนาดของเขาเดี่ยวที่ส่องแสงอยู่บนหน้าผาก และจากความดุร้ายระดับสูง นักวิชาการหลายคนถกเถียงหาเหตุผลกันว่าทำไมเขาของมันจึงเรืองแสง แต่หลังจากหนึ่งในมังกรพวกนี้ถูกกำจัดไป ก็มีการพบลูกกลมส่องแสงในกระโหลกมังกรซึ่งช่วยไขความลับทุกอย่าง อย่างไรก็ตาม เหตุผลว่าทำไมอัญมณีที่ดูเหมือนมุกนี้ถึงได้ส่องแสงในตัวมันเองนั้นยังไม่มีใครรู้ และราคาที่สูงของมันก็ทำให้การค้นคว้าทำได้ยาก
raw.vi: Nguồn gốc của cái tên con rồng hào quang này đến từ mức độ rực sáng của chiếc sừng trên trán nó và từ sự dữ tợn hạng nhất của nó. Nhiều học giả đã tranh luận về lý do tại sao cái sừng của nó phát sáng, nhưng sau khi một trong những con rồng này bị đánh bại, một quả cầu phát sáng được tìm thấy trong hộp sọ của con rồng đã giải mã được bí ẩn này. Tuy nhiên, lý do vì sao viên đá quý trông như ngọc trai này lại tự phát sáng vẫn chưa được biết và giá trị cao của nó như một loại nguyên liệu khiến việc nghiên cứu trở nên khó khăn.

id: Van Lucy, setan heterogen yang muncul baru-baru ini. Penampakannya seperti mesin, jadi banyak yang percaya ia adalah senjata buatan dewa. Namun saat Pembunuh Setan membawa pulang bagian dari setan ini, kemungkinan dugaan itu benar sangatlah kecil. Perlu riset untuk menentukan makhluk apa ini.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10617_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Van Lucy, a new heterogeneous demon which has appeared only recently. Its appearance is strikingly like a machine, which had lead many to believe that it was a weapon made by the gods. However, when some Demon Slayers brought back with them a piece of this demon, it was discovered that the possibility of that being true was very low. New research will be needed in order to determine what kind of creature it truly is.

raw.en: Van Lucy, a new heterogeneous demon which has appeared only recently. Its appearance is strikingly like a machine, which had lead many to believe that it was a weapon made by the gods. However, when some Demon Slayers brought back with them a piece of this demon, it was discovered that the possibility of that being true was very low. New research will be needed in order to determine what kind of creature it truly is.
raw.es: Van Lucy, nuevo demonio heterogéneo que apareció hace poco tiempo. Su apariencia es muy similar a la de una máquina, por lo que muchos piensan que fue un arma construida por los dioses. Sin embargo, cuando algunos Exterminadores de demonios trajeron consigo una pieza de este demonio, se descubrió que la posibilidad de que esa afirmación fuera cierta era muy baja. Ahora es necesario llevar a cabo más investigaciones para determinar qué clase de criatura es.
raw.id: Van Lucy, setan heterogen yang muncul baru-baru ini. Penampakannya seperti mesin, jadi banyak yang percaya ia adalah senjata buatan dewa. Namun saat Pembunuh Setan membawa pulang bagian dari setan ini, kemungkinan dugaan itu benar sangatlah kecil. Perlu riset untuk menentukan makhluk apa ini.
raw.pt: Van Lucy, o demônio heterogêneo que apareceu recentemente. Sua aparência é muito semelhante a uma máquina, o que levou muitos a acreditar que era uma arma feita pelos deuses. Porém, quando alguns matadores de demônios trouxeram de volta um pedaço do demônio, descobriram que essa possibilidade era muito pequena. Novas pesquisas seriam necessárias para determinar exatamente o tipo de criatura.
raw.th: ฟาน ลูซี่ ปีศาจชนิดใหม่ที่เพิ่งปรากฎตัวมาไม่นานนี้ รูปร่างของมันคล้ายกับเครื่องจักร ซึ่งทำให้หลายคนเชื่อว่ามันเป็นอาวุธที่ถูกสร้างโดยเทพเจ้า อย่างไรกก็ตาม เมื่อนักสังหารปีศาจบางคนได้นำชิ้นส่วนของปีศาจนี้กลับมาด้วย ก็มีการค้นพบว่าความเป็นไปได้ที่เรื่องดังกล่าวจะเป็นจริงนั้นต่ำมากๆ จำเป็นต้องมีการค้นคว้าใหม่เพื่อจะประเมินให้ถูกต้องว่ามันเป็นสิ่งมีชีวิตประเภทใดกันแน่
raw.vi: Van Lucy, một con quỷ không thuần chủng mới chỉ xuất hiện gần đây. Bề ngoài của nó gây ấn tượng giống như một người máy, đã dẫn đến nhiều người tin rằng nó là một vũ khí do các vị thần tạo ra. Tuy nhiên, khi một số Sát thủ diệt ma mang về một mảnh của con quỷ này, người ta đã khám phá ra rằng khả năng điều đó là sự thật rất thấp. Nghiên cứu mới sẽ cần thực hiện để xác định xem nó thực sự thuộc loại sinh vật nào.

id: Van Nader, setan berbentuk aneh yang muncul baru-baru ini. Penampakannya seperti mesin dari dunia lain, persis setan Van Lucy. Meski rumornya ia adalah senjata buatan dewa, para sarjana menolak klaim ini karena mesin tidak mampu memakai sihir. Setan ini, belum pernah disebutkan dalam mitos apa pun, masih misterius.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10618_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Van Nader, a demon of a curious shape that appeared here very recently. Resembling a machine from another world, its appearance is exactly the same as that of the demon Van Lucy. Though there are rumors that it is a weapon made by the gods, there are scholars who refute this claim by reiterating that machines are not capable of using magic. This demon, who has not been mentioned in any myths, is still shrouded in mystery.

raw.en: Van Nader, a demon of a curious shape that appeared here very recently. Resembling a machine from another world, its appearance is exactly the same as that of the demon Van Lucy. Though there are rumors that it is a weapon made by the gods, there are scholars who refute this claim by reiterating that machines are not capable of using magic. This demon, who has not been mentioned in any myths, is still shrouded in mystery.
raw.es: Van Nader, demonio de forma curiosa que apareció hace poco tiempo. Es similar a una máquina de otro mundo, y su apariencia es exactamente igual a la del demonio Van Lucy. A pesar de que existen rumores de que es un arma creada por los dioses, algunos eruditos rechazan esta afirmación y repiten que las máquinas no son capaces de usar magia. Este demonio, que no ha sido mencionado en ningún mito, todavía está rodeado por un velo de misterio.
raw.id: Van Nader, setan berbentuk aneh yang muncul baru-baru ini. Penampakannya seperti mesin dari dunia lain, persis setan Van Lucy. Meski rumornya ia adalah senjata buatan dewa, para sarjana menolak klaim ini karena mesin tidak mampu memakai sihir. Setan ini, belum pernah disebutkan dalam mitos apa pun, masih misterius.
raw.pt: Van Nader, um demônio de forma curiosa que apareceu recentemente. Lembrando uma máquina de outro mundo, sua aparência é exatamente a do demônio Van Lucy. Apesar dos rumores de que seja uma arma dos deuses, há estudiosos que negam este fato reiterando que máquinas não podem usar magia. Esse demônio, que não foi mencionado nos mitos, é envolto em mistério.
raw.th: ฟาน เนเดอร์ ปีศาจที่มีรูปร่างน่าสงสัยซึ่งปรากฎตัวที่นี่ไม่นานมานี้ ดูคล้ายกับเครื่องจักรจากโลกอื่น รูปร่างของมันดูเหมือนกับปีศาจ ฟาน ลูซี่ แม้จะมีข่าวลือว่ามันคืออาวุธที่ถูกสร้างโดยเทพเจ้า มีนักวิชาการที่ปฏิเสธคำกล่าวอ้างนี้โดยคงคำแนะนำว่าเครื่องจักรไม่ได้มีความสามารถในการใช้เวทมนตร์ ปีศาจที่ไม่เคยถูกเอ่ยถึงในตำนานเทพใดๆ นี้ ยังคงถูกปกคลุมด้วยความลึกลับ
raw.vi: Van Nader, một con quỷ có hình dạng kỳ lạ mới xuất hiện ở đây thời gian gần đây. Giống như một cỗ máy đến từ thế giới khác, bền ngoài của nó hoàn toàn giống với con quỷ Van Lucy. Mặc dù, có những lời đồn rằng nó là vũ khí do các vị thần tạo ra, nhưng có những học giả bác bỏ tuyên bố này bằng cách nhắc lại rằng máy móc không có khả năng sử dụng phép thuật. Con quỷ này, chưa từng được nhắc đến trong bất kỳ huyền thoại nào, vẫn còn là bí ẩn.

id: Jiwa orang yang telah dibantai dewa ini dijebak, dan si dewa tidak membiarkan korbannya mati. Itulah legenda dewa bara, Nalda Delia. Mata setan ini penuh kebencian yang memnawa musinah, meski tidak ada saksi hidup. Sesuai legenda, banyak Pemanggil menaruh segel kuat di material ini dan menjaganya dengan ketat.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10619_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The souls of the people who have been slain by this god are trapped by him, refusing to let them die. Such is the legend left behind of the ember god, Nalda Delia. This demon's eyes full of resentment are said to bring about catastrophes, though there is no one alive that can confirm that this threat is real. However, in accordance with the legend, many Summoners place a powerful seal over this material and keep close guard over it.

raw.en: The souls of the people who have been slain by this god are trapped by him, refusing to let them die. Such is the legend left behind of the ember god, Nalda Delia. This demon's eyes full of resentment are said to bring about catastrophes, though there is no one alive that can confirm that this threat is real. However, in accordance with the legend, many Summoners place a powerful seal over this material and keep close guard over it.
raw.es: Las almas de las personas asesinadas por este dios quedan atrapadas y se les impide morir. Esta es la leyenda que se cuenta sobre Nalda Delia, el dios de las brasas. Se dice que los ojos de este demonio llenos de resentimiento son portadores de la catástrofe, a pesar de que no hay nadie con vida que pueda confirmar esa amenaza. Sin embargo, según las leyendas, muchos invocadores plantan sellos sobre este material y lo vigilan con mucho cuidado.
raw.id: Jiwa orang yang telah dibantai dewa ini dijebak, dan si dewa tidak membiarkan korbannya mati. Itulah legenda dewa bara, Nalda Delia. Mata setan ini penuh kebencian yang memnawa musinah, meski tidak ada saksi hidup. Sesuai legenda, banyak Pemanggil menaruh segel kuat di material ini dan menjaganya dengan ketat.
raw.pt: As almas das pessoas que teriam sido mortas são armazenadas nele, que se recusa a deixá-los morrer. Tal é a lenda por trás do deus das cinzas, Nalda Delia. Os olhos desse demônio estão cheios de ressentimento e dizem trazer catástrofes, embora não haja testemunha viva que possa confirmar esta ameaça. Porém de acordo com a lenda, muitos Invocadores colocam um poderoso selo no material e ficam de olho nele.
raw.th: วิญญาณของคนที่ถูกสังหารโดยเทพเจ้าจะถูกกักไว้โดยเขา และไม่ยินยอมปล่อยให้พวกตายไป ตำนานดังกล่าวเป็นเรื่องที่ถูกเล่าทิ้งไว้ของเทพเจ้าแห่งถ่านไฟคุ นัลดา ดีเลีย  ดวงตาปีศาจนี้เต็มไปด้วยความแค้นซึ่งว่ากันว่าจะนำมาซึ่งความหายนะ แม้ว่าจะมีไม่มีใครที่มีชีวิตซึ่งสามารถยืนยันได้ว่าภัยคุกคามนี้เป็นจริง อย่างไรก็ตาม ในตำนานกล่าวว่า ซัมมอนเนอร์มากมายได้ทำวางผนึกทรงพลังบนวัตถุดิบนี้และจัดตาดูมันอยู่อย่างใกล้ชิด
raw.vi: Linh hồn của những người bị vị thần này giết chết sẽ bị thần này bắt, không để cho họ chết. Đó là truyền thuyết đằng sau thần than hồng, Nalda Delia. Đôi mắt chứa đầy oán hận của con quỷ này được cho là mang lại thảm họa, mặc dù không có ai còn sống có thể xác nhận lời hăm dọa này là sự thực. Tuy nhiên, theo truyền thuyết, nhiều Người Triệu Hồi đặt một phong ấn mạnh lên vật liệu này và canh giữ nó nghiêm ngặt.

id: Jika orang mempelajari mitos, mata Nalda Delia aslinya ditujukan untuk melindungi semua makhluk hidup di atas tanah. Namun kejahatan tak terhingga manusia membuat si dewa bara marah, dan matanya mulai membaktikan diri untuk menjaga melawan kriminal. Bertindak sebagai karma, legenda bilang, dewa bara akan menghukum siapa pun yang berdosa sesuai dengan kejahatannya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10620_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: If one browses through various myths, one will find that Nalda Delia's eyes were originally meant for protecting all living beings above the ground. However, the countless follies that humans repeated time and time again incited the wrath of the ember god, and these eyes started devoting themselves to guarding against crimes. Acting as karma, legend states that the ember god will punish those who sin according to their crimes.

raw.en: If one browses through various myths, one will find that Nalda Delia's eyes were originally meant for protecting all living beings above the ground. However, the countless follies that humans repeated time and time again incited the wrath of the ember god, and these eyes started devoting themselves to guarding against crimes. Acting as karma, legend states that the ember god will punish those who sin according to their crimes.
raw.es: Si se examinan los mitos con cuidado, se puede descubrir que, en un principio, los ojos de Nalda Delia protegían a todos los seres vivos que pisaban la tierra. Sin embargo, la infinita cantidad de tonterías realizadas una y otra vez por los humanos dieron origen a la cólera del dios de las brasas, y estos ojos comenzaron a proteger a la deidad de los crímenes. La leyenda cuenta que, como karma, el dios de las brasas castigará a todos los pecadores según sus crímenes.
raw.id: Jika orang mempelajari mitos, mata Nalda Delia aslinya ditujukan untuk melindungi semua makhluk hidup di atas tanah. Namun kejahatan tak terhingga manusia membuat si dewa bara marah, dan matanya mulai membaktikan diri untuk menjaga melawan kriminal. Bertindak sebagai karma, legenda bilang, dewa bara akan menghukum siapa pun yang berdosa sesuai dengan kejahatannya.
raw.pt: Se vários mitos forem explorados, descobre-se que os olhos de Nalda Delia originalmente deveriam proteger todos os seres vivos acima do chão. Porém, as incontáveis tolices dos humanos incitaram a fúria do deus das cinzas e estes olhos começaram a se devotar a guardarem-se contra crimes. Agindo como karma, a lenda fala de um deus das cinzas que punirá todos os pecadores de acordo com seus crimes.
raw.th: ถ้าหากใครสักคนได้เปิดดูตำนานต่างๆ ก็จะพบว่าดวงตาของนัลดา ดีเลีย ดั้งเดิมนั้นมีไว้เพื่อปกป้องสิ่งมีชีวิตทั้งมวลบนพื้นดิน อย่างไรก็ตาม ความโง่เขลานับครั้งไม่ถ้วยที่มนุษย์ทำซ้ำแล้วซ้ำอีกยั่วยุความโกรธของเทพเจ้าแห่งถ่านไฟคุ และดวงตาเหล่านี้เริ่มอุทิศตัวเองเพื่อปกป้องอาชญากรรม ทำหน้าที่เป็นกรรม ตำนานกล่าวว่าเทพเจ้าแห่งถ่านไฟคุจะลงโทษผู้ผิดบาปตามความผิดของพวกเขา
raw.vi: Nếu lướt qua nhiều huyền thoại khác nhau, người ta sẽ thấy rằng mắt của Nalda Delia ban đầu là để bảo vệ tất cả các sinh vật sống trên mặt đất. Tuy nhiên, vô số những hành động điên rồ mà con người lặp lại hết lần này đến lần khác đã kích động cơn thịnh nộ của thần than hồng và những con mắt này bắt đầu dành hết sức mình để bảo vệ chống lại tội ác. Truyền thuyết kể rằng thần than hồng sẽ trừng phạt những người phạm tội theo tội ác của họ như là quả báo đối với họ.

id: Setan Nalda Delia memiliki banyak mata. Yang paling penting ada di dada. Menurut legenda, mata ini bisa melihat jarak jauh, melewati Empat Laut, dan meyakinkan diri atas kejahatan orang berhati jahat, dan menghukum mereka dengan bencana. Mereka yang membuat dewa bara marah, jiwanya akan dipenjara, menghabiskan sisa keabadian dalam siksaan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10621_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The demon Nalda Delia possesses many eyes. The most important of those being the one that resides in his chest. According to legend, this eye can see a great distance away, past the Four Seas, to ascertain itself of the crimes committed by people of wicked hearts, and punish them with calamity. It is said that those who anger the ember god will have their souls imprisoned, spending the rest of eternity in torture.

raw.en: The demon Nalda Delia possesses many eyes. The most important of those being the one that resides in his chest. According to legend, this eye can see a great distance away, past the Four Seas, to ascertain itself of the crimes committed by people of wicked hearts, and punish them with calamity. It is said that those who anger the ember god will have their souls imprisoned, spending the rest of eternity in torture.
raw.es: El demonio Nalda Delia posee muchos ojos. El más importante de todos ellos es el que yace en su pecho. Según las leyendas, este ojo puede ver a mucha distancia, más allá de los Cuatro mares, para descubrir los crímenes cometidos por la gente con corazón malvado y castigarlos con la tragedia. Se dice que las almas de aquellos que despiertan la furia del dios de las brasas quedarán encarceladas y serán torturadas por la eternidad.
raw.id: Setan Nalda Delia memiliki banyak mata. Yang paling penting ada di dada. Menurut legenda, mata ini bisa melihat jarak jauh, melewati Empat Laut, dan meyakinkan diri atas kejahatan orang berhati jahat, dan menghukum mereka dengan bencana. Mereka yang membuat dewa bara marah, jiwanya akan dipenjara, menghabiskan sisa keabadian dalam siksaan.
raw.pt: O demônio Nalda Delia possui muitos olhos. O mais importante sendo aquele que fica no peito. Conforme a lenda, este olho pode enxergar a grandes distâncias, além dos Quatro Mares, para garantir que os crimes dos perversos serão encontrados e punidos com a calamidade. Dizem que aqueles que enfurecerem o deus das cinzas terão suas almas aprisionadas, passando o resto da vida em tortura.
raw.th: ปีศาจนัลดา ดีเลียครอบครองดวงตามากมาย แต่ลูกที่สำคัญที่สุดคืออันที่อยู่ในอกของเขา ตามที่ตำนานว่าไว้ ตาลูกนี้สามารถมองเห็นได้ไกลมาก ผ่านทะเลทั้งสี่ เพื่อใช้ยืนยันความผิดที่ถูกก่อขึ้นดดยมนุษย์ที่มีจิตใจชั่วร้าย และลงโทษพวกนั้นด้วยความหายนะ ว่ากันว่าเหล่าผู้ที่ทำให้เทพเจ้าห่งถ่านไฟคุโกรธ วิญญาณจะถูกจองจำ และใช้เวลาตลอดกาลด้วยการถูกทรมาน
raw.vi: Con qủy Nalda Delia có nhiều con mắt. Quan trọng nhất trong những con mắt đó là con mắt nằm trên ngực nó. Theo truyền thuyết, con mắt này có thể thấy ở khoảng cách rất xa, qua Bốn Biển, để hiểu rõ bản thân của tội ác do những người có trái tim độc ác gây ra và trừng phạt họ bằng tai họa. Người ta nói rằng những người làm thần than hồng tức giận thì linh hồn của họ sẽ bị giam giữ, bị tra tấn trong suốt phần đời còn lại.

id: Dewa bara memiliki banyak mata yang bisa melihat sekeliling Gaia Besar. Banyak orang mencari tahu bagaimana dewa ini bisa memiliki kemampuan henat melihat, dan berharap mendapatkan kekuatan itu. Laporan lain berkata Nalda Dalia punya permata yang bersinar merah dan dapat menggandakan kekuatannya. Tidak jelas apakah permata ini benar-benar berefek demikian.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10622_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The ember god has many eyes which can see all around Grand Gaia. Many people sought to understand how this god processed this amazing amount of visibility, hoping to attain the same great power for themselves. Other reports state that Nalda Dalia has a jewel that glows in red which can amplify his powers. However, it is unclear as to whether or not this jewel truly has such an effect.

raw.en: The ember god has many eyes which can see all around Grand Gaia. Many people sought to understand how this god processed this amazing amount of visibility, hoping to attain the same great power for themselves. Other reports state that Nalda Dalia has a jewel that glows in red which can amplify his powers. However, it is unclear as to whether or not this jewel truly has such an effect.
raw.es: El dios de las brasas tiene muchos ojos que pueden ver todo Gran Gaia. Mucha gente intentó comprender cómo es que este dios procesaba tanta cantidad de visibilidad en afán de obtener el mismo poder para ellos mismos. Otros informes dicen que Nalda Dalia tenía una joya brillante y roja que podía ampliar su poder. Sin embargo, no se sabe a ciencia cierta si esta joya tenía o no esa capacidad.
raw.id: Dewa bara memiliki banyak mata yang bisa melihat sekeliling Gaia Besar. Banyak orang mencari tahu bagaimana dewa ini bisa memiliki kemampuan henat melihat, dan berharap mendapatkan kekuatan itu. Laporan lain berkata Nalda Dalia punya permata yang bersinar merah dan dapat menggandakan kekuatannya. Tidak jelas apakah permata ini benar-benar berefek demikian.
raw.pt: O deus das cinzas tem muitos olhos que podem ver por toda Grand Faia. Muitos buscaram compreender como este deus processou sua incrível capacidade de visibilidade, esperando obter para si o mesmo poder. Outros relatos dizem que Nalda Dalia tinha uma joia que brilhava em vermelho quando ele amplifica seus poderes. Porém, não é claro o quanto essa joia realmente faz efeito.
raw.th: เทพเจ้าแห่งถ่านไฟคุมีดวงตามากมายซึ่งสามารถมองเห็นรอบแกรนด์ไกอาได้ทั้งหมด หลายคนพยายามทำความเข้าใจว่าทำไมเทพเจ้านี้ถึงได้ครอบครองการมองเห็นที่น่าทึ่งนี้ โดยหวังว่าจะได้รับพลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่แบบเดียวกันเพื่อตัวเอง รายงานอื่นๆ กล่าวไว้ว่า นัลดา ดีเลีย มีอัญมณีที่ส่องแสงสีแดงซึ่งสามารถขยายอำนาจของเขา อย่างไรก็ตาม มันยังไม่เป็นที่แน่ชัดว่าอัญมณีนี้ให้ผลกระทบแบบนั้นจริงหรือไม่
raw.vi: Thần than hồng có nhiều con mắt có thể nhìn khắp tất cả Grand Gaia. Nhiều người đã cố gắng tìm hiểu làm cách nào vị thần này xử lý được số lượng sự việc thấy được đáng ngạc nhiên này với hy vọng cũng có được sức mạnh to lớn như vậy cho bản thân. Những báo cáo khác cho biết Nalda Dalia có một viên đá quý phát sáng màu đỏ có thể làm tăng lên sức mạnh của thần. Tuy nhiên, vẫn chưa rõ là viên đá quý này có thực sự có khả năng như vậy không.

id: Katanya, dalam banyak titik di tubuh dewa penghancur ada kekuatan yang membuat siapa yang melihatnya akan menjadi gila dengan visi musuh mengelilingi mereka. Untuk alasan tersenut, meski Mistzug di garis depan selama perang melawan dewa, ia jarang bertarung tanpa senjata. Tentara bersenjata manusia saling menghancurkan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10623_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It is said that within the many speckles that run through the god of destruction's body lies the power to make those who see them go insane with visions of enemies all around them. For this reason it is thought that though Mistzug was at the front lines during the great war of the gods, he rarely ever fought in hand to hand combat. The human armed forces were destroying each other instead.

raw.en: It is said that within the many speckles that run through the god of destruction's body lies the power to make those who see them go insane with visions of enemies all around them. For this reason it is thought that though Mistzug was at the front lines during the great war of the gods, he rarely ever fought in hand to hand combat. The human armed forces were destroying each other instead.
raw.es: Se dice que dentro de las muchas manchas que forman parte del cuerpo del dios de la destrucción yace el poder para hacer que aquellos que las vean se vuelvan locos y tengan visiones de sus enemigos rodeándolos. Por esta razón, se cree que si bien Mistzug estaba al frente de la batalla durante la guerra de los dioses, pocas veces necesitaba peleaba mano a mano, ya que las fuerzas armadas de los humanos se masacraban entre sí.
raw.id: Katanya, dalam banyak titik di tubuh dewa penghancur ada kekuatan yang membuat siapa yang melihatnya akan menjadi gila dengan visi musuh mengelilingi mereka. Untuk alasan tersenut, meski Mistzug di garis depan selama perang melawan dewa, ia jarang bertarung tanpa senjata. Tentara bersenjata manusia saling menghancurkan.
raw.pt: Dizem que no meio dos muitos olhos pelo corpo do deus da destruição está o poder de fazer aqueles que o veem ficarem malucos com visões de inimigos ao seu redor. Por esse motivo que eu achei que apesar de Mistzug ficar na linha de frente com os deuses, ele raramente se engajava em combate corpo-a-corpo. Ao invés disso as forças armadas dos humanos estavam se destruindo entre si.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าภายในจุดด่างมากมายที่มีอยู่เต็มร่างกายของเทพเจ้าแห่งการทำลายล้าง มีอำนาจที่จะทำให้ผู้ที่เห็นพวกมันเป็นบ้าด้วยภาพของศัตรูรอบตัว ด้วยเหตุผลนี้ จึงคิดกันว่า มิสท์ซุก นั้นอยู่ในแนวหน้าของการรบในมหาสงครามของเทพเจ้า เขาแทบจะไม่เคยสู้ในการปะทะกันมือต่อมือเลย เพราะกองกำลังพวกมนุษย์นั้นทำลายล้างกันเองแทน
raw.vi: Người ta nói rằng trong số nhiều đốm khắp cơ thể của thần hủy diệt ẩn chứa sức mạnh khiến người nhìn thấy chúng phát điên luôn thấy những quanh họ là kẻ thù. Vì lý do này, người ta cho rằng mặc dù Mistzug ở tuyến đầu trong cuộc chiến tranh vĩ đại của các vị thần, nhưng thần hiếm khi chiến đấu trong các trận chiến giáp lá cà. Thay vào đó, các lực lượng vũ trang của con người đã hủy diệt lẫn nhau.

id: Mistzug, dewa penghancur yang menginvasi hati manusia dan menghancurkannya. Tidak diketahui apakah dewa ini selalu begitu dari awal. Ada beberapa baris dari puisi epik yang menggambarkan dewa penghancur misterius. "Mistzug hanyalah ilusi samar. Penampakannya ilusi, dan suaranya juga ilusi. Dewa ini tidak ada di dunia ini. Yang ada hanyalah permata ilusi."
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10624_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Mistzug, the god of destruction that invades people's hearts and destroys them. It is unknown whether this god had always been like this since the very beginning. There are only a few lines left of an epic poem that describe this mysterious god of destruction. "Mistzug is only a faint illusion. His appearance is an illusion, and his voice is also an illusion. This god doesn't exist in this world. The only thing present is the jewel of an illusion."

Um deus que não existe neste mundo. A única coisa presente é a joia de uma ilusão.”
raw.th: มิสท์ซุก เทพเจ้าแห่งการทำลายล้างที่รุกรานจิตใจของผู้คนและทำลายพวกนั้น ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าเทพเจ้าตนนี้เป็นแบบนี้มาตั้งแต่แรกหรือไม่ มีบทกวีที่ยิ่งใหญ่เหลืออยู่ไม่กี่บรรทัดที่อธิบายถึงเทพเจ้าแห่งการทำลายล้างผู้ลึกลับนี้ "มิสท์ซุกเป็นเพียงภาพมายาจางๆ รูปร่างของเขาเป็นภาพลวงตา และเสียงของเขาก็เป็นสิ่งลวงตาเช่นกัน เทพเจ้าตนนี้ไม่มีตัวตนอยู่ในโลก สิ่งเดียวที่มีอยู่จริงคืออัญมณีแห่งภาพลวงตา"
raw.vi: Mistzug, thần hủy diệt xâm chiếm trái tim của mọi người và hủy diệt họ. Không rõ là vị thần này có luôn như vậy ngay từ đầu không. Chỉ có vài dòng trong một bài thơ sử thi miêu tả vị thần hủy diệt bí ẩn này. "Mistzug chỉ là một ảo ảnh mờ nhạt. Diện mạo của thần là một ảo ảnh, giọng nói của thần là một ảo giác. Vị thần này không tồn tại trên thế giới này Thứ duy nhất xuất hiện là viên đá quý ảo ảnh."

id: Batu berharga yang dikenal sebagai Mata Zealot telah memukau manusia sejak lama dengan kekuatan sihirnya yang besar. Katanya para pedagang terobsesi mendapatkannya, para penyihir melakukan apa saja untuk menemukannya. Namun ada kutukan di batu ini, cahaya mencurigakan yang bertambah kuat saat batu beralih tangan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10625_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The precious stone known as the Zealot Eye has fascinated people for ages with its strong magical power. It's said that merchants were obsessed with getting their hands on these stones, with magicians doing everything in their power to find them. But it's said there is also a hex placed on these stones, the suspicious light from which grows stronger as it passes from hand to hand.

raw.en: The precious stone known as the Zealot Eye has fascinated people for ages with its strong magical power. It's said that merchants were obsessed with getting their hands on these stones, with magicians doing everything in their power to find them. But it's said there is also a hex placed on these stones, the suspicious light from which grows stronger as it passes from hand to hand.
raw.es: La piedra preciosa conocida como Ojo fanático ha sido objeto de devoción de la gente durante eras debido a su poder mágico. Se dice que los mercaderes estaban obsesionados por conseguir estas piedras y que los hechiceros hacían todo lo que tenían a su alcance para lograrlo. No obstante, también se comenta que estas piedras están embrujadas, y que la luz que tienen en su interior se hace más fuerte cuando pasan de mano en mano.
