Katanya para pedagang terobsesi mendapatkannya, para penyihir melakukan apa saja untuk menemukannya. Namun ada kutukan di batu ini, cahaya mencurigakan yang bertambah kuat saat batu beralih tangan.
raw.pt: A pedra preciosa conhecida como Olho Zeloso fascinou pessoas por eras com seu forte poder mágico. Dizem que mercadores era obcecados por conseguirem estas pedras, com magos fazendo de tudo para obtê-las. Mas também dizem que há uma maldição sobre as pedras, a luz suspeita crescendo conforme ela passa de mão em mão.
raw.th: หินมีค่าที่เรียกกันว่า ซีลอท อายส์ ทำให้ผู้คนต่างหลงใหลมานานในพลังอำนาจวิเศษที่แข็งแกร่ง ว่ากันว่าพ่อค้าลุ่มหลงที่จะได้รับหินเหล่านี้มาครอบครอง เพราะจอมเวทย์จะทำทุกอย่างด้วยพลังของพวกเขาเพื่อค้นหามัน แต่กล่าวว่ามันยังมีคำสาปใส่ไว้ที่หินเหล่านี้ แสงลึกลับซึ่งจะส่องสว่างมากขึ้นเมื่อมันถูกส่งผ่านจากมือสู่มือ
raw.vi: Một viên đá quý được gọi là Mắt cuồng tín cuốn hút mọi người ở các lứa tuổi bằng sức mạnh ma thuật mạnh mẽ của nó.  Tương truyền rằng, các thương gia bị ám ảnh bởi việc được chạm tay vào những viên đá này, với các pháp sư đang làm mọi cách trong khả năng sức mạnh của họ để tìm thấy chúng. Nhưng người ta nó rằng cũng có một bùa mê được đặt trên những viên đá này, ánh sáng đáng ngờ từ đó phát sáng mạnh mẽ khi được tuyền từ tay người này đến tay người khác.

id: Kristal aneh yang bersinar menurut seberapa bijak pemegangnya. Legenda berkata kristal ini dipakai penembak dari dunia lain yang ingin memperkuat senjatanya. Menurut deskripsi yang ada dalam bacaan yang berbeda, kemungkinan kristal berasal dari dunia lain sangat rendah. Kristal dipercaya diproduksi dalam laboratorium.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10626_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A strange crystal that shines according to how wise the person holding it is. Legend claims that this crystal was used by gunners of another world to further strengthen their arms. However, according to many of the descriptions left about the crystal in different pieces of literature, the possibilities of it having come from another world are very low. Instead, it is believed this Item was fabricated in a laboratory.

raw.en: A strange crystal that shines according to how wise the person holding it is. Legend claims that this crystal was used by gunners of another world to further strengthen their arms. However, according to many of the descriptions left about the crystal in different pieces of literature, the possibilities of it having come from another world are very low. Instead, it is believed this Item was fabricated in a laboratory.
raw.es: Un extraño cristal que brilla según la sabiduría de su portador. Cuenta la leyenda que artilleros de otro mundo usaron este cristal para reforzar sus armas. No obstante, según las muchas descripciones sobre el cristal que se encontraron en diversos textos, las posibilidades de que provenga de otro mundo son muy bajas. En su lugar, se cree que este objeto se creó en un laboratorio.

raw.pt: Um cristal estranho que brilha de acordo com a sabedoria do usuário. Diz a lenda que esse cristal foi usado por atiradores de outro mundo para fortalecer suas armas. No entanto, de acordo com muitas das descrições que restaram sobre o cristal em vários exemplares da literatura, as possibilidades de ele ter vindo de outro mundo são mínimas. Em vez disso, acredita-se que este item tenha sido fabricado em um laboratório.
raw.th: ผลึกประหลาดที่ส่องแสงราวกับจะให้เห็นว่าผู้ถือครองมีความฉลาดแค่ไหน ตามตำนานกล่าวว่าผู้ใช้มันคือนักยิงปืนจากต่างโลก เพื่อเพิ่มความแข็งแกร่งให้แขนของพวกเขา อย่างไรก็ตาม จากหลายคำอธิบายเกี่ยวกับสิ่งนี้ที่หลงเหลือไว้ในหนังสือต่างๆ กล่าวว่าความเป็นไปได้ที่มันจะมาจากต่างโลกนั้นเป็นไปได้น้อยมาก ทั้งยังเชื่อว่ามันน่าจะสร้างขึ้นมาจากในห้องทดลอง
raw.vi: Một viên pha lê lạ lùng tỏa sáng tùy theo người nắm giữ nó khôn ngoan ra sao Truyền thuyết cho rằng viên pha lê này đã được các xạ thủ của một giới khác dùng để tăng cường vũ khí của họ. Tuy nhiên, theo nhiều mô tả còn lại về viên pha lê trong nhiều mảnh cổ văn khác nhau, khả năng nó đến từ một thế giới khác là rất thấp. Thay vào đó, người ta tin rằng Vật phẩm này đã được chế tạo trong phòng thí nghiệm.

id: Informasi apa pun yang muncul tentang Balmedia, beast ini dikatakan selalu membara. Menurut kesaksian Pemanggil yang langsung melawan Balmedia, ekor Balmedia membara total. Beast ini juga mampu mengubah surainya menjadi guntur, yang menandakan ekornya akan membara lagi segera. Harga karun ini ditemukan tidak sengaja, dan mungkin adalah kunci kemampuan Balmedia untuk mengubah ekornya menjadi api.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10627_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Whenever any information regarding Balmedia surfaces, the beast is always said to be aflame. According to the testimony of a Summoner that fought Balmedia first-hand, its tail was completely ablaze. The beast also had the ability to change its mane into thunder, which hinted that its tail would go ablaze again shortly after. This treasure stumbled upon purely by chance may be the key to Balmedia's ability to transform its tail into fire.

raw.en: Whenever any information regarding Balmedia surfaces, the beast is always said to be aflame. According to the testimony of a Summoner that fought Balmedia first-hand, its tail was completely ablaze. The beast also had the ability to change its mane into thunder, which hinted that its tail would go ablaze again shortly after. This treasure stumbled upon purely by chance may be the key to Balmedia's ability to transform its tail into fire.
raw.es: En todos los escritos que se conocen sobre Balmedia se dice que la bestia está cubierta de fuego. Según el testimonio de un invocador que luchó contra Balmedia cara a cara, la cola de la criatura estaba hecha de fuego en su totalidad. La bestia también poseía la habilidad de cambiar su melena al trueno. Esto dejaba entrever que la cola de la criatura se prendería en llamas al poco tiempo. Este tesoro descubierto por casualidad puede ser la clave para la habilidad de Balmedia de transformar su cola en fuego.
raw.id: Informasi apa pun yang muncul tentang Balmedia, beast ini dikatakan selalu membara. Menurut kesaksian Pemanggil yang langsung melawan Balmedia, ekor Balmedia membara total. Beast ini juga mampu mengubah surainya menjadi guntur, yang menandakan ekornya akan membara lagi segera. Harga karun ini ditemukan tidak sengaja, dan mungkin adalah kunci kemampuan Balmedia untuk mengubah ekornya menjadi api.
raw.pt: Todas informações sobre Balmedia que vêm a tona dizem que a fera está em chamas. De acordo com um Invocador que lutou contra Balmedia, sua cauda estava completamente incandescente. A fera também tem o poder de mudar sua juba em trovão, o que era uma dica que sua cauda ficaria em chamas logo após. Esta pode ser a chave da habilidade de Balmedia em transformar sua cauda em chamas.
raw.th: ทุกๆ ครั้งจะมีข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับบาลเมเดียมาใหม่ สัตว์ตัวนี้จะมีเปลวไฟตลอดเวลา จากการอ้างอิงของซัมมอนเนอร์ที่ได้ต่อสู้กับบาลเมเดียกล่าวไว้ว่า หางของมันเป็นเปลวเพลิงที่รุนแรง ขนที่หลังคอของมันยังสามารถเปลี่ยนเป็นสายฟ้า และหางจะลุกไหม้เป็นไฟต่อมา หีบสมบัตินี้อาจจะบอกความลับเกี่ยวกับความสามารถของมันในการเปลี่ยนหางให้เป็นไฟ
raw.vi: Bất cứ khi nào có thông tin nào về bề ngoài của Balmedia, con quái thú này luôn được cho rằng đang rực cháy. Theo chứng nhận của một Người triệu hồi đã trực tiếp đánh nhau với Balmedia, đuôi của nó hoàn toàn bốc cháy. Quái thú này cũng có khả năng thay đổi bờm của nó thành sấm sét, gợi ý rằng đuôi của nó sẽ lại bốc cháy ngay sau đó. Kho báu được phát hiện hoàn toàn tình cờ này có thể là chìa khóa trả lời cho khả năng biến đuôi thành lửa của Balmedia.

id: Intan berukuran kepalan tangan ditemukan dalam tubuh Grudkia, Dianggap luar biasa indah, dan bahan berharga untuk menempa zirah berkualitas tinggi. Namun sangat mudah pecah, dan biasanya remuk saat melawab Grudkia. Perlu lebih dari sekadar kekuatan untuk menang melawan Grudkia. Dikatakan, perlu hoki besar untuk mengambilnya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10628_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A jewel the size of a fist said to grow within Grudkia's body. Regarded for its extraordinary beauty, it is considered a valuable ingredient used to forge high quality armor. However, being very fragile in nature, the jewel usually breaks into pieces when fighting Grudkia in hopes of obtaining it. Therefore, more than needing strength to win against the beast in battle, it is said that what one really needs is a stroke of luck in order to collect it.

raw.en: A jewel the size of a fist said to grow within Grudkia's body. Regarded for its extraordinary beauty, it is considered a valuable ingredient used to forge high quality armor. However, being very fragile in nature, the jewel usually breaks into pieces when fighting Grudkia in hopes of obtaining it. Therefore, more than needing strength to win against the beast in battle, it is said that what one really needs is a stroke of luck in order to collect it.
raw.es: Joya del tamaño de un puño que se dice crece dentro del cuerpo de Grudkia. Esta joya extraordinariamente bella se considera un valioso ingrediente y se usa para forjar armaduras de gran calidad. Sin embargo, como es frágil por naturaleza, la piedra generalmente se parte en pedazos cuando se lucha contra Grudkia. Por lo tanto, la mejor manera de conseguirla no es a través de la fuerza bruta durante una batalla contra la bestia, sino mediante una golpe de suerte.
raw.id: Intan berukuran kepalan tangan ditemukan dalam tubuh Grudkia, Dianggap luar biasa indah, dan bahan berharga untuk menempa zirah berkualitas tinggi. Namun sangat mudah pecah, dan biasanya remuk saat melawab Grudkia. Perlu lebih dari sekadar kekuatan untuk menang melawan Grudkia. Dikatakan, perlu hoki besar untuk mengambilnya.
raw.pt: Uma joia do tamanho de um punho que cresce no corpo de Grudkia. Por sua beleza extraordinária, a joia é considerada um ingrediente de valor para forjar armaduras de ala qualidade. Porém, por ser frágil na natureza, a joia normalmente se quebra durante a luta contra Grudkia. Portanto, muito mais do que apenas força é necessário para derrotar a fera, dizem que é necessário um golpe de sorte para obter a joia.
raw.th: หินสวยงามขนาดกำปั้นที่เชื่อว่าเกิดจากร่างกายของกรัดเกียร์ นอกจากจะมีความสวยงามมากแล้ว มันยังถือว่าเป็นสิ่งสำคัญในการสร้างเสื้อเกราะคุณภาพดี แต่ด้วยความเปราะบางของมัน ส่วนมากจะแตกในขณะที่ต่อสู้กับกรัดเกียร์เพื่อทีจะเอามา ฉะนั้นที่สำคัญกว่าการที่จะเอาชนะสัตว์ตัวนี้ได้คือความโชคดีที่จะได้รับอัญมณีนี้กลับมาเป็นชิ้น
raw.vi: Một viên đá quý có kích thước bằng nắm đấm được cho rằng phát triển trong cơ thể của Grudkia. Được chú ý vì vẻ đẹp lạ thường, nó được coi là nguyên liệu quý giá được sử dụng để rèn giáp chất lượng cao. Tuy nhiên, vì tính chất rất dễ vỡ, viên đá quý này thường vỡ vụn khi đánh Grudkia để hy vọng có được nó. Do đó, ngoài việc cần sức mạnh để chiến thắng quái vật này khi chiến đấu, tương truyền rằng điều thực sự cần là may mắn để thu được nó.

id: Yugreia adalah setan yang terkenal memiliki sifat berlawanan air dan api. Sering menggunakan ilusi untuk berpindah, keberadaan intan ini terkonfirmasi saat  Yugreia akhirnya menunjukkan bentuk sejatinya. Ketika dilemparkan ke air, intan ini katanya membuat cairan itu menjadi api menyala. Kalau dilemparkan ke air, api itu berubah menjadi air mengalir. Banyak periset spesies setan berharap untuk mendapatkan penemuan besar dalam bidangnya kalau mereka mendapatkan intan yang satu ini.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10629_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Yugreia is a demon known for possessing the opposing properties of both water and fire. Often resorting to illusions in order to move about, the existence of this jewel was confirmed when Yugreia finally showed its true form. When thrown into a body of water, the jewel is said to turn the liquid into burning flames. When thrown into a fire, the flames turn into flowing water. Many researchers of demonic species hope to make a great break through in their field once they acquire this peculiar stone.

raw.en: Yugreia is a demon known for possessing the opposing properties of both water and fire. Often resorting to illusions in order to move about, the existence of this jewel was confirmed when Yugreia finally showed its true form. When thrown into a body of water, the jewel is said to turn the liquid into burning flames. When thrown into a fire, the flames turn into flowing water. Many researchers of demonic species hope to make a great break through in their field once they acquire this peculiar stone.
raw.es: Yugreia es un demonio conocido por poseer las propiedades opuestas del agua y el fuego. La existencia de esta joya se confirmó cuando Yugreia por fin reveló su verdadera forma, algo que no ocurre a menudo, ya que la bestia se mueve mediante ilusiones. Cuando se la arroja al agua, se dice que esta joya tiene la capacidad de convertir el líquido en llamas ardientes. Cuando se la arroja al fuego, las llamas se convierten en agua. Muchos investigadores de especies demoníacas esperan realizar un gran descubrimiento en su campo una vez hayan conseguido esta peculiar piedra.
raw.id: Yugreia adalah setan yang terkenal memiliki sifat berlawanan air dan api. Sering menggunakan ilusi untuk berpindah, keberadaan intan ini terkonfirmasi saat  Yugreia akhirnya menunjukkan bentuk sejatinya. Ketika dilemparkan ke air, intan ini katanya membuat cairan itu menjadi api menyala. Kalau dilemparkan ke air, api itu berubah menjadi air mengalir. Banyak periset spesies setan berharap untuk mendapatkan penemuan besar dalam bidangnya kalau mereka mendapatkan intan yang satu ini.
raw.pt: Yugreia é um demônio conhecido por possuir dois poderes opostos, Fogo e Água. Muitas vezes utilizando de ilusão para se locomover, a existência desta joia confirmada quando Yugreia mostrou sua verdadeiro forma. Ao ser jogado um corpo de água, a joia transforma o líquido em chamas. E quando jogada no fogo, as chamas se tornam água. Muitos pesquisadores de espécies demoníacas, esperam fazer descobertas incríveis em seus ramos se obtiverem a pedra.
raw.th: ยูกรีเอียเป็นปีศาจที่สามารถควบคุมคุณสมบัติตรงกันข้ามของน้ำและไฟ จะสร้างภาพลวงตาขึ้นมาแต่อัญมณีนี้มีอยู่จริงเมื่อยูกรีเอียแสดงร่างจริงของมัน เมื่อโยนลงไปในน้ำ หินนี้จะเปลี่ยนน้ำให้เป็นเปลวเพลิง และเมื่อโยนลงไปในไฟ ไฟจะปลี่ยนไปเป็นน้ำ นักศึกษาปีศาจคาดว่าถ้าได้ตัวอย่างหินนี้มา จะสามารถเข้าใจปีศาจตัวนี้ได้มากขึ้น
raw.vi: Yugreia là một con quỷ được nổi tiếng vì sở hữu những đặc tính đối lập của cả nước và lửa. Thường phải sử dụng đến ảo giác để di chuyển, sự tồn tại của viên đá quý này đã được xác nhận khi Yugreia cuối cùng đã cho thấy hình dạng thật của mình. Khi bị ném vào một khối nước, viên đá quý này được cho rằng sẽ biến chất lỏng thành ngọn lửa bùng cháy. Khi được ném vào lửa, ngọn lửa biến thành dòng nước chảy. Nhiều nhà nghiên cứu về loài quỷ này hy vọng tạo ra một đột phá lớn trong lĩnh vực của họ khi có được viên đá kỳ lạ này.

id: Kulit hijau mudah ini dari monster biasa. Digunakan untuk berbagai macam zirah karena mudah diproses dan banyak tersedia, juga di Elgaia. Karena mudah didapatkan, banyak pemula yang memakainya sebagai zirah pertama mereka. Making juga bekerja dengan mengumpulkan dan menjualnya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This is the light green pelt from a common beast. It's used in various types of armor because of its easy-to-process nature and high availability, even in Elgaia. As it's easy to get, many novices put together their first set of armor with this pelt. Making also make their living by gathering and selling them.

raw.en: This is the light green pelt from a common beast. It's used in various types of armor because of its easy-to-process nature and high availability, even in Elgaia. As it's easy to get, many novices put together their first set of armor with this pelt. Making also make their living by gathering and selling them.
raw.es: Este cuero de color verde claro es de una bestia muy común y se utiliza en diversas armaduras porque es fácil de procesar y de conseguir, incluso en Elgaia. Por ello, muchos aprendices fabrican su primera armadura con ella y se ganan la vida fabricando y vendiendo otras.
raw.id: Kulit hijau mudah ini dari monster biasa. Digunakan untuk berbagai macam zirah karena mudah diproses dan banyak tersedia, juga di Elgaia. Karena mudah didapatkan, banyak pemula yang memakainya sebagai zirah pertama mereka. Making juga bekerja dengan mengumpulkan dan menjualnya.
raw.pt: Esse é o couro verde-claro de uma fera comum. É usado em vários tipos de armadura por causa de sua natureza de fácil processo e alta disponibilidade, mesmo em Elgaia. Como é fácil de conseguir, muitos novatos o utilizam para fazer sua primeira armadura. Muitos também ganham a vida coletando e vendendo esse material.
raw.th: หนังสีเขียวอ่อนจากสัตว์ป่าที่พบบ่อย มันใช้สำหรับชุดเกราะประเภทต่างๆ เพราะง่ายต่อการทำ และมีอยู่ในจำนวนมากแม้แต่ในเอลไกอา มันเป็นเรื่องง่ายที่จะได้มาทำให้พวกมือใหม่จำนวนมาก ใส่ชุดเกราะเริ่มแรกของพวกเขาด้วยหนังชนิดนี้ การทำนั้นยังทำให้พวกเขาดำรงชีวิตอยู่ได้ โดยการรวบรวมและขายพวกมัน
raw.vi: Đây là một tấm da màu xanh lá cây nhạt lấy được từ trên mình một con thú thông thường. Nó được sử dụng để chế tạo nhiều loại áo giáp khác nhau bởi vì chúng sở hữu đặc tính dễ chế tạo và mang lại giá trị cao, ngay cả tại Elgaia. Bởi vì dễ dàng có được những tấm da thú này cho nên những người chưa có kinh nghiệm thường cùng nhau chế tạo những bộ áo giáp đầu tiên từ chính những tấm da thú này. Họ thường tập hợp và bán những áo giáp được chế tạo từ da thú này để kiếm thu nhập trang trải cuộc sống

id: Kulit biru yang sering ditemukan di Padang Pasir Kagan dan Pantai Angin di Morgan. Karena lebih kuat daripada Kulit Hijau, perlu keahlian yang lebih tinggi untuk memrosesnya, tapi juga menghasilkan alat-alat yang mempunyai tingkat pertahanan lebih tinggi.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10701_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This blue pelt is frequently found in the Kagan Desert and Breezy Beaches of Morgan. Since it's tougher than the Green Pelt it requires a higher degree of skill to work with, but in exchange it does yield equipment with a higher defense rating.

raw.en: This blue pelt is frequently found in the Kagan Desert and Breezy Beaches of Morgan. Since it's tougher than the Green Pelt it requires a higher degree of skill to work with, but in exchange it does yield equipment with a higher defense rating.
raw.es: Este cuero se encuentra con frecuencia en el desierto de Kegan y en las playa de las brisas de Morgan. Como es más duro que el cuero verde, requiere más destreza para trabajarlo, pero a cambio se obtiene equipo con mayor nivel de defensa.
raw.id: Kulit biru yang sering ditemukan di Padang Pasir Kagan dan Pantai Angin di Morgan. Karena lebih kuat daripada Kulit Hijau, perlu keahlian yang lebih tinggi untuk memrosesnya, tapi juga menghasilkan alat-alat yang mempunyai tingkat pertahanan lebih tinggi.
raw.pt: Esse couro azul-celeste é encontrado com frequência no Deserto de Kagan e nas Fendas do Vento em Morgan. Como é mais resistente do que o couro verde precisa de mais habilidade na hora de ser trabalhado, mas o equipamento feito com ele tem um potencial de defesa melhor.
raw.th: นี้หนังสีฟ้าที่พบบ่อยในทะเลทรายคากัน และ หาดสายลมของมอร์แกน เนื่องจากมันคงทนกว่าหนังสีเขียว มันต้องสกิลระดับสูงเพื่อจัดการกับมัน แต่ผลตอบแทนที่ได้รับคืออัตราการป้องกันของอุปกรณ์จะเพิ่มสูงขึ้น
raw.vi: Tấm da thú màu xanh da trời này được tìm thấy ở sa mạc Kagan và bãi biển Breezy ở Morgan. Bởi vì tấm da thú này chắc bền hơn tấm da thú màu xanh nên khi chế tạo chúng đòi hỏi người thực hiện phải có trình độ kỹ năng cao hơn, nhưng đổi lại chúng sẽ tạo ra được các trang thiết bị có khả năng phòng bị cao hơn

id: Kulit merah ini ditemukan di Gunung Berapi Eldent dan Gunung Suci Craylia di daerah St. Lamia. Sangat keras tapi fleksibel, dan legenda mengatakan materi ini dulu dipakai untuk membuat Segel Dewi. Dapat ditemukan di Mistral, tapi orang harus pergi ke St. Lamia untuk mendapatkannya dalam jumlah besar.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10702_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This red pelt is found on the Volcano Eldent and Sacred Mt. Craylia in the St. Lamia region. It has both high hardness and flexibility, and legend has it that it was the material used to make the Goddess Seal. It can be found in Mistral, but one must travel to St. Lamia in order to obtain large quantities.

raw.en: This red pelt is found on the Volcano Eldent and Sacred Mt. Craylia in the St. Lamia region. It has both high hardness and flexibility, and legend has it that it was the material used to make the Goddess Seal. It can be found in Mistral, but one must travel to St. Lamia in order to obtain large quantities.
raw.es: Este cuero rojo se encuentra en el volcán Eldent y en el monte sagrado de Craylia, en Santa Lamia. Tiene una gran dureza y flexibilidad, y la leyenda dice que se usó para fabricar el sello de la diosa. Se puede encontrar en Mistral, pero hay que ir a Santa Lamia si se necesitan grandes cantidades.
raw.id: Kulit merah ini ditemukan di Gunung Berapi Eldent dan Gunung Suci Craylia di daerah St. Lamia. Sangat keras tapi fleksibel, dan legenda mengatakan materi ini dulu dipakai untuk membuat Segel Dewi. Dapat ditemukan di Mistral, tapi orang harus pergi ke St. Lamia untuk mendapatkannya dalam jumlah besar.
raw.pt: Esse couro vermelho é encontrado no Vulcão Eldent e no Sagrado Monte Craylia na região de St. Lamia. Ele combina dureza e flexibilidade, e dizem as lendas que foi o material usado para fazer o Selo da Deusa. Ele pode ser encontrado em Mistral, mas para obter grandes quantidades é necessário viajar a St. Lamia.
raw.th: หนังสีแดงที่พบในภูเขาไฟ เอลเด้นท์ และภูเขาศักดิ์สิทธิ์เครเลีย ในเขตแดนเซนต์ลาเมีย มันมีทั้งความแข็งแรงและความยืดหยุ่น ตำนานเล่าว่ามันเป็นวัตถุดิบที่ใช้ทำผนึกของเทพธิดา ซึ่งสามารถพบได้ในมิสทราล แต่จะต้องเดินทางไปที่เซนต์ลาเมียหากต้องการในปริมาณที่มาก
raw.vi: Tấm da thú màu đỏ này được tìm thấy ở vùng núi lửa Eldent và Sacred Mt. Craylia ở vùng St. Lamia. Chúng sở hữu cả hai đặc tính là rất cứng và dẻo dai, và theo truyền thuyết thì đây là loại nguyên vật liệu đã được sử dụng để chế tạo con dấu cho các nữ thần. Có thể tìm thấy tấm da thú màu đỏ này ở Mistral, nhưng khi đó lại phải đi tới St. Lamia nếu muốn lấy được số lượng lớn hơn

id: Kulit berwarna merah darah yang sangat langka. Tidak hanya kuat, tapi polyanya juga sangat indah sehingga para kolektor memajangnya. Juga pernah dipakai untuk spanduk. Tapi sekarang sudah sangat langka dan hanya dapat ditemukan di sekitar Kuil Lystia dan Kuil yang Hancur.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10705_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This is an extremely rare scarlet-colored pelt. Not only is it tough, but the pattern is so beautiful that some collectors even put it on display. It has also historically been used as a material for banners. It's extremely rare now, however, and only found around the Shrine of Lystia and the Destroyed Temple.

raw.en: This is an extremely rare scarlet-colored pelt. Not only is it tough, but the pattern is so beautiful that some collectors even put it on display. It has also historically been used as a material for banners. It's extremely rare now, however, and only found around the Shrine of Lystia and the Destroyed Temple.
raw.es: Este cuero tan poco habitual de color escarlata es bien resistente y tiene un diseño tan bonito que algunos coleccionistas llegan a exponerlo como decoración. Históricamente se ha utilizado para hacer banderas. Hoy en día solo se encuentra en el templo de Lystia y en la catedral derruida.
raw.id: Kulit berwarna merah darah yang sangat langka. Tidak hanya kuat, tapi polyanya juga sangat indah sehingga para kolektor memajangnya. Juga pernah dipakai untuk spanduk. Tapi sekarang sudah sangat langka dan hanya dapat ditemukan di sekitar Kuil Lystia dan Kuil yang Hancur.
raw.pt: Couro escarlate extremamente raro. Não somente é resistente, mas possui um padrão de cores tão belo que alguns colecionadores o exibem. Historicamente ele foi usado como material para bandeiras. Mas é extremamente raro e só é encontrado perto do Templo de Lystia e do Templo Destruído.
raw.th: เป็นหนังสีแดงสดที่หายากมาก ไม่เพียงแต่มันจะหายาก แต่ลวดลายที่สวยงามทำให้นักสะสมบางคนนำไปสะสมเสียมากกว่า ถึงอย่างไรในอดีตมันก็เคยถูกนำมาใช้เป็นวัตถุดิบสำหรับป้ายธง และหายากมากในขณะนี้ อย่างไรก็ดีมันถูกพบอยู่ที่วิหารลิสเทีย
raw.vi: Đây là tấm da tú có màu đỏ tươi vô cùng hiếm. Nó không chỉ bền chắc mà mẫu mã cũng vô cùng đẹp tới mức các nhà sưu tập ai khi có nó cũng có ý mang ra trưng bày. Từ xa xưa nó đã được sử dụng như một nguyên vật liệu để làm các băng zôn biểu ngữ. Tuy nhiên, hiện giờ nó đã trở thành một thứ nguyên liệu vô cùng hiếm có, và chỉ tìm thấy được ở các vùng quanh miếu thờ Lystia và Khu đền đã bị phá hủy Destroyed Temple

id: Kulit biru ini hanya dapat ditemukan di Gunung Wistorea di St. Lamia. Warna biru langitnya sangat indah. Legenda bercerita ketika Ratu Suci dari kerajaan kuno pergi berperang, simbol yang dibawanya dibuat dari kulit ini. Simbol itu meningkatkan vitalitas, dan pasukan yang dipimpinnya dikira tidak bisa mati.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10706_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This blue pelt is found only on Mt. Wistorea in St. Lamia. It features a beautiful azure hue. Legend has it that when the Holy Queen of the ancient kingdom left for the battlefield, the crest she took with her was made from it. That crest raised vitality, and the troops that she led with it were thought to be immortal.

raw.en: This blue pelt is found only on Mt. Wistorea in St. Lamia. It features a beautiful azure hue. Legend has it that when the Holy Queen of the ancient kingdom left for the battlefield, the crest she took with her was made from it. That crest raised vitality, and the troops that she led with it were thought to be immortal.
raw.es: Este cuero solo se encuentra en el monte Wistorea. Destaca de él su bello color cian. Cuenta la leyenda que, cuando la antigua reina de luz partió a la guerra, se llevó con ella un blasón de este cuero. El blasón le dio tal ánimo a sus tropas que sus enemigos creyeron que eran inmortales.
raw.id: Kulit biru ini hanya dapat ditemukan di Gunung Wistorea di St. Lamia. Warna biru langitnya sangat indah. Legenda bercerita ketika Ratu Suci dari kerajaan kuno pergi berperang, simbol yang dibawanya dibuat dari kulit ini. Simbol itu meningkatkan vitalitas, dan pasukan yang dipimpinnya dikira tidak bisa mati.
raw.pt: Este couro azul-celeste só é encontrado no Monte Wistorea em St. Lamia. Ele tem uma bela coloração azul-celeste. Diz a lenda que a Sacra Rainha do antigo reino foi para o campo de batalha levando um brasão feito deste material. Esse brasão dava vitalidade, e imaginava-se que as tropas que ela liderou fossem imortais.
raw.th: หนังสีฟ้าที่พบบนภูเขาวิสทอรีอา ในเซนต์ลาเมีย มันมีสีฟ้าสวยงาม ในตำนานเล่าว่าเมื่อราชินีศักดิ์สิทธิ์แห่งอาณาจักรโบราณได้ออกไปสู่สนามรบ เธอเอาตราที่ทำจากมันติดตัวไปด้วย ตรานั้นช่วยเพิ่มพลัง และกองทัพที่เธอเป็นผู้นำถูกเข้าใจว่าเป็นกองกำลังที่เป็นอมตะ
raw.vi: Tấm da thú màu xanh da trời này chỉ được tìm thấy ở Mt. Wistorea ở St. Lamia. Màu đặc trưng của nó là màu xanh da trời rất đẹp. Truyền thuyết kể lại rằng khi Nữ hoàng Holy của vương triều cổ đại rời khỏi chiến trường, chiếc mũ sắt mà cô ấy đội trên đầu chính là được làm từ tấm da thú màu xanh thế này. Chiếc mũ đó đã làm tăng sinh khí, và đoàn quân do cô ấy lãnh đạo đã trở thành bất tử

id: Kulit unik yang didistribusikan oleh Dewan Pemanggil. Karena materi ini adalah salah satu bahan untuk membuat Aksesoris kualitas tinggi, Pemanggil sering saling bertukar sendiri. Tapi, seperti semua materi tipe Kehormatan, misteri menyelimutinya dan tidak tahu di mana monster sumbernya hidup.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10707_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: These unique pelts are distributed by the Summoners' Council. As it is one of the materials used in creating high-quality Spheres, Summoners often exchange them amongst themselves. However, like other Honor-type materials, mystery surrounds them and it's unknown where the beast that they're taken from lives.

raw.en: These unique pelts are distributed by the Summoners' Council. As it is one of the materials used in creating high-quality Spheres, Summoners often exchange them amongst themselves. However, like other Honor-type materials, mystery surrounds them and it's unknown where the beast that they're taken from lives.
raw.es: El consejo de invocadores se encarga de distribuir este extraordinario material. Como se usa en la creación de esferas, a veces los invocadores se lo intercambian. Como sucede con los demás materiales nobles, un halo de misterio rodea este cuero: se desconoce a qué bestia pertenece.
raw.id: Kulit unik yang didistribusikan oleh Dewan Pemanggil. Karena materi ini adalah salah satu bahan untuk membuat Aksesoris kualitas tinggi, Pemanggil sering saling bertukar sendiri. Tapi, seperti semua materi tipe Kehormatan, misteri menyelimutinya dan tidak tahu di mana monster sumbernya hidup.
raw.pt: Esses couros único são distribuídos pelo Conselho dos Invocadores. Como é um dos materiais usados na criação de esferas de alta qualidade, é comum ver Invocadores negociando-os entre si. No entanto, como outros materiais do tipo Honra, é cercado de mistério e não se sabe onde vive a fera que o fornece.
raw.th: หนังหายากเหล่านี้ จะถูกแจกจ่ายโดยสภาซัมมอนเนอร์ มันเป็นหนึ่งในวัตถุดิบที่ใช้ในการสร้างสเฟียร์ที่มีคุณภาพสูง ซัมมอนเนอร์มักจะแลกเปลี่ยนมันกันในหมู่ตัวเอง อย่างไรก็ตามเช่นเดียวกับวัตถุดิบเกียรติอื่น ๆ ความลึกลับอยู่ล้อมรอบตัวพวกเขา และก็ไม่รู้ที่มาของสัตว์ป่าที่พวกเขาได้พรากชีวิตของมัน
raw.vi: Những tấm da thú độc nhất vô nhị này được đưa tới bởi Hội đồng triệu tập. Bởi vì chúng là một trong những loại nguyên vật liệu đã được sử dụng để tạo ra những khối cầu khối lượng cao, nên những người Summoner thường tự trao đổi chúng với nhau. Tuy nhiên, cũng giống như những nguyên vật liệu dạng Honor khác, bí ẩn xung quanh việc sử dụng những tấm da thú độc nhất vô nhị này vẫn chưa được khám phá và người ta cũng không biết những con thú cho ra những tấm da này sống ở nơi đâu

id: Kulit dari monster yang besar dan sangat kuat. Ukurannya membuatnya sulit untuk diproses secara normal. Mereka sering terlihat di reruntuhan di daerah Cordelica yang dalam. Tapi, Pemanggil menyelidiki bagaimana dan dari monster mana kulit itu didapatkan, karena tidak cocok dengan semua spesies yang sekarang ada di Cordelica.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10708_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The pelt from a massive and immensely powerful beast. Its size makes it difficult to process by normal means. They are often spotted in the ruins deep within Cordelica. However, Summoners are investigating as to how and from what beast such pelts could be obtained considering it doesn't match any species that currently exists in Cordelica.

raw.en: The pelt from a massive and immensely powerful beast. Its size makes it difficult to process by normal means. They are often spotted in the ruins deep within Cordelica. However, Summoners are investigating as to how and from what beast such pelts could be obtained considering it doesn't match any species that currently exists in Cordelica.
raw.es: Piel de una bestia gigantesca e inmensamente poderosa. Su tamaño dificulta procesarla por medios normales. A menudo son vistas en las ruinas dentro de Cordélica. Sin embargo, los invocadores investigan de qué bestia podrían obtenerse estas pieles, considerando que no coinciden con ninguna especie existente en Cordélica.
raw.id: Kulit dari monster yang besar dan sangat kuat. Ukurannya membuatnya sulit untuk diproses secara normal. Mereka sering terlihat di reruntuhan di daerah Cordelica yang dalam. Tapi, Pemanggil menyelidiki bagaimana dan dari monster mana kulit itu didapatkan, karena tidak cocok dengan semua spesies yang sekarang ada di Cordelica.
raw.pt: O couro de uma fera gigantesca e extremamente poderosa. Seu tamanho o torna difícil de processar de formas normais. São vistos com frequência nas ruínas no interior de Cordelica. No entanto, invocadores ainda investigam como e onde o couro desse monstro podia ser obtido, considerando que não é compatível com qualquer espécie existente em Cordelica.
raw.th: หนังจากสัตว์ที่มีขนาดใหญ่ยักษ์และพละกำลังมากมาย ขนาดของมันทำให้ยากที่จะดำเนินการโดยวิธีการปกติ พวกมันมักถูกพบเห็นในซากปรักหักพังลึกเข้าไปในคอเดลิก้า อย่างไรก็ดีซัมมอนเนอร์กำลังตรวจสอบอยู่ว่าจะหาหนังพวกนี้ได้จากสัตว์ชนิดไหนและอย่างไร ในเมื่อพวกมันไม่ได้มีสายพันธุ์ตรงกับสิ่งมีชีวิตใดๆ เลยในคอเดลิก้า
raw.vi: Bộ da của một loài thú khổng lồ và sở hữu một sức mạnh vô cùng lớn. Kích thước của tấm da thú này khiến cho người ta khó có thể biến gia công chúng bằng những dụng cụ thông thường. Chúng thường được đặt vào trong những đống đổ nát nằm sâu trong lòng Cordelica. Tuy nhiên, những người Summoner vẫn đang điều tra xem bằng cách nào và từ đâu mà người ta có thể lấy được những tấm da thú khổng lồ này bởi vì theo họ những bộ da thú này không khớp với bất kỳ một loài sinh vật nào đang sinh sống và tồn tại ở Cordelica

id: Kulit dari monster emas. Yang memegangnya bisa merasakan kemegahan dari monster mistis yang tinggal di seluruh Amdahl, di mana dia berjaga dengan surainya tertiup aingin. Dia berubah menjadi kuning matang kalau terbakar matahari, dan ketika digunakan untuk benda pertahanan, tidak hanya kuat, tapi juga memberikan penggunanya kekuatan spesial.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10709_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The pelt from a golden beast. One who holds it can feel the regality of the mystical beast which inhabits all of Amdahl, where it stands watch with its mane blowing in the wind. It turns a dull yellow when tanned, and when used to created defensive items it is not only strong but also grants its user special powers.

raw.en: The pelt from a golden beast. One who holds it can feel the regality of the mystical beast which inhabits all of Amdahl, where it stands watch with its mane blowing in the wind. It turns a dull yellow when tanned, and when used to created defensive items it is not only strong but also grants its user special powers.
raw.es: Piel de una bestia dorada. Quien la sostiene puede sentir la majestuosidad de la bestia mística que habita en Amdahl, donde vigila con la melena agitándose al viento. Toma un color opaco al ser curtida, y cuando es usada para crear objetos de defensa no solo es fuerte sino que concede poderes especiales a quien la usa.
raw.id: Kulit dari monster emas. Yang memegangnya bisa merasakan kemegahan dari monster mistis yang tinggal di seluruh Amdahl, di mana dia berjaga dengan surainya tertiup aingin. Dia berubah menjadi kuning matang kalau terbakar matahari, dan ketika digunakan untuk benda pertahanan, tidak hanya kuat, tapi juga memberikan penggunanya kekuatan spesial.
raw.pt: O couro de um monstro dourado. Quem o segura consegue sentir a realeza do monstro místico que vive em Amdahl, onde observa os arredores com os pelos voando ao vento. Ele fica com uma coloração amarela fosca e, quando usada para criar itens de defesa, não é só resistente, mas também confere poderes especiais ao usuário.
raw.th: หนังจากสัตว์สีทอง ผู้ที่ถือมันจะสามารถสัมผัสได้ถึงความสง่างามของสัตว์วิเศษซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ทั่วไปในอัมดาลห์ สถานที่ซึ่งพวกมันยืนมองพร้อมแผงคอสยายพริ้วไปตามสายลม มันจะเปลี่ยนเป็นสีเหลืองคล้ำเมื่อฟอกและเมื่อใช้สำหรับสร้างไอเทมป้องกัน นอกจากมันจะแข็งแกร่งมากแล้วมันยังมอบพลังพิเศษให้กับผู้ใช้อีกด้วย
raw.vi: Bộ da của một loài thú vàng. Một người nào đó có cơ may sở hữu tấm da thú này có thể cảm nhận được uy quyền của một loài thú vô cùng thần bí sinh sống trên khắp vùng Amdahl, đây là nơi chúng đứng và quan sát xung quanh với bộ bờm thả trôi trong gió. Bộ da thú này sẽ chuyển sang màu vàng đục khi bị rám nắng và khi được sử dụng để chế tạo ra các công cụ phòng vệ thì nó không chỉ chắc mà còn sở hữu một sức mạnh vô cùng đặc biệt

id: Serigala berkulit perak yang ada di zaman kuno. Serigala perak hidup bergerombol, dan pemimpin gerombolan katanya berkilau. Kulit bulunya berisi sihir kuat dan digunakan dalam berbagai studi sihir.Terlalu banyak yang berburu membuat mereka punah, walau beberapa kulit dilaporkan telah ditemukan di Palmyna di Gaia Besar.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10710_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A silver-skinned wolf that existed in ancient times. Silver wolves lived in packs, and the leader of the pack is said to have glistened. Its pelt contained powerful magic and have been used in various magic studies. Over-hunting drove them to extinction, but some pelts have reportedly been found in Palmyna in Grand Gaia.

raw.en: A silver-skinned wolf that existed in ancient times. Silver wolves lived in packs, and the leader of the pack is said to have glistened. Its pelt contained powerful magic and have been used in various magic studies. Over-hunting drove them to extinction, but some pelts have reportedly been found in Palmyna in Grand Gaia.
raw.es: Lobo de piel plateada que existió en la antigüedad. Los lobos plateados viven en manadas, y se dice que el líder de la manada relucía. Su piel contenía magia poderosa y ha sido usada en varios estudios sobre magia. La caza excesiva los llevó a la extinción, pero según se dice algunas han sido encontradas en Palmyna en Gran Gaia.
raw.id: Serigala berkulit perak yang ada di zaman kuno. Serigala perak hidup bergerombol, dan pemimpin gerombolan katanya berkilau. Kulit bulunya berisi sihir kuat dan digunakan dalam berbagai studi sihir.Terlalu banyak yang berburu membuat mereka punah, walau beberapa kulit dilaporkan telah ditemukan di Palmyna di Gaia Besar.
raw.pt: Um lobo de pele prateada que vivia em tempos antigos. Lobos prateados viviam em grupo e dizem que o líder brilhava. Seu couro contém uma magia poderosa e tem sido usado em vários estudos de magia. A caça abundante levou esses lobos à extinção, mas há registros de algumas peles ainda sendo encontradas em Palmyna, em Grand Gaia.
raw.th: หมาป่าหนังสีเงินที่มีอยู่ในยุคโบราณ หมาป่าเงินอาศัยอยู่เป็นฝูงและจ่าฝูงนั้นจะมีประกายระยิบระยับ หนังของมันบรรจุพลังเวทย์ที่แข็งแกร่งและถูกใช้กันในการศึกษาเวทมนตร์มากมาย การล่ามากจนเกินไปทำให้มันสูญพนธุ์ แต่มีการรายงานว่าพบเห็นหนังของมันอยู่บ้างในปาลมินาและแกรนด์ไกอา
raw.vi: Một con sói da ánh bạc sống ở thời cổ đại. Sói bạc sống theo đàn, và thủ lĩnh đàn được cho là có bộ lông lấp lánh. Tấm da của nó có phép thuật mạnh mẽ và được dùng trong nhiều nghiên cứu ma thuật. Việc săn bắt quá mức đã khiến chúng tuyệt chủng, nhưng theo báo cáo một số tấm da đã được tìm thấy tại Palmyna ở Grand Gaia.

id: Kulit beast sangat kejam yang tinggal di tanah Agni. Beast yang sangat kejam sehingga resmi diburu sebagai pembuktian kekuatan ksatria. Kulit beast dipenuhi rambut lancip, memberikan perlindungan memuaskan. Dengan improvisasi oleh pembuat zirah terbaik di Kekaisaran Agni, diubah menjadi zirah cantik dan fungsional berkualitas terbaik. Pemimpin negara lain menawarkan emas luar biasa untuk zirah yang terbuat dari kulit ini.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10711_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The pelt of a ferocious beast that resides in the lands of Agni. The extreme ferociousness of this beast led to them being ceremoniously hunted as a way to prove a knight's strength. The beast's pelt is covered with bristly hairs that provide excellent protection, but with improvisation by the best armor craftsmen in the Agni Empire, they've been transformed into beautiful yet functional armor of the highest quality. It's said that rulers of other countries have offered exorbitant amounts of gold in exchange for armor made from these pelts.

raw.en: The pelt of a ferocious beast that resides in the lands of Agni. The extreme ferociousness of this beast led to them being ceremoniously hunted as a way to prove a knight's strength. The beast's pelt is covered with bristly hairs that provide excellent protection, but with improvisation by the best armor craftsmen in the Agni Empire, they've been transformed into beautiful yet functional armor of the highest quality. It's said that rulers of other countries have offered exorbitant amounts of gold in exchange for armor made from these pelts.
raw.es: La piel de una bestia feroz que vive en el reino de Agní. A causa de la ferocidad extrema que estas bestias poseían, los caballeros comenzaron a cazarlas para demostrar su valía. La piel de la bestia está cubierta con un pelaje erizado que brinda una gran protección. Gracias a la improvisación de los mejores armeros del imperio Agní, estas pieles han sido convertidas en armaduras funcionales de una calidad exquisita. Se dice que los gobernantes de otras naciones han ofrecido cantidades de oro exorbitantes a cambio de una armadura hecha con estas pieles.
raw.id: Kulit beast sangat kejam yang tinggal di tanah Agni. Beast yang sangat kejam sehingga resmi diburu sebagai pembuktian kekuatan ksatria. Kulit beast dipenuhi rambut lancip, memberikan perlindungan memuaskan. Dengan improvisasi oleh pembuat zirah terbaik di Kekaisaran Agni, diubah menjadi zirah cantik dan fungsional berkualitas terbaik. Pemimpin negara lain menawarkan emas luar biasa untuk zirah yang terbuat dari kulit ini.
raw.pt: O couro de uma besta feroz que vive nas terras de Agni. A extrema ferocidade dessa besta levou-as a serem caçadas cerimoniosamente como forma de provar a força de um cavaleiro. O couro da besta é coberto por pelos ouriçados que fornecem excelente proteção, mas com algumas improvisações por parte dos melhores artesãos do Império Agni, era transformado em belas porém funcionais armaduras da maior qualidade. Dizem que os governantes de outros países ofereciam quantias exorbitantes de ouro em troca de armaduras feitas com este couro.
raw.th: หนังของสัตว์ที่ดุร้ายซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ในดินแดนแห่งแอ็กนี่ ความดุร้ายอย่างมากของเจ้าสัตว์ตัวนี้ ทำให้มันถูกล่าเพื่อเป็นวิธีพิสูจน์ความแข็งแกร่งของเหล่าอัศวิน หนังของสัตว์ตัวนี้ปกคลุมด้วยคนที่ทอประกายซึ่งสามารถช่วยในการป้องกันได้อย่างดีเยี่ยม แต่ด้วยการพัฒนาของช่างทำเกราะที่เก่งที่สุดในจักรวรรดิแอ็กนี่ พวกมันถูกเปลี่ยนเป็นเกราะที่สวยแต่ก็ยังทำหน้าที่ป้องกันได้อย่างเต็มประสิทธิภาพ ว่ากันว่าผู้ปกครองของประเทศอื่นๆ ได้เสนอทองมากมายก่ายกองเพื่อแลกเปลี่ยนกับเกราะที่ทำจากหนังชนิดนี้
raw.vi: Tấm da của một con quái thú hung dữ sinh sống ở những vùng đất của Agni. Tính dã man tàn bạo của con quái thú này đã khiến chúng bị săn bắn theo phong trào như một cách để chứng minh sức mạnh của một hiệp sĩ. Tấm da của con thú được bao phủ bởi những cọng lông tua tủa mang lại khả năng bảo vệ tuyệt vời, nhưng với ngẫu hứng từ những thợ rèn áo giáp tốt nhất trong Đế chế Agni, chúng đã được chuyển đổi thành áo giáp xinh đẹp đầy đủ chức năng với chất lượng cao nhất. Nghe đồn rằng những kẻ đứng đầu các nước khác đã đề nghị số vàng cực lớn để đổi lấy bộ áo giáp được làm từ những tấm da này.

id: Kontras dengan penampakannya, sayap setan Reduhark sangat fleksibel dan mudah dipotong oleh berbagai senjata yang diedarkan para dewa. Jika satu sayap dipotong, otomatis memproduksi kegelapan yang mengental di mana pun ia mendarat, jadi tidak mungkin kabur dari setan ini. Merupakan material yang sangat langka, siapa pun yang mau sayap utuh dari setan ini, harus mengalahkan ia sepenuhnya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10712_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In contrast to their appearance, the wings of the demon Reduhark are very flexible and can be easily cut by the kinds of weapons that the gods tend to circulate. However, if a wing were to be cut off, it immediately produces darkness that coagulates wherever it lands, perhaps making it impossible to flee from this demon. Being an extremely rare material, whoever wants to get his hands on a full wing from this demon will have to take him down in his entirety.

raw.en: In contrast to their appearance, the wings of the demon Reduhark are very flexible and can be easily cut by the kinds of weapons that the gods tend to circulate. However, if a wing were to be cut off, it immediately produces darkness that coagulates wherever it lands, perhaps making it impossible to flee from this demon. Being an extremely rare material, whoever wants to get his hands on a full wing from this demon will have to take him down in his entirety.
raw.es: En contraste con su apariencia, las alas del demonio Reduhark son muy flexibles y se pueden cortar fácilmente por las armas que los dioses suelen usar. Sin embargo, si alguien le cortara un ala a este demonio, inmediatamente produciría una oscuridad que coagularía donde aterrice, lo que hace que quizá sea imposible escapar de este demonio. Al ser un material extremadamente raro, quien quiera conseguir un ala completa de este demonio tendrá que derribarlo entero.
raw.id: Kontras dengan penampakannya, sayap setan Reduhark sangat fleksibel dan mudah dipotong oleh berbagai senjata yang diedarkan para dewa. Jika satu sayap dipotong, otomatis memproduksi kegelapan yang mengental di mana pun ia mendarat, jadi tidak mungkin kabur dari setan ini. Merupakan material yang sangat langka, siapa pun yang mau sayap utuh dari setan ini, harus mengalahkan ia sepenuhnya.
raw.pt: Em contraste com a aparência, as asas do demônio Reduhark são muito flexíveis e podem ser cortadas facilmente pelas armas que os deuses costumam usar. Porém, se uma asa fosse cortada, ela imediatamente produz uma escuridão que coagula onde cair, talvez tornando impossível a fuga desse demônio. Sendo um material extremamente raro, quem puser as mãos em uma asa completa do demônio terá que destruí-lo por completo.
raw.th: ในทางตรงกันข้ามกับลักษณะของพวกมัน ปีกของปีศาจเรดูฮาร์คนั้นยืดหยุ่นมากและสามารถถูกตัดได้อย่างง่ายดายโดยอาวุธที่เหล่าเทพเจ้ามีแนวโน้มจะเผยแพร่ อย่างไรก็ตาม หากปีกถูกตัดออก มันจะสร้างความมืดทันทีซึ่งจะจับทุกอย่างที่มันสัมผัสโดน อาจจะทำให้เป็นไปไม่ได้ที่จะหนีจากปีศาจตนนี้ ด้วยความที่เป็นวัตถุดิบซึ่งหายากมากๆ ใครก็ตามที่ต้องการจะได้ปีกเต็มๆ จากปีศาจนี้มาครองจะต้องจัดการมันในร่างเต็มตัว
raw.vi: Trái ngược với vẻ ngoài, cánh của quỷ Reduhark rất mềm dẻo và có thể dễ dàng cắt được bằng các loại vũ khí mà các vị thần có xu hướng phổ biến rộng rãi. Tuy nhiên, nếu một chiếc bị cắt rời, nó ngay lập tức tạo ra bóng tối tụ lại bất cứ nơi đâu nó rớt xuống, có thể khiến việc chạy trốn khỏi con quỷ này là không thể. Là một vật liệu cực hiếm, bất kỳ ai muốn có được cánh tay trên chiếc cánh đầy đủ từ con quỷ này sẽ phải hạ gục nó hoàn toàn.

id: Suhu naga berbaju api ini tinggi. Suhu sisik kulitnya bisa menyebabkan kulit manusia terluka bakar parah dalam hitungan sepersekian detik. Bahkan kulit ini punya kemampuan mempertahankan suhu panas meski si naga sudah mati. Jika ingin memakai material ini untuk peralatan, mungkin hasilnya bagus. Tapi penaklukan naga ini bukan tugas yang mudah.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10713_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The fire clad dragon's temperature is unusually high. The temperature of the scales that its skin is covered in can cause severe burns on the frail skin of a human in a split second. Even more surprisingly, this skin has the ability to maintain the same temperature even after the dragon has died. If one were to implement this material into making equipment, it would probably have wonderful results. The subjugation of this dragon, however, is no easy task.

raw.en: The fire clad dragon's temperature is unusually high. The temperature of the scales that its skin is covered in can cause severe burns on the frail skin of a human in a split second. Even more surprisingly, this skin has the ability to maintain the same temperature even after the dragon has died. If one were to implement this material into making equipment, it would probably have wonderful results. The subjugation of this dragon, however, is no easy task.
raw.es: La temperatura del dragón cubierto de llamas es extrañamente alta. En cuestión de segundos, la temperatura de las escamas con las que está cubierta su piel pueden causar quemaduras graves en la frágil piel humana. Es incluso más sorprendente que esta piel tenga la habilidad de mantener la misma temperatura incluso cuando el dragón ha muerto. Está claro que si alguien implementara este material para crear equipamiento, los resultados serían sorprendentes. Sin embargo, subyugar al dragón no es tarea fácil.
raw.id: Suhu naga berbaju api ini tinggi. Suhu sisik kulitnya bisa menyebabkan kulit manusia terluka bakar parah dalam hitungan sepersekian detik. Bahkan kulit ini punya kemampuan mempertahankan suhu panas meski si naga sudah mati. Jika ingin memakai material ini untuk peralatan, mungkin hasilnya bagus. Tapi penaklukan naga ini bukan tugas yang mudah.
raw.pt: A temperatura do dragão flamejante é inesperadamente alta. A temperatura das escamas que cobrem sua pele pode causar queimaduras graves na frágil pele humana em apenas um décimo de segundo. Ainda mais surpreendente, essa pele tem a habilidade de manter a mesma temperatura mesmo após a morte do dragão. Se este material fosse utilizado para fazer equipamento, certamente os resultados seriam maravilhosos. Porém, subjugar o dragão não é nada fácil.
raw.th: อุณหภูมิของเกราะไฟมังกรนั้นสูงเกินกว่าปกติ อุณหภูมิของเกล็ดที่ปกคลุมผิวหนังของมันสามารถทำให้เกิดแผลไหม้บนผิวหนังมนุษย์ได้ในเสี้ยววินาที ที่น่าประหลาดใจกว่านั้น หนังนี้มีความสามารถที่จะคงอุณหภูมิเอาไว้แม้แต่หลังจากที่มังกรได้ตายไป ถ้าหากใครจะนำวัตถุดิบชิ้นนี้มาสร้างเป็นอุปกรณ์  มันคงจะได้รับผลที่ยอดเยี่ยม แต่อย่างไรก็ตาม การปราบปรามมังกรตัวนี้ ไม่ใช่งานที่ง่ายเลย
raw.vi: Nhiệt độ của con rồng phủ lửa cao bất thường. Nhiệt độ của những chiếc vảy phủ trên da nó có thể khiến làn da yếu ớt của con người bị bỏng nặng trong tích tắc. Ngạc nhiên hơn nữa, tấm da này có khả năng duy trì nhiệt độ đó ngay cả sau khi con rồng đã chết. Nếu một người định dùng nguyên liệu này để chế tạo thiết bị, thì nó có thể mang lại kết quả tuyệt vời. Tuy nhiên, chinh phục con rồng này không phải nhiệm vụ dễ dàng gì.

id: Di kulit mulus naga bersinar ada sayap mikro mirip file yang mengelilinginya. Ada anggota Pembunuh Setan yang membawa pulang kulit ini, menggosokkan baja, dan secara tidak sengaja mempertajam si baja. Meski dipercaya kulit ini membantu naga bergerak lebih cepat di air, seperti kulit ikan, melalui eksperimen terbukti bahwa kulit ini bisa dipakai sebagai senjata mengerikan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10714_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: On the smooth skin of the shining dragon there are file-like micro scales that extend all around it. Once some of the members of the Demon Slayers took this pelt home to examine it, they rubbed steel against it, and accidentally ended up sharpening the steel. Though it had been believed that this skin served to help the dragon move more rapidly in water, like the skin of a fish, it was proven through this experiment that it could also be used as a terrible weapon.

raw.en: On the smooth skin of the shining dragon there are file-like micro scales that extend all around it. Once some of the members of the Demon Slayers took this pelt home to examine it, they rubbed steel against it, and accidentally ended up sharpening the steel. Though it had been believed that this skin served to help the dragon move more rapidly in water, like the skin of a fish, it was proven through this experiment that it could also be used as a terrible weapon.
raw.es: Sobre la suave piel del dragón brillante hay microescamas ígneas que se extienden hacia todas partes. En una oportunidad, algunos miembros de los Exterminadores de demonios examinaron este cuero. Frotaron acero contra él y, accidentalmente, el metal quedó más afilado. Si bien se cree que esta piel hacía que el dragón se moviera más rápido bajo el agua, como las escamas de un pescado, este experimento probó que podría usarse como un arma terrible.

Ada anggota Pembunuh Setan yang membawa pulang kulit ini, menggosokkan baja, dan secara tidak sengaja mempertajam si baja. Meski dipercaya kulit ini membantu naga bergerak lebih cepat di air, seperti kulit ikan, melalui eksperimen terbukti bahwa kulit ini bisa dipakai sebagai senjata mengerikan.
raw.pt: Na pele suave do dragão brilhante há pequenas micro escamas por todo lado. Quando alguns matadores de demônios levaram essa pele para casa para ser examinada, a esfregaram com aço, que acabou sendo afiado por acidente. Apesar de se acreditar que esta pele servia para ajudar o dragão a se mover mais rápido na água, como a pele de um peixe, foi provado com esse experimento que ela também poderia ser usada como uma arma terrível.
raw.th: บนผิวเรียบของมังกรส่องแสงมีเกล็ดขนาดเล็กเหมือนตะไบที่ขยายไปทั่วตัวของมัน ครั้งหนึ่งมีสมาชิกบางส่วนของมือสังหารปีศาจได้นำหนังนี้กลับมาบ้านและตรวจสอบมัน พวกเขาถูเหล็กกับมันและบังเอิญจบลงด้วยการเหลาจนเหล็กคม แม้ที่ผ่านมาจะเชื่อว่าผิวหนังนี้ช่วยให้มังกรเคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างต่อเนื่องในน้ำคล้ายกับผิวหนังของปลา แต่มันถูกพิสูจน์ผ่านการทดลองนี่ว่ามันสามารถนำมาใช้เป็นอาวุธที่น่ากลัวได้
raw.vi: Trên làn da mịn màng của con rồng hào quang, có những chiếc vảy rất nhỏ xếp thành hàng trên khắp cơ thể nó. Xưa kia một số thành viên của đội Sát thủ diệt ma đã mang tấm da này về nhà để nghiên cứu, họ cọ sát thép vào tấm da này và vô tình đã mài sắc thép. Mặc dù người ta tin rằng bộ da này là để giúp con rồng di chuyển nhanh hơn trong nước, giống như da cá, nhưng nó cũng được chứng minh qua thí nghiệm này rằng nó có thể được sử dụng như một vũ khí khủng khiếp.

id: Granomus bepergian di bawah air secara menyamar, tiba-tiba muncul di kaki seseorang. Sudah menjadi misteri sejak lama bagaimana monster ini bisa tahu cara memunculkan diri tanpa memakai mata atau telinga. Ada anggota Pembunuh Setan yang membawa pulang kulit ini, dan menemukan bahwa si monster bisa bergerak dengan merasakan vibrasi melalui kulitnya. Menurut data baru, cangkang kristal makhluk ini punya kemampuan merasakan kekuatan sihir, meski belum ada demonstrasinya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10715_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Granomus travels underwater in disguise, appearing suddenly underneath one's feet. It has been a mystery for some time as to how this monster knows where to show himself without the use of his eyes nor ears. Once the Demon Slayers took a lot of this material home with them, they discovered that the monster can move by sensing vibrations through its skin. According to newly collected data, the crystallized shell of this creature has the ability of sensing magical powers, though no demonstrations of this have been given as of yet.

raw.en: Granomus travels underwater in disguise, appearing suddenly underneath one's feet. It has been a mystery for some time as to how this monster knows where to show himself without the use of his eyes nor ears. Once the Demon Slayers took a lot of this material home with them, they discovered that the monster can move by sensing vibrations through its skin. According to newly collected data, the crystallized shell of this creature has the ability of sensing magical powers, though no demonstrations of this have been given as of yet.
raw.es: Granomus viaja bajo el agua oculto y aparece de repente bajo los pies de las personas. Todavía se desconoce cómo hace este monstruo para saber cuándo aparecer sin usar los ojos ni las orejas. Cuando los Exterminadores de demonios estudiaron una gran cantidad de este material, descubrieron que el monstruo se puede mover por las vibraciones que siente en la piel. Según datos recolectados recientemente, el caparazón cristalizado de esta criatura tiene la habilidad de percibir poderes mágicos, si bien todavía no se han dado demostraciones de este hecho.

Sudah menjadi misteri sejak lama bagaimana monster ini bisa tahu cara memunculkan diri tanpa memakai mata atau telinga. Ada anggota Pembunuh Setan yang membawa pulang kulit ini, dan menemukan bahwa si monster bisa bergerak dengan merasakan vibrasi melalui kulitnya. raw.pt: Granomus viaja por baixo d’água em disfarce, aparecendo do nada sob os pés. Foi um mistério por muito tempo, como este monstro sabia aonde se mostrar sem usar seus olhos ou orelhas. Quando os matadores de demônios levaram um lote desse material para casa, descobriram que o monstro podia sentir fibrações pela pele. De acordo com os novos dados, o casco cristalizado da criatura tem a habilidade de sentir poderes mágicos, embora não tenha sido feita uma única demonstração.
raw.th: กราโนมัสเดินทางแฝงตัวอยู่ใต้น้ำ และปรากฎตัวขึ้นทันทีเมื่ออยู่ใต้เท้า มันเป็นเรื่องลึกลับมาสักพักแล้วว่ามอนสเตอร์ตัวนี้รู้ได้อย่างไรว่าจะต้องโผล่มาเมื่อไหร่ โดยไม่ใช้ดวงตาหรือหูของมันเลย ครั้งหนึ่งนักสังหารปีศาจได้นำวัตถุดิบขนิดนี้หลายชิ้นกลับบ้านไปกับพวกเขา พวกเขาค้นพบว่ามอนสเตอร์สามารถเคลื่อนไหวโดยการสัมผัสแรงสั่นสะเทือนผ่านทางผิวหนังของมัน ตามที่ข้อมูลซึ่งได้มาล่าสุด เปลือกคริสตัลของสัตว์ชนิดนี้มีอำนาจที่จะสัมผัสถึงพลังเวทย์ แต่กระนั้นก็ยังไม่มีการจัดการแสดงผลงานนี้แต่อย่างใด
raw.vi: Granomus ngụy trang đi dưới nước, đột ngột xuất hiện dưới chân ai đó. Việc làm cách nào con quái vật này biết được nơi cần hiện hình mà không sử dụng mắt cũng như tai từ lâu vẫn là một bí ẩn. Khi Sát thủ diệt ma mang rất nhiều nguyên liệu này về nhà, họ phát hiện ra rằng quái vật có thể di chuyển bằng cách cảm nhận rung động qua da của nó. Theo dữ liệu mới thu thập được, lớp vỏ tinh thể của sinh vật này có khả năng cảm nhận sức mạnh ma thuật, mặc dù cho đến bây giờ không có bằng chứng nào cho vấn đề này được đưa ra.

id: Telah dikonfirmasi bahwa kulit Granomus berubah warna sesuai lingkungannya tinggal. Dulu dipercaya untuk kamuflase perlindungan, tapi sekarang karena Granomus merasakan sihir di sekitarnya melalui kulit kristalnya, dan beradaptasi sesuai lingkungan, termasuk tanah, mineral, es, tanaman. Singkatnya, kulit kristal ini memiliki sifat elemen berbeda sesuai warnanya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10716_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It has been confirmed that the skin of Granomus changes color depending on the many environments it chooses to live in. It was simply believed to be protective camouflage, but now many think that this is the result of Granomus sensing magic from its surroundings through its crystallized skin, and consequently adapting to the neighboring environment, including soil, minerals, ice, and plants. In short, this crystallized skin holds different elemental properties depending on its color.

raw.en: It has been confirmed that the skin of Granomus changes color depending on the many environments it chooses to live in. It was simply believed to be protective camouflage, but now many think that this is the result of Granomus sensing magic from its surroundings through its crystallized skin, and consequently adapting to the neighboring environment, including soil, minerals, ice, and plants. In short, this crystallized skin holds different elemental properties depending on its color.
raw.es: Se ha confirmado que la piel de Granomus cambia de color según el ambiente en el que elije vivir. Simplemente se creía que esta piel era una especie de camuflaje protector. Sin embargo, ahora hay muchos que piensan que es el resultado de la habilidad de Granomus de sentir la magia de los alrededores a través de su piel cristalizada para, consecuentemente, adaptarse a los ambientes vecinos, como la tierra, los minerales, el hielo y las plantas. En resumen, esta piel cristalizada tienen propiedades elementales diferentes según su color.
