id: Samaran  hewan kuno, sebening kaca, berkilau dengan warna memukau. Rumornya, samaran ini datang dari makhluk ilusi kuno yang punya kemampuan lenyap dalam sekejap. Hanya pemburu kuno yang sangat ahli yang bisa membunuhnya. Ada yang bilang semacam kuda, tapi tak ada yang bisa mengenalinya. Begitu dibunuh, tubuhnya terbakar menjadi abu, hanya meninggalkan samaran berkilaunya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800003_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The hide of an ancient creature clear as a mirror, but which glimmers with immense colors. There had been rumors that the hide had come from an illusive creature of old that had the ability to vanish in an instant, rendering only the most skilled ancient hunters able to kill one. Some say it had been some sort of horse, but no one has been able to identify it. Once killed, its body incinerates to ashes leaving behind only its shiny hide.

raw.en: The hide of an ancient creature clear as a mirror, but which glimmers with immense colors. There had been rumors that the hide had come from an illusive creature of old that had the ability to vanish in an instant, rendering only the most skilled ancient hunters able to kill one. Some say it had been some sort of horse, but no one has been able to identify it. Once killed, its body incinerates to ashes leaving behind only its shiny hide.
raw.es: La piel de una criatura ancestral. Es clara como un espejo y brilla con diferentes colores. Los rumores dicen que esta piel viene de una criatura ilusoria de antaño que tiene la habilidad de desaparecer en un instante. Solo los cazadores ancestrales más experimentados podían cazarla. Algunos dicen que fue una especie de caballo, pero nadie fue capaz de identificarlo. Cuando muere, su cuerpo se prende fuego, se reduce a cenizas y solo queda esta piel.
raw.id: Samaran  hewan kuno, sebening kaca, berkilau dengan warna memukau. Rumornya, samaran ini datang dari makhluk ilusi kuno yang punya kemampuan lenyap dalam sekejap. Hanya pemburu kuno yang sangat ahli yang bisa membunuhnya. Ada yang bilang semacam kuda, tapi tak ada yang bisa mengenalinya. Begitu dibunuh, tubuhnya terbakar menjadi abu, hanya meninggalkan samaran berkilaunya.
raw.pt: A pele de uma criatura antiga, límpida como um espelho, mas com brilho de muitas cores. Há vários rumores de que a pele vinha de uma criatura furtiva da antiguidade que tinha a habilidade de desaparecer em um segundo. Só os caçadores antigos mais habilidosos conseguiam matar uma. Alguns dizem que era um tipo de cavalo, mas ninguém é capaz de identificar. Depois de morrer, seu corpo se transforma em cinzas, deixando apenas sua pele brilhante.
raw.th: แผ่นหนังของสัตว์โบราณ ใส่เหมือนกระจกแต่ส่องประกายด้วยสีเข้มข้น  มีข่าวลือว่าหนังนี้มาจากสัตว์ในจินตนาการจากเมื่อครั้งโบราณที่มีความสามารถในการหายตัวได้ในทันที มีเพียงแค่นักล่ายอดฝีมือสมัยโบราณเท่านั้นที่จะสามารถฆ่าพวกมันได้สักตัว บ้างก็ว่ามันเป็นม้าชนิดหนึ่ง แต่ก็ไม่มีใครสามารถยืนยันได้ เมื่อถูกฆ่าแล้วร่างของมันจะเผาไหม้เป็นเถ้าถ่านเหลือไว้แค่เพียงหนังที่เงางามของมันเท่านั้น
raw.vi: Lớp da của một sinh vật cổ đại, trong suốt như gương nhưng lấp lánh vô số màu sắc. Nghe đồn rằng lớp da này là của một sinh vật hư ảo ngày xưa có khả năng tan biến ngay lập tức. Chỉ có những tay thợ săn cổ lão cực kỳ tinh thông mới có thể giết chết nó. Một số người nói sinh vật này tựa như một loài ngựa, nhưng chẳng ai có thể nhận biết được nó. Sau khi bị giết thân thể sinh vật này sẽ bùng cháy thành tro tàn chỉ để lại lớp da bóng loáng của nó.

id: Cuilan tanduk unicorn, mengandung sifat sihir dan obat. Para pembuat ramuan menumbuknya untuk obat penyembuh, para tukang elemen memanterakan ke aksesoris dan senjata dengan energinya untuk menambah hoki dan berkat.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800004_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Chipped off from a unicorn's horn, this shard holds magical and medicinal properties. Herbalists grind it for medicine to cure diseases, while elemental craftsmen enchant accessories and weapons with its energy for increased luck and blessings.

raw.en: Chipped off from a unicorn's horn, this shard holds magical and medicinal properties. Herbalists grind it for medicine to cure diseases, while elemental craftsmen enchant accessories and weapons with its energy for increased luck and blessings.
raw.es: Este fragmento de cuerno de unicornio tiene propiedades mágicas y medicinales. Los herboristas lo muelen para crear una medicina, mientras que los herreros elementales encantan accesorios y armas con su energía con el objetivo de conseguir suerte y bendiciones.
raw.id: Cuilan tanduk unicorn, mengandung sifat sihir dan obat. Para pembuat ramuan menumbuknya untuk obat penyembuh, para tukang elemen memanterakan ke aksesoris dan senjata dengan energinya untuk menambah hoki dan berkat.
raw.pt: Vindo do chifre quebrado de um unicórnio, o fragmento possui propriedades mágicas e medicinais. Herbalistas moem o chifre para fabricar medicamentos que curam doenças, enquanto artesãos de elementos encantam acessórios e armas com a energia dele para obter mais sorte e bênção.
raw.th: สะเก็ดจากเขาของยูนิคอร์น ชิ้นส่วนนี้มีคุณสมบัติทางเวทย์และการรักษา นักสมุนไพรบดมันเพื่อทำยารักษาขณะที่นักประดิษฐ์ธาตุเสริมพลังเครื่องประดับกับอาวุธด้วยพลังงานของมันเพื่อช่วยเพิ่มโชคและพร
raw.vi: Được lấy ra từ một chiếc sừng kỳ lân, mảnh vỡ này nắm giữ các đặc tính phép thuật và chữa bệnh. Các thầy lang chuyên dùng thảo dược sẽ xay nó ra làm thuốc để chữa bệnh trong khi các thợ thủ công lành nghề sẽ dùng bùa chú tăng cường may mắn và phước lành cho các phụ kiện và vũ khí bằng năng lượng của nó.

id: Cuilan tanduk minotaur, mengandung aura energi intens. Katanya menyentuhnya terllau lama akan memengaruhi suasana hati dan temperamen. Beberapa seniman dan tukang menggunakan energi intensnya untuk memperkuat zirah dan senjata.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800005_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Chipped off from a minotaur's horn, the shard holds an aura of intense energy. It is said that being in contact with it for too long can affect one's mood and temper. Some artisans and craftsmen use its intense energy to strengthen armor and weapons.

raw.en: Chipped off from a minotaur's horn, the shard holds an aura of intense energy. It is said that being in contact with it for too long can affect one's mood and temper. Some artisans and craftsmen use its intense energy to strengthen armor and weapons.
raw.es: Este fragmento de cuerno de minotauro tiene un aura con mucha energía. Se dice que si uno pasa demasiado tiempo con este objeto, el ánimo y el temperamento de la persona pueden cambiar. Algunos artesanos y herreros usan su intensa fuerza para mejorar armaduras y armas.
raw.id: Cuilan tanduk minotaur, mengandung aura energi intens. Katanya menyentuhnya terllau lama akan memengaruhi suasana hati dan temperamen. Beberapa seniman dan tukang menggunakan energi intensnya untuk memperkuat zirah dan senjata.
raw.pt: Vindo do chifre quebrado de um minotauro, o fragmento possui uma aura de energia intensa. Dizem que o contato prolongado com o fragmento pode afetar o temperamento e o humor da pessoa. Alguns artesãos usam sua energia intensa para fortalecer armaduras e armas.
raw.th: สะเก็ดจากเขามิโนทอร์ ชิ้นส่วนนี้มีกลิ่นอายของพลังที่รุนแรง ว่ากันว่าการได้สัมผัสกับมันเป็นเวลานานเกินไปสามารถเกิดผลกับอารมณ์และความโกรธของคนๆ นั้นได้ ช่างฝีมือและนักประดิษฐ์บางคนได้พลังที่รุนแรงของมันเพื่อเพิ่มความแข็งแกร่งให้กับอาวุธและชุดเกราะ
raw.vi: Được lấy ra từ một chiếc sừng quái đầu trâu, mảnh vỡ này chứa đựng hào quang năng lượng cực kỳ mãnh liệt. Người ta nói rằng nếu ai tiếp xúc với nó quá lâu có thể ảnh hưởng đến tâm trạng và tính khí của người đó. Một số nghệ nhân và thợ thủ công lại sử dụng năng lượng mãnh liệt của nó để gia cường cho áo giáp và vũ khí.

id: Adamit dapat ditemukan di gua bawah tanah dan katanya memiliki energi misterius yang diperkuat inti bumi. Sangat awet dan sering ditambang untuk membuat zirah perang meski proses menggali bumi sangatlah berbahaya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800006_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Adamite can be found in the depths of underground caverns, and is said to possess a mysterious energy harnessed from the earth's core. It is extremely durable and often mined for crafting battle armor, even though it is often hazardous to traverse deep into the earth.

raw.en: Adamite can be found in the depths of underground caverns, and is said to possess a mysterious energy harnessed from the earth's core. It is extremely durable and often mined for crafting battle armor, even though it is often hazardous to traverse deep into the earth.
raw.es: La adamita se puede encontrar en las cavernas subterráneas. Se dice que posee una misteriosa energía extraída del núcleo terrestre. Es extremadamente resistente y a menudo se la mina para crear armaduras de batalla. Sin embargo, a veces es peligroso adentrarse en lo profundo de la tierra.
raw.id: Adamit dapat ditemukan di gua bawah tanah dan katanya memiliki energi misterius yang diperkuat inti bumi. Sangat awet dan sering ditambang untuk membuat zirah perang meski proses menggali bumi sangatlah berbahaya.
raw.pt: A adamita pode ser encontrada nas profundezas de cavernas subterrâneas e dizem que ela possui uma energia misteriosa absorvida do núcleo da terra. É extremamente durável e é minerada com frequência para a produção de armaduras de batalha, mesmo que normalmente seja perigoso ir até o fundo da terra.
raw.th: อะดาไมท์สามารถพบได้ลึกลงไปในถ้ำใต้ดินและว่ากันว่ามันมีพลังงานลึกลับที่รวบรวมมาจากแกนของโลก มันมีความทนทานมากและมันจะถูกขุดมาใช้สำหรับประดิษฐ์เกราะต่อสู้ แม้ว่ามันมักจะเป็นอันตรายในการสำรวจลึกลงไปใต้ดิน
raw.vi: Thạch anh Adamite có thể tìm được thấy ở sâu thẳm các hang động dưới lòng đất và được cho là sở hữu một thứ năng lượng bí ẩn lấy từ lõi trái đất. Nó cực kỳ bền và thường được dùng để chế tạo chiến giáp mặc dù cũng rất nguy hiểm khi đi sâu vào lòng đất.

id: Bintang jatuh meledak melalui langit, membentur permukaan tanah dengan sangat kuat sehingga remuk menjadi debu. Para penyihir dan penyembuh sering memanennya karena berisi energi kosmis yang amat menyempurnakan karya mereka. Orang awam menyimpannya dalam botol sebagai berkat dari langit.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800007_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: As falling stars blaze through the heavens, they smash into the land's surface with such force that they disintegrate into fine dust. Conjurers and healers often harvest it, as it contains cosmic energy that can greatly enhance their craft. Common folk keep it in a bottle as a blessing from the heavens.

raw.en: As falling stars blaze through the heavens, they smash into the land's surface with such force that they disintegrate into fine dust. Conjurers and healers often harvest it, as it contains cosmic energy that can greatly enhance their craft. Common folk keep it in a bottle as a blessing from the heavens.
raw.es: Las estrellas fugaces atraviesan los cielos y caen con tanta fuerza sobre la tierra que se desintegran y quedan convertidas en polvo. Los conjuradores y sanadores a menudo recogen este polvo porque contiene energías cósmicas que fortalecen muchísimo su trabajo. La gente común guarda el polvo en una botella como una bendición de los cielos.
raw.id: Bintang jatuh meledak melalui langit, membentur permukaan tanah dengan sangat kuat sehingga remuk menjadi debu. Para penyihir dan penyembuh sering memanennya karena berisi energi kosmis yang amat menyempurnakan karya mereka. Orang awam menyimpannya dalam botol sebagai berkat dari langit.
raw.pt: Quando as estrelas cadentes atravessam os céus, elas caem na superfície com tanta força que se desintegram, virando um pó muito fino. Feiticeiros e curandeiros normalmente coletam este pó, já que ele contém energias cósmicas que melhorariam muito seus trabalhos. Pessoas comuns mantêm o pó em uma garrafa como símbolo de bênção do paraíso.
raw.th: ขณะที่ดาวตกลุกโชนผ่านสวรรค์ มันกระแทกเข้ากับพื้นผิวด้วยพลังรุนแรงจนพวกมันสลายเป็นฝุนผง หมอผีและผู้รักษามักเก็บพวกมันไปใช้เพราะว่าพวกมันมีพลังงานจักรวาลอยู่ซึ่งสามารถเสริมพลังให้กับสิ่งประดิษฐ์ของพวกนั้นอย่างมาก คนทั่วไปจะพกมันไว้ในสนามรบเพื่อเป็นพรจากสรรค์
raw.vi: Khi các ngôi sao băng cháy rực xuyên qua các tầng trời, chúng lao xuống mặt đất với một lực khủng khiếp như vậy khiến chúng tan rã thành bụi nhuyễn. Các pháp sư và thầy thuốc thường thu lượm chúng bởi trong đó có chứa năng lượng vũ trụ giúp ích rất nhiều cho nghề của họ. Dân gian thường lưu giữ nó trong một chiếc chai như là điềm lành do trời cao ban xuống.

id: Air murni, diisi sihir bulan sepanjang langit malam yang jernih. Ada legenda: bulan purnama menatap bayangannya sendiri pada permukaan air, terpana akan keindahannya, diam-diam mentransfer rohnya ke bayangannya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800010_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Clear water infused with lunar energy throughout a long, clear night sky. There is a legend of the full moon staring at its own reflection on the stagnant water surface. Mesmerized by its own beauty, it silently transferred some of its spirit into its own reflection.

raw.en: Clear water infused with lunar energy throughout a long, clear night sky. There is a legend of the full moon staring at its own reflection on the stagnant water surface. Mesmerized by its own beauty, it silently transferred some of its spirit into its own reflection.
raw.es: Agua pura, insuflada con magia lunar.
raw.id: Air murni, diisi sihir bulan sepanjang langit malam yang jernih. Ada legenda: bulan purnama menatap bayangannya sendiri pada permukaan air, terpana akan keindahannya, diam-diam mentransfer rohnya ke bayangannya.
raw.pt: Água limpa, infundida com energia da lua em uma longa noite de céu claro. Há uma lenda de que a lua cheia, vendo seu reflexo em uma superfície de água parada, hipnotizada por sua própria beleza, transferiu em silêncio parte de seu espírito para o reflexo.
raw.th: น้ำใส ผสมกับพลังงานจัทราผ่านท้องฟ้ายามค่ำคืนอันยาวนาน มีตำนานเกี่ยวกับจันทร์เพ็ญ ที่จ้องมองเงาสะท้อนของตัวเองบนพื้นผิวน้ำที่นิ่งเรียบ เพลิดเพลินกับความงามของตัวเอง และโอนถ่ายวิญญาณบางส่วนของมันลงไปที่เงาสะท้อนของมันเอง
raw.vi: Nước trong vắt, được hấp thu nguyệt năng Có truyền thuyết về mặt trăng tròn, khi nhìn chằm chằm vào ảnh phản chiếu của mặt trăng trên mặt nước tù đọng, bị mê hoặc bởi vẻ đẹp của trăng, âm thầm truyền linh hồn vào ảnh phản chiếu của nó.

id: Kantong bumbu biasanya disiapkan oleh pedagang dan penjaja keliling, berisi berbagai bahan dan bumbu memasak. Sering diperdagangkan dengan petualang sebagai kebutuhan perjalanan atau membumbui makanan sebelum sampai ke tujuan. Makan enak baik untuk pikiran dan jiwa!
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800011_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Spice pouches are usually prepared by travelling merchants and peddlers, filled with various cooking ingredients and seasoning. They are often traded to adventurers as a travelling necessity for spicing up their meals while traversing for days outfield before reaching their destination. Having a good meal is great for the mind and soul!

raw.en: Spice pouches are usually prepared by travelling merchants and peddlers, filled with various cooking ingredients and seasoning. They are often traded to adventurers as a travelling necessity for spicing up their meals while traversing for days outfield before reaching their destination. Having a good meal is great for the mind and soul!
raw.es: Una bolsa llena de especias para cocinar.
raw.id: Kantong bumbu biasanya disiapkan oleh pedagang dan penjaja keliling, berisi berbagai bahan dan bumbu memasak. Sering diperdagangkan dengan petualang sebagai kebutuhan perjalanan atau membumbui makanan sebelum sampai ke tujuan. Makan enak baik untuk pikiran dan jiwa!
raw.pt: Bolsas de temperos são geralmente preparadas por mercadores viajantes e mascates, com vários ingredientes culinários e temperos. Elas são geralmente comerciadas a aventureiros como necessidade de viagem para temperar suas refeições ao atravessarem o campo por dias antes de chegarem a seu destino. Uma boa refeição é importante para a mente e a alma!
raw.th: กระเป๋าเครื่องปรุงปกติจะถูกใช้โดยพ่อค้านักเดินทางหรือหาบเร่ เต็มไปด้วยเครื่องปรุ่งและวัตถุดิบต่างๆ พวกมันมักจะถูกใช้แลกเปลี่ยนกับนักเดินทางในฐานะของใช้จำเป็นสำหรับปรุงแต่งอาหารขณะเดินทางเป็นเวลาหลายวันจนกว่าจะถึงที่หมาย การมีอาหารที่อร่อยไว้ทานย่อมดีต่อจิตใจและวิญญาณ!
raw.vi: Túi gia vị luôn được chuẩn bị bởi các nhà buôn đi xa và người bán rong, chứa các nguyên liệu nấu ăn và gia vị khác nhau. Những túi gia vị này thường được bán cho các nhà thám hiểm như một món đồ cần thiết để thêm gia vị cho bữa ăn khi băng qua những cánh đồng trống trong nhiều ngày trước khi đến đích. Thưởng thức một bữa ăn ngon sẽ thật tuyệt cho trí óc và tâm hồn!

id: Jenis kunang-kunang yang muncul setiap tahub selama purnama penuh, tertarik oleh energi bulan intens dari langit malam. Sinar kuningnya yang misterius katanya adalah bentuk komunikasi melalui bidang bintang yang dihuni kesadaran bulan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800012_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This typical type of firefly emerges every year during the fullest moon, attracted to the intense lunar energies projected from the night sky. Their mysterious yellow glow is rumored to be some sort of communication through the astral field where the moon's consciousness resides.

raw.en: This typical type of firefly emerges every year during the fullest moon, attracted to the intense lunar energies projected from the night sky. Their mysterious yellow glow is rumored to be some sort of communication through the astral field where the moon's consciousness resides.
raw.es: Un tipo de luciérnaga que brilla de un color amarillento como la luna.
raw.id: Jenis kunang-kunang yang muncul setiap tahub selama purnama penuh, tertarik oleh energi bulan intens dari langit malam. Sinar kuningnya yang misterius katanya adalah bentuk komunikasi melalui bidang bintang yang dihuni kesadaran bulan.
raw.pt: Essa espécie típica de vagalume aparece todo ano durante a lua mais cheia, atraído pelas intensas energias lunares projetadas do céu noturno. Seu misterioso brilho amarelado é supostamente um tipo de comunicação pelo campo astral, onde reside a consciência da lua.
raw.th: หิ่งห้อยชนิดนี้จะโผล่ออกมาทุกๆ ปีในช่วงที่พระจันทร์เต๋มดวง เพราะถูกดึงดูดโดยพลังงานจันทราที่รุนแรงซึ่งถูกฉายมาจากท้องฟ้าในยามค่ำคืน แสงสีเหลืองลึกลับของมันถูกลือกันว่าเป็นการสื่อสารบางประเภทผ่านทางทุ่งแห่งดวงดาวที่ซึ่งสติของดวงจันทร์พำนักอยู่
raw.vi: Loại đom đóm đặc trưng này xuất hiện hàng năm vào những đêm trăng rằm, bị thu hút bởi nguyệt năng cường độ cao phát ra từ bầu trời đêm. Người ta đồn rằng ánh sáng màu vàng bí ẩn của chúng là một loại liên lạc nào đó thông qua trường tinh tú nơi tiềm thức của mặt trăng trú ngụ.

id: Bara abadi katanya tiba-tiba muncul secara mistis dalam waktu-waktu tertentu saat energi bintang melimpah di udara. Bisa dipindahkan oleh tubuh dan objek fisik. Bara misterius menarik auranya dari dimensi alternatif yang berisi energi tanpa batas di seluruh Pusaran. Beberapa petualang memakainya sebagai sumber cahaya karena kilau redup yang tidak menarik perhatian.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800013_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Undying flames are said to combust mystically out of nowhere during certain times of the year when astral energies in the air are overwhelming. They can be shifted and moved by physical bodies and objects. These mysterious flames draw their aura from alternate dimensions that are filled with unlimited amounts of energy across the Vortex. Some adventurers prefer it as a light source due to its dim glow that doesn't attract attention.

raw.en: Undying flames are said to combust mystically out of nowhere during certain times of the year when astral energies in the air are overwhelming. They can be shifted and moved by physical bodies and objects. These mysterious flames draw their aura from alternate dimensions that are filled with unlimited amounts of energy across the Vortex. Some adventurers prefer it as a light source due to its dim glow that doesn't attract attention.
raw.es: Una llama eterna que no quema ni arde.
raw.id: Bara abadi katanya tiba-tiba muncul secara mistis dalam waktu-waktu tertentu saat energi bintang melimpah di udara. Bisa dipindahkan oleh tubuh dan objek fisik. Bara misterius menarik auranya dari dimensi alternatif yang berisi energi tanpa batas di seluruh Pusaran. Beberapa petualang memakainya sebagai sumber cahaya karena kilau redup yang tidak menarik perhatian.
raw.pt: Dizem que chamas imorredouras aparecem misticamente durante certas épocas do ano, quando as energias astrais no ar são fortes. Elas podem ser movidas e alteradas por corpos físicos e objetos. Essas chamas misteriosas puxam sua aura de dimensões paralelas que são preenchidas com quantias ilimitadas de energia através do Vórtice. Alguns aventureiros a preferem como fonte de luz, já que seu brilho fraco não atrai atenção.
raw.th: เปลวไฟอมตะที่ว่ากันว่าลุกไหม้ขึ้นมาอย่างลี้ลับจากความว่างเปล่าระหว่างบางช่วงของปีเมื่อพลังงานดวงดาวในอากาศมีอย่างท่วมท้น พวกมันสามารถถูกเปลี่ยนรูปและเคลื่อนย้ายได้ร่างกายและวัตถุ เปลวไฟลึกลับเหล่านี้วาดรัศมีของพวกมันจากมิติอื่นที่เต็มไปด้วยปริมาณที่ไม่จำกัดของพลังงานในวังวน นักเดินทางบางคนต้องการมันเพื่อใช้เป็นแหล่งกำเนิดแสงเนื่องจากแสงสลัวของมันจะไม่ดึงดูดความสนใจจากสัตว์ร้าย
raw.vi: Tương truyền rằng ngọn lửa vĩnh cửu cháy ra một cách huyền bí từ hư không trong những khoảng thời gian nhất định trong năm khi mà năng lượng tinh tú tràn ngập trong không khí. Chúng có thể được chuyển dịch và di chuyển bởi những cơ thể và đối tượng vật chất. Những ngọn lửa huyền bí này rút được khí chất từ những chiều không gian thay thế chứa đầy năng lượng với số lượng không hạn chế trên khắp Vortex. Một số nhà thám hiểm thích dùng nó làm nguồn sáng do ánh sáng lờ mờ của nó sẽ không thu hút sự chú ý.

id: Saat Pusaran muncul melalui pemanggilan dan melintasi bidang pemanggil, aura elemen memberikan energi tetesan di sekitarnya sehingga bersinar dalam kemurniannya. Jarang ditemukan, tapi memiliki kekuatan menyegarkan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800014_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: As the Vortex emerges through summonings and the crossing of planes by Summoners, its elemental aura energizes the droplets around it, causing their purity to shimmer. They are hard to come by, but are said to have revitalizing powers.

raw.en: As the Vortex emerges through summonings and the crossing of planes by Summoners, its elemental aura energizes the droplets around it, causing their purity to shimmer. They are hard to come by, but are said to have revitalizing powers.
raw.es: Gota formada del rocío desde donde emerge el Vórtice.
raw.id: Saat Pusaran muncul melalui pemanggilan dan melintasi bidang pemanggil, aura elemen memberikan energi tetesan di sekitarnya sehingga bersinar dalam kemurniannya. Jarang ditemukan, tapi memiliki kekuatan menyegarkan.
raw.pt: À medida que o Vórtice emerge pelas invocações e o cruzamento dos planos pelos invocadores, sua aura elemental energiza as gotículas à sua volta, fazendo com que brilhem de pureza. É difícil encontrá-las, mas dizem que elas possuem poderes revitalizantes.
raw.th: เมื่อวังวนโผล่ขึ้นมาผ่านการอัญเชิญและการข้ามแนวราบของซัมมอนเนอร์ รัศมีของธาตุเพิ่มพลังหยดน้ำรอบ ๆ มันทำให้พวกมันเปล่งประกายระยับในความบริสุทธิ์ของพวกมัน ยากที่จะพบเจอพวกมัน แต่กล่าวกันว่ามันมีพลังในการฟื้นฟูอยู่
raw.vi: Khi Vortex hiện ra thông qua triệu hồi và hiện lên bởi người triệu hồi, bộ cấp năng lượng tinh tú mạnh mẽ của nó khiến những giọt nước quanh nó tỏa sáng lung linh trong sự tinh khiết. Chúng rất khó kiếm, nhưng được cho rằng có sức mạnh hồi sinh.

id: Tulang terkutuk biasanya ditemukan di dekat tempat tinggal si jahat. Pahlawan atau orang biasa sama saja, terkutuk dan ditandai maut.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Cursed bones are usually found near places where powerful evils reside. Once belonging to heroes and commoners alike, they are now what remains of the cursed and marked for death.

raw.en: Cursed bones are usually found near places where powerful evils reside. Once belonging to heroes and commoners alike, they are now what remains of the cursed and marked for death.
raw.es: A los huesos posesos generalmente se los encuentra en lugares donde residen poderosos seres malignos. Antaño héroes y campesinos por igual, malditos y marcados para morir.
raw.id: Tulang terkutuk biasanya ditemukan di dekat tempat tinggal si jahat. Pahlawan atau orang biasa sama saja, terkutuk dan ditandai maut.
raw.pt: Ossos malditos são geralmente encontrados perto de lugares com males poderosos. Outrora heróis e plebeus, amaldiçoados e marcados para a morte.
raw.th: กระดูกต้องสาปมักจะถูกพบใกล้กับสถานที่ ที่ปีศาจร้ายทรงพลังอาศัยอยู่ ครั้งหนึ่งผู้กล้าและพวกคนธรรมดา ถูกสาปและทำเครื่องหมายสำหรับความตาย
raw.vi: Xương bị nguyền thường được tìm thấy gần nơi ma quỷ uy lực ẩn náu. Anh hùng và thường dân cũng vậy, đều bị nguyền rủa và tuyên án tử.

id: Tetes jahat dari makhluk gelap yang kuat. Memperkuat esensi nakal, takut, gila, dan bodoh.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800101_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A drop of evil that comes from a powerful dark being. It harnesses the essence of mischief, fear, insanity and folly.

raw.en: A drop of evil that comes from a powerful dark being. It harnesses the essence of mischief, fear, insanity and folly.
raw.es: Una gota proveniente de un poderoso ser oscuro. Es la esencia de las travesuras, el miedo, la demencia y la locura.
raw.id: Tetes jahat dari makhluk gelap yang kuat. Memperkuat esensi nakal, takut, gila, dan bodoh.
raw.pt: Uma gota de perversidade, caída de um poderoso ser maligno. Ela contém a essência do medo, insanidade, maldade e insensatez.
raw.th: หยดแห่งความชั่วร้ายที่มาจากสิ่งมีชีวิตแห่งความมืดที่ทรงพลัง มันมีความเข้มข้นของความชั่วร้าย ความกลัว ความบ้าคลั่ง และ ความขลาดเขลา
raw.vi: Vật rơi lại của quỷ dữ đến từ thế lực hắc ám mạnh mẽ, nó khai thác bản chất của sự tàn độc, sợ hãi, sự cuồng dại và điên rồ.

id: Debu penuh esensi jahat, abu sisa makhluk jahat yang tadinya kuat.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800102_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Dust filled with evil essence, the burnt remains of a once powerful evil being.

raw.en: Dust filled with evil essence, the burnt remains of a once powerful evil being.
raw.es: Polvo contaminado con esencia maldita. Son los restos quemados de un ser maléfico de antaño.
raw.id: Debu penuh esensi jahat, abu sisa makhluk jahat yang tadinya kuat.
raw.pt: Pó cheio de essência vil, os restos queimados de um poderoso ser maligno.
raw.th: ผงที่เต็มไปด้วยความชั่วร้ายเข้มข้น ซากเผาไหม้ของอดีตสิ่งมีชีวิตแห่งความมืดที่ทรงพลัง
raw.vi: Đống bụi chứa đầy tinh lực quỷ dữ, phần còn lại bị thiêu cháy của một ác quỷ từng rất cường đại.

id: Keping salju yang bersinar dengan kilau biru. Energi mistis mengelilinginya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A snow flake that shines softly with a blue glow. Mystical energy surrounds it.

raw.en: A snow flake that shines softly with a blue glow. Mystical energy surrounds it.
raw.es: Un carámbano que irradia un leve brillo azul. Lo rodea una energía mística.
raw.id: Keping salju yang bersinar dengan kilau biru. Energi mistis mengelilinginya.
raw.pt: Um floco de neve que brilha suavemente na cor azul. Cercado de energia mística.
raw.th: เกล็ดหิมะที่ส่องแสงสีฟ้านวล มีพลังงานลึกลับล้อมรอบมัน
raw.vi: Bông tuyết tỏa sáng dịu nhẹ với ánh sáng xanh. Năng lượng bí ẩn bao quanh nó

id: Keping kristal ini adalah hasil kondensasi beberapa keping salju mistis. Bersinar biru dan memiliki aura energi misterius di sekelilingnya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800201_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: These crystal shards are the work of condensing mystical Snow Flakes together. They glow blue and have an aura of mysterious energy surrounding them.

raw.en: These crystal shards are the work of condensing mystical Snow Flakes together. They glow blue and have an aura of mysterious energy surrounding them.
raw.es: Estos fragmentos cristalinos se fabricaron condensando carámbanos místicos. Emiten un brillo azul y los rodea un aura de energía misteriosa.
raw.id: Keping kristal ini adalah hasil kondensasi beberapa keping salju mistis. Bersinar biru dan memiliki aura energi misterius di sekelilingnya.
raw.pt: Esses fragmentos de cristais são o resultado da condensação dos flocos de neve místicos. Eles brilham na cor azul e têem uma estranha aura de energia.
raw.th: เศษคริสตัลเหล่านี้เป็นผลงานของการควบแน่นเกล็ดหิมะเข้าด้วยกัน พวกมันส่องแสงสีฟ้าและมีออร่าของพลังงานลึกลับล้อมรอบมันอยู่
raw.vi: Những mảnh pha lê này là tác phẩm của các bông tuyết thần bí kết lại với nhau. Chúng tỏa ra ánh sáng xanh và có hào quang năng lượng bí ẩn xung quanh nó.

id: Permata salju dibuat dengan susah payah, menyintesis kristal salju dengan presisi ekstrim. Teknik yang dipakai untuk memotong batu kristal yang sudah didinginkan memantulkan sinar seakan bersinar sendiri. Bahan berharga yang dicari para magi es.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800202_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Snow Gemstones are crafted through the tedious work of synthesizing Snow Crystals with extreme precision. The technique used to cut these chilled crystal stones causes them to reflect light as if they illuminate themselves. A precious material sought by ice mages.

raw.en: Snow Gemstones are crafted through the tedious work of synthesizing Snow Crystals with extreme precision. The technique used to cut these chilled crystal stones causes them to reflect light as if they illuminate themselves. A precious material sought by ice mages.
raw.es: Las gemas níveas se crean a través de un tedioso proceso: sintetizar cristales níveos con una precisión extrema. Debido a las técnicas usadas para cortar estos cristales, las heladas piedras reflejan la luz como si ellas mismas la estuvieran irradiando. Material precioso y adorado por los magos de hielo.
raw.id: Permata salju dibuat dengan susah payah, menyintesis kristal salju dengan presisi ekstrim. Teknik yang dipakai untuk memotong batu kristal yang sudah didinginkan memantulkan sinar seakan bersinar sendiri. Bahan berharga yang dicari para magi es.
raw.pt: Gemas da neve são feitas através de um processo tedioso, que sintetiza cristais com extrema precisão. A técnica usada para cortar esses cristais resfriados fazem com que ele reflita luz como se estivesse se iluminando. Um material precioso procurado pelos magos do gelo.
raw.th: หินอัญมณีหิมะถูกประดิษฐ์ขึ้นผ่านการสังเคราะห์ที่วุ่นวายของคริสตัลหิมะกับความแม่นยำอย่างสุดขีด เทคนิคที่ใช้เพื่อตัดหินคริสตัลเย็นเหล่านี้ทำให้มันสะท้อนแสงราวกับว่ามันเปล่งออกมาด้วยตนเอง เป้นวัตถุดิบล้ำค่าที่ถูกตามหาโดยนักเวทย์น้ำแข็ง
raw.vi: Đá quý băng tuyết được chế tác thông qua quá trình tẻ nhạt kết các pha lê tuyết lại với nhau với độ chính xác cực kỳ cao. Kỹ thuật được sử dụng để cắt những viên đá đông lạnh thành pha lê này khiến nó phản chiếu ánh sáng như thể tự nó chiếu sáng. Vật liệu quý giá được tìm kiếm bởi các pháp sư băng

id: Di siang hari saat matahari keluar dan agak mencairkan es serta salju, tiba-tiba angin salju bertiup dan badai cepat membekukan embun yang mencair ini. Ladang sihir misterius rawa ini kemudian menyimpan embun beku agar tidak mencair lagi.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800203_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: During the day when the sun comes out and melts the ice and snow a little, sudden gusts of chilling storm winds flash freeze these melting dews. The mysterious and magical ice glades then keep the frozen dew from melting ever again.

raw.en: During the day when the sun comes out and melts the ice and snow a little, sudden gusts of chilling storm winds flash freeze these melting dews. The mysterious and magical ice glades then keep the frozen dew from melting ever again.
raw.es: Durante el día, cuando el sol aparece y derrite el hielo y la nieve, ráfagas repentinas de vientos y tormentas de nieve congelan estos rocíos. Los misteriosos campos mágicos de los claros evitan luego que el rocío congelado se vuelva a derretir.
raw.id: Di siang hari saat matahari keluar dan agak mencairkan es serta salju, tiba-tiba angin salju bertiup dan badai cepat membekukan embun yang mencair ini. Ladang sihir misterius rawa ini kemudian menyimpan embun beku agar tidak mencair lagi.
raw.pt: Durante o dia, quando o sol sai e derrete um pouco o gelo e o sol, ventanias de ventos gelados e tempestades-relâmpago congelam o orvalho. Os misteriosos campos mágicos das clareiras continuam impedindo que o orvalho congelado se derretam novamente.
raw.th: ในระหว่างวัน เมื่อพระอาทิตย์ออกมาและละลายน้ำแข็งกับหิมะเล้กน้อย ลมกรรโชกและพายุกระทันหันแช่แข็งหยดน้ำที่ละลายพวกนี้ ทุ่งเวทมนตร์ลึกลับแห่งทุกกว้างจึงได้กักเก็บหยดน้ำแข็งจากการละลายอีกครั้งหนึ่ง
raw.vi: Trong ngày khi mặt trời mọc và làm tan một chút băng tuyết, những gió và bão tuyết bất ngờ hiện ra đóng băng những giọt sương đang tan chảy này. Những dải rừng thưa ma thuật bí ẩn giữ cho giọt sương đóng băng khỏi tan chảy lại.

id: Jantung beku langka dan hanya ditemukan pada makhluk yang subur di tanah dingin. Selama mereka bertahan, jantungnya perlahan mengkristal, mengubah mereka menjadi makhluk dingin dan keji. Pemburu Arktik tertawa atas ironi makhluk keji yang memiliki jantung cantik. Untuk jantung beku berkilau dengan keindahan mistis.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800204_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Frozen hearts are rare to find, and can only be found on creatures that thrive in harsh, cold lands. For as long as they have survived, their hearts have slowly crystalized, changing them into cold and vicious creatures. Arctic hunters laugh at the irony of vicious creatures having a beautiful heart, for frozen hearts glimmer with a mystical beauty.

raw.en: Frozen hearts are rare to find, and can only be found on creatures that thrive in harsh, cold lands. For as long as they have survived, their hearts have slowly crystalized, changing them into cold and vicious creatures. Arctic hunters laugh at the irony of vicious creatures having a beautiful heart, for frozen hearts glimmer with a mystical beauty.
raw.es: Los corazones gélidos son raros, y solo se pueden hallar en las criaturas que merodean las zonas más frías y severas. Durante el transcurso de sus vidas, los corazones se les fueron cristalizando, lo que las convirtió en criaturas frías y feroces. Los cazadores árticos se ríen de la ironía de que criaturas tan feroces tengan corazones hermosos. Los corazones gélidos brillan con una belleza mística.
raw.id: Jantung beku langka dan hanya ditemukan pada makhluk yang subur di tanah dingin. Selama mereka bertahan, jantungnya perlahan mengkristal, mengubah mereka menjadi makhluk dingin dan keji. Pemburu Arktik tertawa atas ironi makhluk keji yang memiliki jantung cantik. Untuk jantung beku berkilau dengan keindahan mistis.
raw.pt: Corações gelados são difíceis de achar, e só podem ser encontrados em criaturas que vivem em condições de frio agressivo. Enquanto sobrevivem, seus corações cristalizam aos poucos, transformando-as em criaturas frias e ferozes. Caçadores do ártico acham graça na ironia em criaturas ferozes tendo um coração tão belo. Pois os corações gelados brilham com beleza mística.
raw.th: หัวใจแช่แข็งนั้นหาได้ยากและสามารถพบได้ในสิ่งมีชีวิตที่เจริญเติบโตในดินแดนหนาวเย็นอย่างรุนแรงเท่านั้น ตราบเท่าที่พวกมันมีชีวิตอยู่ หัวใจจะค่อยๆ ตกผลึกอย่างช้า เปลี่ยนพวกมันให้เป็นสิ่งมีชีวิตที่เย็นชาและดุร้าย นายพรานทุ่งน้ำแข็งหัวเราะให้กับเรื่องน่าขำที่ว่าสัตว์ดุร้ายนั้นกลับมีหัวใจที่สวยงาม เพราะว่าโฟรเซ่นฮาร์ทนั้นเปล่งประกายด้วยความงามที่ลึกลับ
raw.vi: Trái tim băng giá hiếm có thể tìm được và chỉ có thể tìm thấy trên những sinh vật sing sống được ở những vùng đất lạnh lẽo khắc nghiệt. Chúng đã sống sót được rất lâu, trái tim của chúng dần dần kết tinh, biến đổi chúng thành những sinh vật lạnh lùng và độc ác. Các thợ săn Bắc Cực cười mỉa mai các sinh vật độc ác có trái tim đẹp đẽ. Trái tim băng giá lấp lánh một vẻ đẹp huyền bí.

id: Katanya saat makhluk wafat, jiwa meninggalkan tubuh menuju dimensi dan tempat lain. Beberapa jiwa yang dikutuk dan dijebak oleh penguasa rahasia mereka sebelum mati, tidak mampu menebus diri sendiri. Selamanya terjebak dan beku abadi.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800205_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: They say that when beings have passed on, their souls leave their bodies to another dimension and place. But some souls that have been cursed and trapped by powerful arcane masters before death are not able to redeem themselves, remaining imprisoned and frozen for eternity.

raw.en: They say that when beings have passed on, their souls leave their bodies to another dimension and place. But some souls that have been cursed and trapped by powerful arcane masters before death are not able to redeem themselves, remaining imprisoned and frozen for eternity.
raw.es: Dicen que cuando los seres mueren, sus almas abandonan el cuerpo que las refugiaba y viajan a otra dimensión. Pero algunas almas no pueden redimirse, ya que han sido maldecidas y encerradas por poderosos maestros arcanos antes de morir. Quedan congeladas y atrapadas durante la eternidad.
raw.id: Katanya saat makhluk wafat, jiwa meninggalkan tubuh menuju dimensi dan tempat lain. Beberapa jiwa yang dikutuk dan dijebak oleh penguasa rahasia mereka sebelum mati, tidak mampu menebus diri sendiri. Selamanya terjebak dan beku abadi.
raw.pt: Dizem que quando os seres partem, suas almas deixam seu corpo para irem a outro lugar e dimensão. Mas algumas almas foram amaldiçoadas e presas por poderosos mestres arcanos, antes da morte, não consegue se redimir. Para sempre trancadas ae congeladas.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าเมื่อสิ่งมีชีวิตตายไป วิญญาณของพวกนั้นจะละจากร่างกายไปสู่อีกภพภูมิ แต่วิญญาณบางดวงที่ถูกสาปและกักเอาไว้ด้วยเจ้าแห่งเวทมนตร์ก่อนที่จะตาย ไม่สามารถแลกตัวเองได้ ถูกกักตลอดไปและแช่แข็งตลอดกาล
raw.vi: Họ nói rằng khi những sinh vật chết đi, linh hồn của chúng rời khỏi xác vào một chiều không gian và địa điểm khác. Nhưng một số linh hồn đã bị nguyền rủa và bị mắc kẹt bởi các pháp sư quyền lực trước khi chết sẽ không thể chuộc thân. Mãi mãi bị mắc kẹt và đóng băng vĩnh viễn.

id: Batu aspirasi adalah batu permata yang berisi elemen tak diketahui yang sangat cantik. Dibuat dan diberkati oleh para dewa dan tersebar di seluruh dunia. Sangat berharga dan banyak yang mau membayar harga tinggi untuk mendapatkannya karena percaya bahwa batu ini akan memberinya keberuntungan besar. Para perajin katanya membuat mereka menajadi artefak kuat dengan bahan yang tepat.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_800207_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Aspiration stones are enchanted gemstones of an unknown element which bear immense beauty. It is rumored that they are synthesized and blessed by the gods themselves, eventually scattered by them across the lands. They are of valuable worth and many are willing to pay a high price to get one, believing that possessing the item brings great luck. Craftsmen are known to synthesize them into powerful artifacts with the right ingredients.

raw.en: Aspiration stones are enchanted gemstones of an unknown element which bear immense beauty. It is rumored that they are synthesized and blessed by the gods themselves, eventually scattered by them across the lands. They are of valuable worth and many are willing to pay a high price to get one, believing that possessing the item brings great luck. Craftsmen are known to synthesize them into powerful artifacts with the right ingredients.
raw.es: Las piedras de la aspiración son gemas encantadas y pertenecen a un elemento desconocido que posee una belleza inmensa. Se rumora que los mismísimos dioses las sintetizaron y las bendijeron, y que están diseminadas por el mundo. Tienen un valor altísimo y muchos están dispuestos a pagar fortunas para hacerse con una, pues piensan que quien porte una de ellas tendrá la suerte asegurada. Se sabe que los artesanos son capaces de sintetizarlas en poderosos artefactos con los ingredientes adecuados.
raw.id: Batu aspirasi adalah batu permata yang berisi elemen tak diketahui yang sangat cantik. Dibuat dan diberkati oleh para dewa dan tersebar di seluruh dunia. Sangat berharga dan banyak yang mau membayar harga tinggi untuk mendapatkannya karena percaya bahwa batu ini akan memberinya keberuntungan besar. Para perajin katanya membuat mereka menajadi artefak kuat dengan bahan yang tepat.
raw.pt: Pedras de aspiração são joias encantadas com elementos desconhecidos que guardam imensa beleza. Há rumores de que são sintetizadas e abençoadas pelos próprios deuses e foram espalhadas pelas terras. Elas são muito valorizadas e muitos estão dispostos a pagar um alto preço por uma delas, acreditando que elas trazem sorte. Artesãos são conhecidos por sintetizá-las em poderosos artefatos com os ingredientes corretos.
raw.th: แอสพเรชั่นสโตนเป็นหินอัญมณีเวทมนตร์ที่ไม่รู้ธาตุซึ่งมีความงดงามเป็นอย่างมาก ลือกันว่าพวกมันสังเคราะห์และถูกมอบให้จากเทพเจ้าโดยตรงและถูกกระจายไปทั่วทุกิดนแดน พวกมันมีมูลค่าและผู้คนมากมายยินยอมที่จะจ่ายราคาสูงเพื่อให้ได้มาสักอันโดยเชื่อว่า การได้ครอบครองมันจะนำโชคมหาศาลมาให้ ช่างฝีมือมักจะสังเคราะห์พวกมันให้กลายเป็นสิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่ทรงพลังด้วยวัตถุดิบที่เหมาะสม
raw.vi: Đá khát vọng là những viên đá quý yểm phép thuật của một yếu tố chưa biết mang vẻ đẹp bao la. Người ta đồn rằng chúng được chính các vị thần tổng hợp và ban phước và nằm rải rác khắp các vùng đất. Chúng rất có giá trị và nhiều người sẵn sàng trả giá cao để có được một viên với hy vọng nó sẽ mang lại thật nhiều may mắn. Người ta biết rằng các thợ thủ công tổng hợp chúng thành những đồ tạo tác đầy sức mạnh với thành phần phù hợp.

raw.th: เถาวัลย์จากพืชกินคนลึกลับที่เรียกกันว่าราชินีซิปล้า มันมีความแข็งแรง ยืดหยุ่นสูง ไม่สามารถใช้มีดธรรมดาตัดให้ขาดได้ ว่ากันว่านักผจญภัยที่ตกเป็นเหยื่อของราชินีซิปล้า เบื้องต้นจะถูกพันธนาการการเคลื่อนไหวก่อนถูกกินเป็นอาหาร วัตถุดิบนี้ไม่เพียงมีมูลค่าสูง แต่ยังนำมาใช้ในผลิตภัณฑ์ครัวเรือนเป็นรายวันด้วย
raw.vi: A vine from the mysterious carnivorous plant known as the Queen Sipla. Extremely sturdy and boasting of abnormal elasticity, this vine cannot be cut by a regular blade. It is said that many of the adventurers that have fallen prey to the Queen Sipla are first robbed of their ability to move by these vines before they are eaten. This material is not only treasured for its role in making hefty arms, but also for its use in making daily household products.

id: Material yang sangat langka, ditemukan di daerah Lem di Ishgria. Berdasarkan bentuknya, dipercaya bahwa ini adalah cakar makhluk, meski tak ada detail yang diketahui tentang ini. Sinar mampu menembus cakar saat memantul di sudut tertentu, jadi spekulasinya adalah makhluk ini juga mampu membuat diirnya transparan. Karena material ini ringan dan awet, maka sangat diburu untuk membuat zirah.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10421_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An extremely rare material found in Ishgria's Lem region. Based on its shape, it is believed to be the claw of some creature, though no further details are known about it. However, light is able to penetrate the claw when it hits it at certain angles, so it is speculated that the creature it belongs to also possesses the ability to make itself transparent. Since this material is light weight but durable, it is highly sought after to make armor.

raw.en: An extremely rare material found in Ishgria's Lem region. Based on its shape, it is believed to be the claw of some creature, though no further details are known about it. However, light is able to penetrate the claw when it hits it at certain angles, so it is speculated that the creature it belongs to also possesses the ability to make itself transparent. Since this material is light weight but durable, it is highly sought after to make armor.
raw.es: Material extremadamente raro que se encuentra en Lem, dentro de Ishgria. Por su forma, se cree que esta garra pertenece a una criatura, aunque no se conocen muchos más detalles sobre ella. Sin embargo, la luz penetra la garra cuando golpea desde ciertos ángulos, por lo que se cree que la criatura a la que pertenece también posee la capacidad de hacerse transparente. Dado que el material es liviano pero durable, muchos la buscan para forjar armaduras.
raw.id: Material yang sangat langka, ditemukan di daerah Lem di Ishgria. Berdasarkan bentuknya, dipercaya bahwa ini adalah cakar makhluk, meski tak ada detail yang diketahui tentang ini. Sinar mampu menembus cakar saat memantul di sudut tertentu, jadi spekulasinya adalah makhluk ini juga mampu membuat diirnya transparan. Karena material ini ringan dan awet, maka sangat diburu untuk membuat zirah.
raw.pt: Um material extremamente raro encontrado na região de Lem em Ishgria. Com base em sua forma, acredita-se que seja a garra de alguma criatura, embora não se saibam mais detalhes. A luz consegue entrar na garra quando acerta em certos ângulos, então há especulações de que a criatura possuía a habilidade de ficar transparente. Já que este material é leve mas durável, é muito procurado para fazer armaduras.
raw.th: วัตถุดิบที่หายากจากอิชเกรีย เล็ม คาดว่าเป็นกรงเล็บของสัตว์ชนิดหนึ่ง แต่ยังไม่มีข้อมูลที่แน่นอน อย่างไรก็ตาม แสงสามารถผ่านมายังมันได้เมื่อตกกระทบตามมุมที่ถูกต้อง ฉะนั้นจึงตั้งข้อสงสัยว่าสัตว์ชนิดนี้นั้นพรางตัวได้ เพราะวัตถุนี้เบาและทนทาน จึงนำมาทำเป็นเสื้อเกราะ
raw.vi: Một chất liệu cực kỳ hiếm có được tìm thấy tại vùng Lem của Ishgria. Dựa vào hình dạng của nó, rất có thể nó là móng vuốt của một sinh vật nào đó, mặc dù không có bất kỳ chi tiết nào cụ thể hơn về nó. Tuy nhiên, ánh sáng có thể chiếu xuyên qua móng vuốt khi nó va chạm tại một góc nào đó, thế nên điều đặc biệt là móng của sinh vật này sở hữu khả năng trở nên trong suốt. Vì vật liệu này khá nhẹ và bền, nó trở thành vật được tìm kiếm nhiều nhất để làm áo giáp.

id: Berkat sifat memurnikan dari sisik Naga Biru Estoreit, laut mana pun yang dihuninya jarang terkena polusi. Namun sifat langka Sisik Terang Estoreit membuat si naga banyak diserang yang meninggalkan limbah habitat si naga. Serangan-serangan ini membuat salah satu sayapnya lepas dan sekarang ia tidak bisa terbang lagi.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10730_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Thanks to the purifying properties of the Azure Dragon Estoreit's scales, any sea it inhabits is seldom polluted. However, it is due to the rare qualities of Estoreit's Light Scales that the dragon has been the target of many attacks that have laid waste upon its habitat. These attacks have caused one of its wings to become detached, and now it cannot fly as freely as it once did.

raw.en: Thanks to the purifying properties of the Azure Dragon Estoreit's scales, any sea it inhabits is seldom polluted. However, it is due to the rare qualities of Estoreit's Light Scales that the dragon has been the target of many attacks that have laid waste upon its habitat. These attacks have caused one of its wings to become detached, and now it cannot fly as freely as it once did.
raw.es: Gracias a las propiedades purificadoras de las escamas de Estoreit, el Dragón Azur, todos los mares que la criatura habita no se están contaminados. Sin embargo, debido a las peculiares cualidades de las escamas claras de Estoreit, el dragón se ha convertido en el objetivo de muchos ataques que han destrozado su hábitat natural. Estos atentados han provocado que una de las alas de la criatura se saliera de su sitio, por lo que Estoreit ahora no puede volar con libertad.
raw.id: Berkat sifat memurnikan dari sisik Naga Biru Estoreit, laut mana pun yang dihuninya jarang terkena polusi. Namun sifat langka Sisik Terang Estoreit membuat si naga banyak diserang yang meninggalkan limbah habitat si naga. Serangan-serangan ini membuat salah satu sayapnya lepas dan sekarang ia tidak bisa terbang lagi.
raw.pt: Graças às propriedades purificadoras das escamas do Dragão Celeste Estoreit, mares habitados por ele raramente são poluídos. Porém, devido às raras qualidades das escamas de luz de Estoreit, o dragão foi alvo de muitos ataques que acabaram com seu hábitat. Estes ataques fizeram com que uma de suas asas caíssem, e agora ele não pode voar como antes.
raw.th: ข้อดีของคุณสมบัติอันบริสุทธิ์อย่างยิ่งของมังกรอาซัว ทำให้ทะเลที่สัตว์ชนิดนี้อาศัยอยู่นั้นบริสุทธิ์ตามไปด้วย อย่างไรก็ตาม เพราะเกล็ดที่มีคุณสมบัติดีมาก ทำให้คนส่วนใหญ่ออกไปสู้กับมังกร ทำให้ที่อยู่ของมังกรถูกรุกราน จากการโจมตีทำให้ปีกมังกรเสียหาย มันจึงไม่สามารถบินได้ดังปกติ
raw.vi: Nhờ những thuộc tính thuần khiết của chiếc vảy Azure Dragon Estoreit, bất cứ sinh vật trên biển nào cũng hiếm khi bị ô nhiễm. Tuy nhiên, điều đó phụ thuộc vào chất lượng hiếm có của chiếc vảy Ánh Sáng Estoreit mà con rồng đã là mục tiêu của nhiều đợt tấn công phí sức của những sinh vật nơi đây. Những cuộc tấn công này đã khiến cho đôi cánh của nó đứt lìa, và giờ nó chẳng còn bay lượn như trước được nữa.

id: Setelah menciptakan ombak berputar di laut, Naga Biru Estoreit meninggalkan banyak Aksesoris Biru mengapung di permukaan air. Kebanyakan lenyap dalam hitungan detik, tapi yang masih ada menjadi objek berkekuatan besar. Kelangkaan aksesoris ini mengundang banyak orang untuk memburunya, tapi Estoreit mengusir manusia yang mendekatinya dengan angin kuat, sehingga susah diperoleh.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_11034_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: After creating whirling tides in the sea, the Azure Dragon Estoreit leaves a lot of Azure Spheres floating on the water's surface. Most of them disappear in a matter of seconds, but those that remain are objects which hold great power. The rarity of these spheres entices many people to search after them, but Estoreit drives away any humans who come near it with powerful windblasts, making them very difficult to obtain.

raw.en: After creating whirling tides in the sea, the Azure Dragon Estoreit leaves a lot of Azure Spheres floating on the water's surface. Most of them disappear in a matter of seconds, but those that remain are objects which hold great power. The rarity of these spheres entices many people to search after them, but Estoreit drives away any humans who come near it with powerful windblasts, making them very difficult to obtain.
raw.es: Luego de crear remolinos en el mar, el Dragón Azul Estoreit deja muchísimas esferas azures sobre la superficie acuática. La mayoría de ellas desaparece en cuestión de segundos, pero las que perduran son objetos de un poder descomunal. La rareza de estas esferas despierta el lado aventurero de la gente, que deciden ir a buscarlas. Sin embargo, Estoreit espanta a todos los humanos que se acercan con poderosas ráfagas. Las esferas, debido a esto, son muy difíciles de obtener.
raw.id: Setelah menciptakan ombak berputar di laut, Naga Biru Estoreit meninggalkan banyak Aksesoris Biru mengapung di permukaan air. Kebanyakan lenyap dalam hitungan detik, tapi yang masih ada menjadi objek berkekuatan besar. Kelangkaan aksesoris ini mengundang banyak orang untuk memburunya, tapi Estoreit mengusir manusia yang mendekatinya dengan angin kuat, sehingga susah diperoleh.
raw.pt: Depois de criar turbilhões no mar, o Dragão Celeste Estoreit deixa muitas Esferas Celestes boiando na água. A maioria desaparece em segundos, mas as que permanecem são itens extremamente poderosos. A raridade dessas esferas incita muitos a procurá-las, mas Estoreit afasta qualquer humano que chegue perto com suas poderosas rajadas de vento, dificultando a sua obtenção.
raw.th: หลังจากสร้างคลื่นทะเล มังกรอาซัวเอสโทเรทได้สร้างมวลน้ำไว้ที่ผิวน้ำ แต่ก็ระเหยไปในไม่กี่นาที แต่มวลน้ำที่เหลือนั้นมีพลังงานมากมายซ่อนอยู่ ด้วยความสามารถพิเศษนี้ทำให้คนหลายคนออกไปตามหา แต่มังกรก็พยายามขับไล่มนุษย์ออกไปด้วยการสร้างลมพายุขึ้นมา ทำให้การตามเก็บลูกบอลน้ำนี้เป็นไปได้ยาก
raw.vi: Sau khi tạo nên lớp sóng cuộn trào trên biển, Azure Dragon Estoreit đã bỏ lại rất nhiều quả cầu Azure trôi lềnh bềnh trên mặt biển. Hầu hết chúng biến mất sau vài giây ngắn ngủi, nhưng những gì còn lại là các vật thể hàm chứa sức mạnh to lớn. Sự hiếm hoi của những quả cầu này cám dỗ rất nhiều người truy tìm chúng sau này, nhưng Estoreit đã dẹp tất cả những người muốn tiếp cận chúng bằng những trận gió uy lực, gây cho họ không ít khó khăn.

id: Mineral yang ditemukan di tubuh Arkem, Malapetaka dari Kegelapan. Sifatnya tidak solid, mineral ini mudah rusak selagi berada dalam tubuh Arkem. Karena alasan ini, maka susah diperoleh dalam kondisi sempurna, meski fragmennya lebih mungkin didapat. Saat dicarikan, material ini bisa dipakai untuk melapisi senjata dsb. Apa pun yang dilapisi cairan ini akan bersinar merah pudar dan mendapat kekuatan sedikit lebih banyak daripada sebelumnya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_11035_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A mineral found in the body of Arkem, the Calamity from Darkness. Not so solid in nature, this particular mineral can suffer damage quite easily while still in Arkem's body. For this very reason it is quite difficult to obtain one in perfect condition, though obtaining fragments of the same is more plausible. When melted into a liquid state, this material can be used for coating arms and the such. Whatever is coated in this solution glows a faint red color and acquires slightly more strength than before.

raw.en: A mineral found in the body of Arkem, the Calamity from Darkness. Not so solid in nature, this particular mineral can suffer damage quite easily while still in Arkem's body. For this very reason it is quite difficult to obtain one in perfect condition, though obtaining fragments of the same is more plausible. When melted into a liquid state, this material can be used for coating arms and the such. Whatever is coated in this solution glows a faint red color and acquires slightly more strength than before.
raw.es: Mineral que se puede hallar en el cuerpo de Arkem, la Calamidad de la Oscuridad. Este mineral, que no es sólido por naturaleza, puede recibir mucho daño mientras aún está en el cuerpo de Arkem. Por esta mismísima razón, es bastante difícil obtener uno de ellos en condiciones perfectas; lo más probable es conseguir solo fragmentos. Cuando se lo derrite, este material se puede usar para cubrir armas y otros objetos. Todo lo que se bañe con esta solución adquiere un leve color rojizo y más fuerza que antes.
raw.id: Mineral yang ditemukan di tubuh Arkem, Malapetaka dari Kegelapan. Sifatnya tidak solid, mineral ini mudah rusak selagi berada dalam tubuh Arkem. Karena alasan ini, maka susah diperoleh dalam kondisi sempurna, meski fragmennya lebih mungkin didapat. Saat dicarikan, material ini bisa dipakai untuk melapisi senjata dsb. Apa pun yang dilapisi cairan ini akan bersinar merah pudar dan mendapat kekuatan sedikit lebih banyak daripada sebelumnya.
raw.pt: Um mineral encontrado no corpo de Arkem, a Calamidade das Trevas. Pouco sólido por natureza, esse mineral em particular pode sofrer bastante enquanto ainda estiver no corpo de Arkem. Por isso mesmo é bem difícil obter um em boas condições, embora obter seus fragmentos seja mais plausível. Quando derretido para a forma líquida, esse material pode ser usado para cobrir armas e outros materiais. Qualquer coisa que for coberta com essa solução brilha com uma luz vermelha e fica levemente mais forte.
raw.th: แร่ที่พบจากศพของอาร์เคม หายนะแห่งความมืด ไม่ใช่หินที่พบตามธรรมชาติ และเสียหายได้ง่ายในขณะที่อยู่ในร่างของอาร์เคม ด้วยเหตุนี้ การนำแร่ธาตุนี้ออกมาอย่างสมบูรณ์นั้นเป็นไปได้ยากมาก อย่างไรก็ตาม การจะนำชิ้นส่วนหนึ่งออกมานั้นพอมีความเป็นไปได้มากกว่า หากแร่นี้อยู่ในสถานะของเหลว สามารถนำมาชุบเกราะได้ สิ่งใดก็ตามที่ถูกชุบด้วยแร่นี้จะส่องแสงเป็นสีแดง และมีพลังเพิ่มขึ้น
raw.vi: Loại khoáng sản được tìm thấy trên thân thể của Arkem, Tai Họa từ Bóng Tối. Không quá cứng khi để tự nhiên, khoáng thể đặc biệt này có thể chịu được tổn thương dễ dàng ngay cả khi còn trong cơ thể Arkem. Chính bởi lý do này nên rất khó để lấy được chúng trong điều kiện hoàn hảo, dù việc lấy các mẫu tương tự thế có vẻ hợp lý hơn. Khi tan thành thể lỏng, chất liệu này được dùng để phủ cánh tay và vùng tương tự. Bất cứ thứ gì được phủ lên bằng dung dịch này sẽ nhuộm một màu đỏ nhạt và trở nên cứng hơn so với ban đầu.

id: Inti yang ditemukan dalam Arkem, Malapetaka dari Kegelapan. Ini adalah organ yang bisa menjadi sumber kehidupan dan pengatur kekuatan untuk Arkem yang berdaya banyak,  jika menderita kerusakan kecil pun, Arkem tidak akan dapat mengontrol kekuatannya dan akan pecah langsung. Inti ini sangat sulit didapat, namun senjata setan atau senjata biasa yang dibuat dari ini akan memiliki kekuatan mega besar.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_11036_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The core found within Arkem, the Calamity from Darkness. Being the organ that acts both as the life source and the power regulator for the multi-powered Arkem, it is said that if it were to suffer even the most minor amount of damage, it would render Arkem unable to control its powers and cause it to disintegrate on the spot. Needless to say, this core is extremely difficult to obtain, but any demon weapon or regular weapon fashioned from it holds an incredible amount of power.

raw.en: The core found within Arkem, the Calamity from Darkness. Being the organ that acts both as the life source and the power regulator for the multi-powered Arkem, it is said that if it were to suffer even the most minor amount of damage, it would render Arkem unable to control its powers and cause it to disintegrate on the spot. Needless to say, this core is extremely difficult to obtain, but any demon weapon or regular weapon fashioned from it holds an incredible amount of power.
raw.es: El núcleo que se encuentra dentro de Arkem, la Calamidad de la Oscuridad. Como es el órgano que actúa como fuente y regulador de potencia de Arkem, una criatura con tantos poderes, se dice que si fuera a sufrir incluso una cantidad mínima de daño, Arken no podría usar sus poderes y el objeto se desintegrara al acto. No hace falta decirlo, pero este núcleo es extremadamente difícil de conocer, pero cualquier arma normal o demoníaca potenciada con él tendrá una fuerza y una potencia increíbles
raw.id: Inti yang ditemukan dalam Arkem, Malapetaka dari Kegelapan. Ini adalah organ yang bisa menjadi sumber kehidupan dan pengatur kekuatan untuk Arkem yang berdaya banyak,  jika menderita kerusakan kecil pun, Arkem tidak akan dapat mengontrol kekuatannya dan akan pecah langsung. Inti ini sangat sulit didapat, namun senjata setan atau senjata biasa yang dibuat dari ini akan memiliki kekuatan mega besar.
raw.pt: O núcleo encontrado em Arkem, a Calamidade das Trevas. Sendo o órgão que tanto a fonte vital quanto regulador para os múltiplos poderes de Arkem, dizem que se ele sofrer o mínimo dano que for, Arkem não poderia controlar seus poderes e se desintegra na hora. Desnecessário dizer, esse núcleo é extremamente difícil de obter, mas qualquer arma normal ou demoníaca feita com ele possui um poder incrível.
raw.th: แกนกลางของอาร์เคม หายนะแห่งความมืด เพราะเป็นชิ้นส่วนในร่างกายที่ทำหน้าที่คล้ายแหล่งพลังงาน ว่ากันว่า หากแกนนี้ได้รับความเสียหาย จะทำให้อาร์เคมสูญเสียการควบคุมพลัง และทำให้มันสลายหายไป แม้ว่าแกนนี้จะได้มายากมาก แต่อาวุธของปีศาจที่ทำมาจากแกนนี้จะมีพลังมหาศาล
raw.vi: Phần lõi này được tìm thấy bên trong Arkem, Tai Họa từ Bóng Tối. Là một phần cơ thể vừa như nguồn sống vừa phát ra sức mạnh toàn năng cho Arkem, nghe nói rằng nếu nó chịu ngay cả một tổn thương nhỏ, nó sẽ khiến cho Arkem không thể kiểm soát sức mạnh khiến nó phân hủy tại chỗ. Không cần phải nói, sợi dây này cực kỳ khó thu nạp, nhưng bất kỳ vũ khí quái vật hay thông thường nào được trang bị với nó sẽ nắm giữ một sức mạnh to lớn.

id: Batu sangat langka yang ditemukan di Celgrad. Meski bersinar dalam 6 warna indah, kekuatan yang dikandungnya amat mengerikan, dan goncangan kecil bisa membuatnya meledak. Karena itu, harus berhati-hati saat menangani batu, meski kekuatan tak terbayangkan bisa didapat jika berhasil memprosesnya dengan benar. Rumornya, asal batu ini terhubung dengan kekuatan yang dirilis oleh sekelompok setan tertentu.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_11037_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A very rare stone found in Celgrad. Though it shines in six beautiful colors it houses a terrifying amount of power, and the slightest shock it suffers could cause it to explode. Because of this, the utmost care is required when handling the stone, though unfathomable power can be obtained when managing to process it correctly. It is rumored that the origin of this stone is connected to the power released by a certain group of demons.

raw.en: A very rare stone found in Celgrad. Though it shines in six beautiful colors it houses a terrifying amount of power, and the slightest shock it suffers could cause it to explode. Because of this, the utmost care is required when handling the stone, though unfathomable power can be obtained when managing to process it correctly. It is rumored that the origin of this stone is connected to the power released by a certain group of demons.
raw.es: Una piedra muy peculiar encontrada en Celgra. A pesar de que brilla en seis hermosos colores, posee una cantidad de poder abrumadora, y cualquier choque que sufra podría hacerlo estallar. Por esta razón, se necesita tener muchísimo cuidado cuando se mueve la piedra. Si uno logra procesarla de forma correcta, podrá obtener una cantidad inconmensurable de poder. Se rumora que el origen de esta piedra está vinculado al poder liberado por un gran grupo de demonios.
raw.id: Batu sangat langka yang ditemukan di Celgrad. Meski bersinar dalam 6 warna indah, kekuatan yang dikandungnya amat mengerikan, dan goncangan kecil bisa membuatnya meledak. Karena itu, harus berhati-hati saat menangani batu, meski kekuatan tak terbayangkan bisa didapat jika berhasil memprosesnya dengan benar. Rumornya, asal batu ini terhubung dengan kekuatan yang dirilis oleh sekelompok setan tertentu.
raw.pt: Uma pedra muito rara, encontrada em Celgrad. Embora ela brilhe em seis belas cores, também contém uma quantia assustadora de poder, e o menor choque poderia fazê-la explodir. Por causa disso, os maiores cuidados são tomados ao lidar com a pedra, já que poder de limites desconhecidos pode ser obtido ao processá-la corretamente. Há rumores de que a origem dessa pedra está conectada ao poder liberado por um certo grupo de demônios.
raw.th: หินที่หาพบยากมากในเซลกราด แม้ว่ามันจะส่องแสง 6 แสงดูสวยงาม แต่มันก็มีพลังที่น่ากลัวแฝงอยู่และมันระเบิดได้หากกระทบกระเทือนเพียงเล้กน้อย ด้วยเหตุนี้จึงต้องดูแลมันอย่างดี และจะได้รับพลังอย่างมากหากนำหินนี้ไปสกัดอย่างถูกวิธี ว่ากันว่าที่มาของหินนี้นั้นเชื่อมต่อกับพลังงานของกลุ่มปีศาจบางกลุ่ม
raw.vi: Một loại đá quý hiếm được tìm thấy ở Celgrad. Mặc dù phản chiếu sáu màu sắc khác nhau, nó chứa đựng sức mạnh vô cùng đáng sợ, và một sự va chạm nhỏ cũng có thể làm nó phát nổ. Bởi lẽ đó, bắt buộc tuyệt đối cẩn thận khi sử dụng hòn đá này, dù năng lượng bí hiểm của nó có thể thu nạp được khi kiểm soát đúng phương pháp. Nghe đồn rằng nguồn gốc hòn đá này có liên kết với sức mạnh thoát ra từ một nhóm quái vật nào đó.

name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10517_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An extremely rare material that can be occasionally found in Beiorg. Once a month the demon moon glows in a purple hue during the dark of the night, calling forth a pack of ferocious wolves that are said to devour anything in their path. The torn fangs of these wolves are a testimony of their battles against demons, though having hidden demonic powers of their own, these fangs deliver a devastating blow when sunk into their prey.

id: Mata terkristal besar setan yang tinggal di Ishgria. Disebut "Mata Hitam Buatan", mata ini berkemampuan mengubah semua cahaya yang diserapnya menjadi energi. desc: The large crystallized eye of a demon which inhabited Ishgria. Called the "Artificial Black Eye" by some, this eye has the ability to convert any light it absorbs into energy. However, since not much is known about this otherworldly material, it is very difficult to obtain in its purest form.

id: Kutu setan malam yang muncul saat hujan miasma ungu di Wulgee. Saat menemukan mangsanya, kutu ini mengeluarkan sinar setan yang memanggil kilat dari surga. Kilat lalu menyambar targetnya langsung, sehingga mati rasa dan lumpuh setelah merasa sakit awalnya. Lalu kutu memakannya tanpa banyak usaha lagi. Tidak pernah berada di satu tempat terlalu lama, Kutu Miasma selalu bergerak dan mengacau. Banyak yang menyarankan lebih baik lari setelah bertemu, karena konfrontasi sangatlah berbahaya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10909_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A nocturnal demon bug said to appear during the downpours of purple miasma in Wulgee. When it has found its prey, this bug emits a demonic light that calls for lightning from the heavens. The lightning then strikes its target directly, rendering it completely numb and paralyzed after the initial pain, which helps the bug to consume it without much effort. Never in one place for too long, the Miasma Bug is constantly moving and wreaking havoc. Many advise that it's best to run after encountering it, as a confrontation could prove far too dangerous.

desc: A lock of hair from the head of the War Demon Shusui. Its never-fading hue is the vibrant color of fire, and has the ability to psychologically entice the fighting spirit of any who look upon it. It is said that this lock of hair has the ability to awaken the hidden potential of whoever possesses it, rapidly developing their abilities on the battlefield. On the other hand, since Shusui's will still lives within it, its owner is also said to have an unquenchable thirst for fighting strong opponents.

raw.es: Mechón de pelo de la cabeza del Demonio guerrero Shusui. Se dice que este mechón de cabello sirve para despertar el potencial oculto de quien lo posee y para desarrollar rápidamente sus habilidades en el campo de batalla. raw.id: Sejumput rambut dari kepala Dewa Perang Shusui. Warna cerahnya bagaikan api tak pernah pudar, dan memiliki kemampuan secara psikologis untuk mengobarkan semangat juang siapa pun yang melihatnya. Rambut ini juga membangkitkan potensi tersembunyi dari pemiliknya, mengembangkan kemampuan dengan cepat di medan perang. Di sisi lain, karena Shusui masih hidup di dalamnya, pemiliknya juga memiliki kehausan tak terpuaskan untuk melawan musuh yang kuat.
raw.pt: Uma mecha do cabelo do Demônio da Guerra Shusui. Sua forte tonalidade é a cor vibrante do fogo, a tem a habilidade de  atrair psicologicamente o espírito de luta em quem o olha. Dizem que esta mecha de cabelo é capaz de despertar o potencial de quem o possui,  desenvolvendo rapidamente suas habilidades no campo de batalha. Por outro lado, como a vontade de Shusui ainda vive através da mecha, o portador tem uma sede incontrolável de encarar oponentes fortes.
raw.th: ปอยผมจากศีรษะของปีศาจแห่งสงครามชูซูอิ แสงแห่งเปลวไฟของมันไม่เคยมอดดับ และยังมีความสามารถในการเพิ่มพลังจิตวิญญาณแห่งการต่อสู้ให้กับผู้ที่มองมัน ว่ากันว่าปอยผมนี้สามารถปลุกพลังที่ซ่อนอยู่ในตัวของผู้ที่ถือครองมัน และเมื่อต่อสู้ก็จะเพิ่มพลังให้อย่างรวดเร็ว หรืออีกนัยหนึ่งก็คือ ตลอดเวลาที่ชูซูอิมีมัน ก็จะทำให้เขากระหายที่จะต่อสู้กับศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งอยู่ตลอดเวลา

id: Zaman dahulu, ada phoenix merah tua yang cantik, bersumpah melayani seorang dewi. Phoenix memberikan perlindungan ilahi kepada si dewi selama bertahun-tahun sampai satu setan muncul dari dunia lain dan menghabisi si dewi. Gila penuh kemarahan, si Phoenix memburu si setan ke dunianya, dan membalas dendam dengan dibayar kedua sayapnya sendiri. Tidak bisa terbang, si Phoenix tidak dapat pulang ke rumah, terpaksa hidup sendirian di dunia setan sampai hanya tersisa tulangnya yang berwarna cerah.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10820_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A long time ago, there was a beautiful crimson phoenix which had pledged its service to a goddess. The phoenix granted its divine protection to the goddess over the span of many years, until a demon appeared from another world and ended the goddess's life. Mad with anger, the Phoenix pursued the demon back to its world, and achieved vengeance in exchange for both of its own wings. Unfortunately, however, the Phoenix was unable to return to its home without the ability to fly, forcing it to live in solitude in the demon's world until nothing but its vibrantly colored bones were left.

raw.es: Hace mucho tiempo, existió un hermoso Fénix carmesí que había jurado servir a una diosa. El Fénix protegió de forma divina a la diosa durante el transcurso de muchos años, hasta que apareció un demonio y puso punto final a la vida de la deidad. Enloquecido por la ira, el Fénix persiguió al demonio hasta su mundo natal y consiguió su venganza a cambio de sus dos alas. Lamentablemente, el ave mágica no pudo regresar a su hogar sin la capacidad de volar y se vio obligada a vivir en soledad en un mundo plagado de demonios hasta que los únicos vestigios que quedaron de él fueron sus huesos de enérgico color.

raw.pt: Muito tempo atrás, havia uma linda fênix carmesim que jurou seu serviço a uma deusa. A Fênix ofereceu a divina proteção para a deusa por muitos anos, até que um demônio de outro mundo apareceu e matou a deusa. Cheia de raiva, a Fênix perseguiu o demônio até seu mundo e conseguiu sua vingança trocando suas duas asas. Infelizmente, a Fênix não poderia voltar para casa sem a habilidade de voar, sendo forçada à solidão no mundo do demônio até que nada além de seus ossos tenham sobrado.
raw.th: นานมาแล้ว มีฟีนิกซ์สีแดงที่งดงามผู้คอยรับใช้เทพธิดา ฟีนิกซ์จะคอยมอบพลังศักดิ์สิทธิ์ให้เทพธิดามาเป็นเวลานาน จนกระทั่งปีศาจจากต่างโลกปรากฏตัวขึ้นและสังหารเทพธิดา ด้วยความโกรธแค้น ฟีนิกซ์จึงไปยังโลกปีศาจเพื่อออกตามล่ามัน และแลกเปลี่ยนปีกกันเพื่อเป็นการแก้แค้นได้สำเร็จ แต่โชคไม่ดีเลยที่ฟีนิกซ์ไม่อาจกลับบ้านได้ทั้งที่ยังบินไม่ได้ จึงต้องดิ้นรนอยู่ในโลกของปีศาจต่อไป จนกระทั่งเหลือเพียงกระดูกที่ส่องแสงทิ้งไว้ต่างหน้า

desc: A transparent piece of Beiorg's body which shines. This item, which lights up even when severed from its original source, is believed to be a crucial part of Beiorg's restorative systems. However, many details regarding this Item still remain unclear, so most of the Bulbs that have been collected thus far are reserved to conduct further research.

Namun sifatnya hilang saat dicampur bahan lain, sehingga susah dikerjakan. Masih perlu banyak riset sebelum dapat digunakan secara praktis.
raw.pt: A part of Beiorg's armor. Believed to have been made with techniques foreign to Elgaia, this seemingly weightless Item's great durability and elasticity has been drawing the attention of many as a new material. However, it tends to lose its valuable properties when mixed with other ingredients, making it a very difficult material to work with. Much more research is still needed before it can be put to practical use.
raw.th: ชิ้นส่วนชุดเกราะของเบยอร์ก ว่ากันว่าใช้เทคนิคของชาวต่างแดนของแกรนไกอา ไอเทมที่ดูไร้น้ำหนัก มีความทนทานและยืดหยุ่นนี้กลายเป็นที่สนใจในการนำมาเป็นวัตถุดิบใหม่ อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณค่าของมันดูจะลดลงเมื่อนำไปรวมกับวัตถุอื่น ทำให้เป็นวัตถุที่หาส่วนผสมมารวมด้วยยาก และคงต้องศึกษามันอีกมากก่อนที่จะนำไปใช้อย่างแพร่หลาย

id: Kristal tertanam dalam tongkat setan Amu Yunos. Punya kekuatan menyempurnakan kekuatan sihir dan akal penggunanya. Dengan kekuatan yang cukup, barang ini dapat dipakai untuk mengamati seluruh dunia. Namun, bahkan di antara setan-setan Ishgria, belum ada yang bisa memanfaatkan kekuatan ini sepenuhnya. Karena dibuat dari bahan yang tak diketahui dengan teknik dunia lain, susah diperoleh lebih dari satu.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10631_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal embedded in the demon Amu Yunos's staff. It has the power to enhance its user's magical power and senses. It is said that with enough power, this item makes it possible to observe the entire world. However, even among Ishgria's demons, almost none have been able to use this power to its full extent. Since it was created from unknown materials with otherworldly techniques, it is difficult to acquire more than one.

id: Persembunyian ular besar yang hidup di wilayah Zamburg. Ular besar sedikit jumlahnya, disebut "ular naga" karena ukurannya, dan ditakuti sebagai beast yang sangat buas. Sisik perak indah menutupi tubuh ular ini, meski lebih dari sekadar dekorasi, sisik juga sangat keras dan material berharga untuk senjata dan zirah. Tak pernah kurang orang yang ingin menantang ular meski mereka berbahaya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10732_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The hide of a great serpent which lives in the Zamburg region. While great serpents are few in number, they are called "serpent dragons" for their size, and are feared as extremely savage beasts. Beautiful silver scales cover parts of these snakes' bodies, though more than mere decoration, they are also an extremely hard and treasured material used for arms and armor. Accordingly, there is never a shortage of those who wish to challenge the serpents despite the danger they represent.

id: Bahan yang jarang ditemukan di wilayah Fal Nerga di Ishgria. Naga hitam penakluk asli tanah ini tidak punya sarang tunggal; namun berkeliaran malam demi malam, mengusir musuh. Suatu hari, naga hitam penakluk berdiri di atas puncak gunung suci dan disambar petir dari awan ungu yang mengelilinginya. Naganya langsung mati, meninggalkan taring putih peraknya.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10518_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A material rarely discovered in the Fal Nerga region of Ishgria. The black conqueror dragons native to this land do not maintain a single den; instead, they wander night after night, driving away enemies. Once, a black conqueror dragon set foot atop the peak of the sacred mountain and was struck by lightning from the purplish clouds enshrouding it. It is said that the dragon was instantly slain, leaving behind only these silver-white fangs.

id: Harpa yang dikagumi dan dicintai setan "dewa gunung" sehingga saat teman akrabnya berkunjung, harpa akan dimainkan. Proses pembuatannya tidak diketahui sejak lama, namun penemuan baru di Ishgria menunjukkan kira-kiranya. Rumornya, bukan hanya suaranya yang indah, harpa ini bisa menenangkan siapa saja yang mendengar musiknya selagi menyemangati lagi jiwa mereka.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_21100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A harp adored by a demon known as "the mountain god." It loved the harp so much, that when intimate demon friends came to visit, the demon would play the harp for them. Its manufacturing process had been unknown for a long time, but recent discoveries in Ishgria have shed light on how it is crafted. Rumor has it that not only is the sound of this harp beautiful, but that it can calm anyone who hears its music while revitalizing their spirit.

id: Cakar naga bumi masif asli Estia. Naga bumi ini mengalami separuh mineralisasi. Selain faktanya rumahnya di gua bawah tanah, siklus hidup naga masih misteri. Cakar dan taring sangat keras, sejumlah energi besar dapat diekstraksi dari mereka. Satu teori: ini karena pengaruh cadangan energi di bawah tanah Estria.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10422_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The claw of a massive earth dragon native to Estria. These earth dragons have undergone partial mineralization, and aside from the fact that they make their homes primarily in caverns deep underground, their life cycle is shrouded in mystery. Their fangs and claws are extremely hard and a substantial amount of energy can be extracted from them. One theory holds that these properties are due to the influence of the energy reserves that lie underground in Estria.

id: Sulur ungu tua yang membungkus Mordlim. Mereka sadar, meski tanaman, dan bertindak sendiri sesuai kehendak Mordlim.  Karena getah dunia lain ada di dalam tanaman, manusia yang terperangkap sulur jadi lumpuh oleh teror tak terpahami. Banyak sarjana memakai sulur ini, yang selalu beregenerasi meski dipotong berkali-kali, sebagai material untuk teknolgo dunia lain.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10007_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The dark purple vines that envelop Mordlim. They are self-aware, despite being plants, and have been seen to act on their own in concert with Mordlim's will. Owing to the otherworldly sap contained within the plant, humans caught by the vines find themselves disabled by unfathomable terror. Many scholars use these vines, which regenerate no matter how often they are cut, as materials for researching otherworldly technologies.

id: Karena terus terekspos sihir kuat, sayap Barion sangat kuat untuk ilmu sihir. Bahan berharga ini membuat para periset senang karena kemampuannya untuk bertindak sebagai konduktor tanpa kerugian virtual tanpa kerugian untuk sihir. Namun karena merupakan bagian dari tubuh setan, ini sangat sulit dikumpulkan dalam jumlah besar. Dipercaya, takkan membawa revolusi teknologi seperti yang diharapkan segelintir periset.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10116_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Due to their constant exposure to powerful magic, Barion's wings have an extremely strong affinity for sorcery. This precious material excited researchers due to its ability to act as a virtually lossless conductor for magic. However, as it constitutes a portion of a demon's body, this item is very difficult to gather in large numbers. Thus, it is believed that it will not bring about the technological revolution some researchers hoped for.

id: Kristal berbentuk sisik mengeluarkan sinar berbagai warna tergantungcahaya dan sudut melihatnya. Jarang-jarang, ditemukan di antara sisik di ekor Barion. Meski identik secara virtual, secara teknis, bukan sisik. Dipercaya adalah sisa terkalsium kekuatan sihir sangat besar. Kekuatan di dalamnya tidak bisa ditarik di sini; karya pemrosesan maju kemungkinan besar bakal diperlukan.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10733_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A scale-shaped crystal that shines with a wide variety of colors depending on the light and the angle it is viewed from. In rare cases, they are found among the scales present on Barion's tail. While it is virtually identical, technically it is not actually a scale. Instead it is believed to be the calcified residue of immense magical power. The power within cannot be drawn out here; advanced processing work will likely be required.

id: Sutra merah-hijau dipercaya dipintal laba-laba fantom yang tinggal dalam tubuh Mordlim. Karena sutra dipintal oleh laba-laba langka fantom ini memiliki sifat mengusir setan, ini sangat dihargai dalam upaya purifikasi. Baju terbuat dari benang ini selalu berkualitas tertinggi, memiliki kekuatan sihir sangat besar. Namun karena benang ini langka, jarang yang bisa menemukan baju ini.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_10734_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Red-green silken thread believed to be spun by the phantom spiders that inhabit the demon Mordlim's body. As the silk spun by these rare phantom spiders has properties that ward off evil, it is prized for its value in purification measures. Clothing made with this thread is always of the highest quality, and holds immense magical power. However, as this thread is incredibly rare, few will ever encounter such an item.

id: Kristal berisi partikel berharga dikumpulkan dari lokasi di sekitar tempat setan Amu Yunos muncul. Mengeluarkan sinar unik, saat menyambar menunjukkan makhluk hidup di dekatnya, visi masa lalu dan masa depan. Sifat asli kekuatan kristal tetap tidak diketahui, tapi hampir dipastikan terhubung dengan keberadaan Amu Yunos. Beberapa berteori ini hasil dari kejutan kekuatannya bergema dalam material di dekatnya waktu itu.
name: MST_ITEMS_MATERIAL_11041_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A crystal containing precious particles that can be gathered from locations where the demon Amu Yunos has appeared. It radiates a unique light, and when struck is said to show living beings in the vicinity, visions of the past and future. The true nature of the crystal's power remains unknown, but it is almost definitely linked to the existence of Amu Yunos. Some theorize that it results from the aftershocks of her powers reverberating in materials nearby at the time.
